8-4.desc: This 301 - piece set includes 14 wheels and 14 tires. A unique turntable allows models to be made with turning parts. Builds all the models shown and many more. Adds to your Lego collection.

9-2.desc: A jumbo set of 550 pieces including 8 small wheels, 4 windows, a trailer hitch, and door. Builds large houses, trucks, animals - almost anything you can imagine. A truly deluxe set for lots of fun.

6844-1.desc: Explorer vehicle. With metal detector and parabolic scanner.

1000-1.desc: Contains 190 elements in 5 colors and 8 classic geometic designs. Plus 12 inspirational cards to stimulate classroom ideas and uses.

1056-1.desc:
773 elements, including 6 large Baseplates, 12 loose hubs with tires and bearings, 16 windows with shutters and frames, 6 doors, 6 figures, turning and tipping elements, ladders, propellers, plus plenty of standard bricks. Includes 6 "idea" cards and a Teacher's Guide.
$54.85

6066-1.desc: The Camouflaged Outpost is a forest hideout where secret missions can be planned. Just open the hidden passageways and enter a world of fun and adventure.

6921-1.desc: Travel to the farthest point of your LEGO universe. Add this set (#6921) to expand your #6990 Monorail transport system to over 18 running feet of track and watch the fun grow.

8832-1.desc:
From 8 years.
Steering gear and rear wheel suspension. Can also build into a 3 Wheeled Racer.

6077-2.desc: Deep in river country lies this hidden fortress built by hearty mini-woodsmen. Ride down the river on the log raft to get supplies while others stand guard on the lookout tower. Includes 6 Forestmen.

6347-1.desc: Increase the range of your Airport Shuttle to over 29 running feet. Add 10 new feet of track and support columns. Includes 4 new track layouts.

6862-1.desc:
A special collection of the 3 most popular M:TRON models. Great fun building all thre models!
BUT THE FUN CONTINUES–you'll also receive another set of building instructions to combine these 3 sets into the secret M:TRON Space Voyager. Ages 8-12. 333 pieces. Save 10%–SPECIALL PRICED at $41.85
Secret M:Tron Space Voyager includes: #6923 Particle Ionizer, #6877 Vector Detector, and #6896 Celestial Forager.
• Bonus Instructions Included

9356-1.desc: Keep young minds active role-playing, shopping or visiting around town. Two large green baseplates set the scene for this livelly LEGO Community where LEGO people deliver mail, serve hot chocolate to waiting customers or clean the streets. This 625 piece set includes brick separators plus 4 idea cards in a red storage bin.

2304-1.desc:
Start creations here!
Even big imaginations need a place to start--and our baseplates do the job.
Measures 15" (38.1cm) x 15" (38.1cm).
Bricks not included.

2734-1.desc:
Need more tracks?
Sometimes you just need a bit more track to make the train go where you want it to. These track sets give you added flexibility.
Includes 6 pieces of straight track
For use with LEGO® DUPLO® trains

2735-1.desc:
Need more tracks?
Sometimes you just need a bit more track to make the train go where you want it to. These track sets give you added flexibility.
Includes 6 pieces of curved track
For use with LEGO® DUPLO® trains

917-1.desc: This three-ring binder contains over 100 pages with 30 different actitivies to support middle school physical science instruction in the areas of motion, energy, work, power, and electricity. Activities of three types (exploration, investigation and invention) are divided into instructional units for flexible use. The binder also contains extensive background information and a supplement of additional useful material. Activities in the binder are designed for use with the TECHNIC II (item #1032) building set.

9701-1.desc: Contains 527 pieces including three motors, four lamps, one sound element, one touch sensor, one temperature sensor, one light sensor, and two angle sensors. Includes enough elements for one building station and two to three students. Also includes step-by-step building instructions for seven models.

8858-1.desc:
This monster truck has four balloon tires, six working pistons that move as the vehicle rolls, and a crane with tow hook that goes up and down when you turn the crank.
• Steer with the knob on top of the Wrecker.
• Turn the crank to raise and lower the crane hook.

9255-1.desc: A new LEGO family hits town! Two adults and two children arrive with newly decorated faces and hair styles. This 173-piece set includes doors, windows, propellers, fences, wheels and basic elements. You can build houses, planes, cars and much more.

1787-1.desc: Small, medium and large tires make this the best space mobile ever for cruising up and down the treacherous slopes of lunar craters. Comes with enough pieces to build a small spacecraft to hover overhead or check out the next galaxy! Two astronauts included.

2150-1.desc:
Every train needs a station — and here's the most exciting station of all! Just like a real big-city station, there's plenty to keep you busy. Buy a ticket to Kalamazoo. Get a bite to eat, make a phone call or mail a letter. The luggage trailer will handle your luggage and the control room will tell you when to board. Includes eight travelers, luggage, letters, mailbox and many other special pieces.
* Train tracks sold separately.

2699-1.desc: Your child will moo and oink and neigh and cluck while keeping busy on the DUPLO farm. There's so much to do -- like hitch up the cart, feed the animals, ride a horse, load blocks in the silo and release the trap door so they tumble into the tractor's wagon. Includes large barn, two horses, 2 pigs, 2 cows, 1 sheep, 3 chickens and four farmers.

2745-1.desc:
At a certain stage children learn that they have the power to make things react to their touch. Your young engineer will just love making the train run and stop, go backwards and automatically change direction. And to add to the fun there is a cargo shoot where your child can drop blocks into the cargo wagon and even raise and lower the crossing gate. The battery powered DUPLO Cargo Train can go everywhere — it runs on the track and directly on the floor. Plus, unlike ordinary toy trains, your child builds both locomotive and wagons and then can redesign them his or her own way. It's a toy that stays fresh, a new adventure each time. Requires 3AA Alkaline batteries (not included).
• Little fingers can drop cargo into the wagon.
• Features 4 different actions and sounds children can operate themselves!
• Add [the pole changer] piece anywhere on the track to change direction.
• Hand operated start/stop rail allows your child to choose whether the train stops, goes by, or changes direction.

4002-1.desc:
See how fast you can rip through the waves in this bright red and black racer. The rear opens for quick engine repairs. And the chrome-plated exhaust pipes take you faster than the speed of sound!
• Check out the cool engine on this hot racer!
• Approximately 8" long.

4012-1.desc:
You’re in command of the seas when you build and drive this awesome police boat. Walkie talkies and megaphones put the power of communication in your hands. Then use the working winch to reel in those who break the law!
• Approximately 8 1/2" long

4022-1.desc:
When other boats are in trouble, the C26 Sea Cutter races to the rescue. It's the fastest speed boat around and is stocked with the latest rescue equipment. The sleek hull cuts through even the roughest ocean waters. Includes a three-person crew.
• Approximately 12" long
• Cockpits in front open and close

4565-1.desc: All the action and excitement of a bustling train yard, complete with an engine, three flatbed train cars, containers for loading solids and liquids, two working cranes, a working scale for weighing cargo, a truck and much more. Use the cranes to load the cars, make sure the load's not too heavy, then let'em roll round the track. Requires #4548 9-volt Speed Regulator to operate (sold separately).

6104-1.desc:
Aquazone Divers (Includes Thresher, Jock and their sidekicks!)
20 pieces. $7.25

6248-1.desc:
Only the brave dare enter! Can you find the treasure hidden in the secret cave...behind the rock skull...protected by an active volcano? Includes a pirate, skeleton and raft.
• Pull the pin in back to send Skully sailing!
• Keep Skull Cave a secret — push the tooth to make face swivel — look what's inside!

626-1.desc:
The perfect starting point for LEGO® creations!
Whether you're constructing a forest scene or just like the color green, this 32x32-stud building plate is the perfect starting point for building, displaying, transporting and playing with your LEGO® creations.
This large building plate measures 32x32 studs or 10'' (25cm) x 10'' (25cm)
A great supplement to any LEGO collection!
Bricks not included.

628-1.desc:
The perfect starting point for LEGO® creations!
Whether you're constructing a castle scene or just like the color gray, this building plate is the perfect starting point for building, displaying, transporting and playing with your LEGO® creations.
This x-large building plate measures 15'' (38cm) x 15'' (38cm)
A great supplement to any LEGO collection!
Bricks not included.

6337-1.desc: This it is — the moment of truth for two speedy race cars and their fearless drivers. Who will cross the finish line first? Only you can decide! Comes with a viewing tower, tow truck, 2 spectators, five signal flags and a pit stop full of tools and tires for quick fixes.

9833-1.desc: This standard 9v transformer plugs in to an AC outlet to recharge your #9798 Rechargeable Battery for LEGO® MINDSTORMS? NXT.9 volts; requires AC outlet.Related charger is no longer available. If charger is also needed, please order #9693 and #8887.

6323-1.desc: Create your own unique LEGO community road system…then have fun building tunnels, bridges, buildings and more with your LEGO bricks. Or use these plates to build a winding raceway. All road plates are detailed with bicycle/jogging paths. Each plate measures 10" square. Two plates per package.

6547-1.desc: The name of the game is FUN! Spin the wheel and see if you win the golden coins. Then take a ride on the giant swing! Stop for ice cream at the cafe and board the festive tram for a tour of the fairgrounds. Ages 7-12. 176 pieces.

6565-1.desc: A trio of trucks for all kinds of construction jobs. Best of all, they're a breeze to construct! After you build'em, scoop and dump and drive through town! Includes 3 construction workers, roadblocks and tools to help you get the job done. Ages 5-12. 73 pieces.

2011-1.desc: Turn the house into a make-believe camera or a mobile home. Molly of course can fit in the house, and your baby will have great fun with this set.

2021-1.desc: A superb collection of toys designed to stimulate baby during those early stages. Clarence Caterpillar can be wheeled and shaken and, when he's squeezed, he bounces! Desmond duck rattles, Sammy Starfish is the ideal teething ring, and a third element has a mirror.

2022-1.desc: Edward is a large elephant, big enough to sit and rock on. Alternatively, add the rollers and let your child apply leg power to move Edward across the floor. Edward is a great storage holder, and his short little trunk is perfect for adding colourful LEGO bricks to! A real quality toy.

2279-1.desc: A host of brightly coloured elements and DUPLO bricks, tubes that click together and through which a ball can be rolled, a push-along train and carriage, and a ghost costume which is great for games of hide-and-seek. What more could you ask for? A set packed full of fun!

2434-1.desc: Sheriff Jake is ready to protect the Wild West from bandits! You can deputise for Sheriff Jake with your very own Sheriff's badge. Role play has never been so much fun as with Sheriff Jake, Bandit Joe, prison and decorated 'wanted' and 'key' bricks. All stored in a Sheriff Jake Container.

2436-1.desc: Many stories can be told around the camp fire! A magnificent Indian camp complete with tepees, canoe, decorated totem pole, Big Chief's family and decorated bricks.

2817-1.desc: It's party time in the DUPLO house, time for cake and lots of fun. Complete with party goers, table, chairs and other fun elements to give your child a great time. From 2 years.

2866-1.desc: A magnificent LEGO Attraction with a variety of wild animals, children's play facilities and a selection of DUPLO bricks and decorated elements to give your child the best time yet. From 2 years.

6907-1.desc: Complete with insectoid unit which provides light and sound! Insector 2, the female member of the reconnaissance crew, controls this strong, powerful ship equipped for defending the Insectoid nation and for foraging the planet Armeron for the Voltstone rock. This rock is created when lightening strikes the planet and is used by the crew to fuel their fleet. From 7 years.

6919-1.desc: Once located the voltstone is then collected by a member of the Collection Team. The Odonata and its pilot, Inspector Leon, travel the surface of the planet Armeron ready to pick up the energy stones. From 7 years.

6969-1.desc: With the new insectoid unit which gives off light and sound the front of the vehicle can be detached from the rear to become a high speed space ship for those tricky manoeuvres. There are also 2 smaller vessels attached by magnets which have further magnetic elements to pick up the Voltstone from the planet Armeron. Zec, Captain of the Space Swarm, is the most experienced member of the team to pilot this craft. From 8 years.

6977-1.desc: A sly spider! The base can split into two, to form two vessels, one with wheels and the other containing the special insectoid unit which created light and sound. Webb is the Commander of the Arachno Base which also acts as the group's fueling station. From 8 years.

8266-1.desc: This really brilliant set includes a motorised spider which jumps around to avoid Blue Flash hitting its target. You control Blue Flash by the use of its arms as you compete to get a real piece of the action. Once you've hit the target the spider's controller is dislodged from his seat, the motor stops and victory is yours! From 7 years.

8417-1.desc:
Hold onto those handlebars! This motorcycle is the fastest bike on the streets, with working gears, shiny chrome rims, super shocks, clear piston heads and a whole lot more. Build it carefully, piece by piece, and when it’s ready to roll, pop a wheelie and show some speed! Next use the same pieces to build the alternate chopper bike.
• Super shocks!
• New Silver Rims
• All new clear pistons!

8428-1.desc:
A superb red hot machine sporting the new alloy wheels. The V6 engine moves during the driving of the car and the seats are adjustable. By pressing the spoiler down at the back of the car it can be transformed into a more sporty vehicle. There are instructions for an alternative buggy complete with moving V6 engine which can be motorised with set number 8735. Enclosed in the 8428 is a FREE CD ROM which will give the user opportunities to build their models using the CD ROM, see the 98 TECHNIC range, and lots more opportunities.
From 10 years.

8482-1.desc: This CD-ROM takes you to TECHNIC City where your guide is Taxi Jim. He will show you the Colosseum, where robots do battle, and Area 15 where Joe the Mechanic will help you construct your models. With LEGO TECHNIC Cybermaster you control your models on the floor via your PC while you participate in a fun and challenging on-screen adventure in TECHNIC City. The LEGO TECHNIC Cybermaster set contains a CD-ROM, a transmittor, a programmable LEGO Brick and touch sensors along with all the building elements you need in order to design your own robots.

9725-1.desc: This set includes bricks and building instructions for 4 different models. Each model is controlled via the RCX programmable brick using ROBOLAB software (software and RCX not included). The models are based on real-life applications in an amusement-park setting, including a bumper car, merry-go-round, tour bus and haunted house ride. Ideally, one Amusement Park Set for every 3-4 students.

2030-1.desc: A great little set which can be used at bathtime or during any water play activity. The friendly looking frog is fun to look at and great for those little hands to investigate. When you press the top of Freddie's head he will wink and squirt water at you.

2031-1.desc: Toby and his Friend are fun to play with in or out of the water. Toby floats and, as water is gently poured on top of him, he will move forward in the water.

2046-1.desc: An ideal way to keep baby busy in the bathtub and a fun way to encourage coordination skills.

2048-1.desc: To stimulate those eyes, ears and little hands, this superb set includes a variety of toys including Toby Turtle, who moves forward when water is poured overe him, a lily that can float, and a 'spyhole' element that can be used for a game of hide and seek. All the elements can be stored in the container when bathtime is over, and the lid can even float to hold all those elements during bathtime or water play.

2076-1.desc: With this fun house children can play hide and seek and begin to role play as they learn to stack the elements and put little Timmy to bed.

2108-1.desc: Boatloads of fun! Every little bather needs a boat — especially one with a paddle that turns around and around in the water.

2807-1.desc: Scoop 'em up and tip 'em out — again and again and again! Or help Billy hide in the secret compartment in back.

2821-1.desc:
Climb on the back of a brachiosaurus! Let a T-Rex give you a tug! These and many more prehistoric adventures await your little cave-kid. 37 pieces.
Ages 2-6. About $30

4519-1.desc: Add the cross track to your existing train set to make even better train layouts. Now your train can criss-cross through your entire LEGO town! This track is made for 9v LEGO Trains and conducts electricity to make 9v trains run. This track is also compatible with new LEGO RC Trains!

4541-1.desc:
Up, up, up rises the bucket of the service truck so you can make repairs to lights and wires. Comes with plenty of tools and a two-person repair crew.
• Move the black plate to change the light from red to green.
• Flip rail wheels up, then drive this truck in your town.

5805-1.desc: In a tower of the castle Princess Rosaline has the prettiest room you can imagine – with a bed draped in fancy cloth and a vanity table where she gets ready for balls. Includes Princess Rosaline in a beautiful gown and Millimy the Fairy.

5807-1.desc: The story continues at the king's stable, where the Prince takes care of his trust steed Lucas. Iris comes for a visit, and helps the Prince with grooming and saddling the horse. Includes lots of extras for many happy hours of play, including a treasure chest, rabbit, and good fairy.

5808-1.desc: With shining turrets and flags waving in the air, this castle is easy to build and so much fun to play with! Here you'll find the King and the beautiful Princess Rosaline surrounded by their animal friends – a cute rabbit, a pet bird and a friendly little fish. Lots of other realistic special pieces like beautiful jewels, shiny silver crowns, flowers, food and a magical fairy make playing in the castle even more fun! But watch out—the wicked witch is close by!

6435-1.desc: Patrol the shores in the dinghy. Watch from the sky in the coast guard chopper, plus your station even has a truck and three-wheeler for rescues on the beach. The coast guard station is also equipped with a search light, stretcher, rescue tubes, diving gear and six rescue workers. Coast Guard boat really floats.

6454-1.desc: Launch this rocket into space to deploy the top secret communications satellite! Lights flash and the engine roars as you blast off! Includes one brave astronaut, meteor and launch pad. Requires two AA batteries for lights and sound (not included).

6456-1.desc: This amazingly realistic space shuttle is ready to take-off for deep space -- with you at the controls! First, build the shuttle and launch pad. Buckle in and get ready to blast off -- with working lights and real sounds! The launch pad has radar, tools, video surveillance, fuel stand and lab. Includes 1 astronaut and 3 workers. Requires two AA batteries to activate lights and sound (not included).

8444-1.desc: With super-cool front shell, corrugated tubing and flexible axles. Rotors can be manually activated. Instructions for alternative helicopters. Jet Wasp can be motorised with set number 8735. Performance is unbelievable.

9681-1.desc:
The eLAB Renewable Energy Set expands upon the energy themes presented in the Energy Work Power Starter Set, inviting students to explore the possibilities of sustainable energy from sun, wind, and water. Solar energy can be captured by the LEGO Solar Cell and used to power a model Ferris wheel or car. Alternatively, create a windmill or watermill and witness wind or water power in action!
There are 721 elements, including one solar cell, one motor, two sorting trays, and building instructions for seven models.

3734-1.desc: Your passengers can enjoy the view with these great new train windows, complete with panes. Choose the color that works best for your train design. Perfect for building your own custom cars!

3913-1.desc: Keep your keys on the coolest key chains in town!

3952-1.desc: Keep your keys on the coolest key chain in town or just collect them all and attach them to your back pack.

5934-1.desc: Here's everything you need as you set off in search of dinosaurs – an all-terrain vehicle, tools, camping equipment, even a campfire. Includes two adventurers.

6520-1.desc: Here's the gear you need to survive freezing temperatures and ice terrain. Snowshoes, backpacks, binoculars and walkie-talkies for communicating with base camp. Plus a snowmobile, mobile lab and a treaded snow truck. Bundle up and see if you can survive where no one has ever gone before! Includes two arctic explorers.

6569-1.desc:
Rumor has it that a precious fossil is buried somewhere deep in the ice. Put on your parka, hop on the snowmobile, hook up the sled and go off on the search — if you dare! Includes two Arctic explorers with snow shoes and lots of tools to help you on your search.
• Uncover precious fossils frozen for thousands of years in solid ice.

6573-1.desc: Nothing can stop you in this super-powered snow plow! Its rubber treads move over any terrain. Collect frozen fossils with the Arctic crane — then head back to warmth as quick as you can! Includes two Arctic explorers.

6575-1.desc:
You're in charge of the action at the base camp — center of the biggest Arctic exploration in history. Includes a communications tower, rescue helicopter, snow trekkers and medical facility. Plus all the gear you need for braving the elements — polar parka, binoculars, ice picks, snow shoes and a stretcher for rescues. Danger lurks everywhere. Not just the icy cold, but hungry polar bears, too! Includes six Arctic explorers.
• Load frozen fossils into base for safe keeping.
• Find frozen fossils.
• Take off on the snowmobile for daring rescues.

8236-1.desc: Use the launcher from #8237 or #8238 to send this trike crusing across the room. Launcher not included.

8237-1.desc: All you have to do is give this race car a "slam" – and wheels spin and screech as they zoom across the floor.

9087-1.desc: This fun set contains tubes that allow children to build their own tracks and study how balls, figures and other elements roll through the tunnel, while reinforcing their understanding of cause and effect, and gravity.

926097-1.desc: For the ultimate LEGO Fan pack your sandwiches and a drink in LEGO lunchbox, making your lunch colourful. Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

B003-1.desc: This door is the perfect finishing touch to any house, building or creation!

B005-1.desc: Includes 25 low sloped ridge roof tiles in red.

10018-1.desc:
Jedi, beware – Darth Maul lives again in this striking bust, perfect for display in your home. The Dark Lord of the Sith makes a menacing model and a great addition to any Star Wars collection. Highly detailed and realistic, this Darth Maul bust stands over 17" tall.
• Sturdy Display Stand
• Over 17" tall!
Ages 14+. 1,860 pieces.
Not available in any store.

4723-1.desc: Join Hermione shopping in Diagon Alley. What are you in the market for … a new magic wand, an interesting pet, or …?

6290-1.desc:
You're Red Beard, captain of the meanest ship on the high seas! Your loyal crew of 6 are ready to take on anyone that dares cross their path! When the mast collapses and the skull hull breaks away – snap them back into place for the next high seas adventure. There's plenty of action, with a plank to walk, cannons, crane with net and of course, a treasure chest filled with gold!
• Pull the pin to drop the mast!
• Hoist sails up and down.
• Skull hull breaks away. Snap it back into place!

6774-1.desc:
This high-powered ATV is ready to travel over the roughest terrain, up the sides of volcanoes, or even deep underground. The Alpha Team mini-sub can take an agent underwater for signs of Ogel and his skeleton zombies. Use the winch to raise and lower the sub, and the launcher to send Flex flying with his cable. Includes Alpha Team agents Flex and Cam.
• Pull back and release to launch agent.
• Lower sub with working winch!

7377-1.desc: You're ready to journey to another planet with this cool Mars Biodium watch! Design the look of your watch with 32 links in five different colors. Features include magnifying lens and star map holder, wrap-around straps, water resistance to 100 ft. and night glow hands.

8465-1.desc:
With jumbo tires and a working suspension system, this awesome vehicle goes where others can’t – and won’t – go! You can even use the tow cable on the Extreme Off Roader to tow other vehicles! Next, add #8375 LEGO TECHNIC motor (sold separately).
• Super Suspension!
• Steer with control knob.
• Unwind tow hook to haul heavy objects.

8466-1.desc:
This 4x4 shows no fear! Its large, air-filled tires roll over real off-road obstacles, and lifelike pumping pistons show it’s ready for action! The knob on top turns the wheels so you can steer! Next, add #5218 Pneumatic Pack (sold separately) to add a crane arm.
• Press button to raise pneumatic gull-wing doors.
• Large air filled tires have awesome suspension!
• Includes building instructions for an alternate 4x4 Buggy Racer.
• Steer with control knob.
• Pumping Pistons
• Over 17"

8546-1.desc: This special BIONICLE power pack features a Universal Music CD with songs inspired by BIONICLE, a silver Kanohi mask, and a Matoran model. A great addition to any BIONICLE collection!

922213-1.desc: Erase any errors and look cool while you do it with this set of LEGO brick erasers!

10023-1.desc: Now you can build your own BIONICLE creatures to add to your adventures! This special BIONICLE Master Builder Set includes pieces and instructions for 15 creatures of Mata Nui – plus you can use the parts to build your own creations too!

10030-1.desc: Build the most awesome ship in the Star Wars universe! The Imperial Star Destroyer is the massively huge, incredibly powerful heart of the Emperor's fleet. Manned by the top crew in the Imperial Navy, the Star Destroyer was heavily armored and bristling with turbolasers and tractor beam projectors. One Star Destroyer alone was enough to strike fear into an entire star system! Now you can add the Imperial Navy's best-known and most powerful ship to your LEGO Star Wars collection! Measuring an impressive 37' by 23', this model dwarfs any LEGO Star Wars ship ever produced. This beautifully designed and one-of-a-kind collector's item comes with a special display stand and collectors card. Also includes an exclusive Rebel Blockade Runner Mini-Model, so you can recreate the opening scenes of Star Wars IV: A New Hope! Excerpt from the Imperial Navy Ship Identification Guide: Imperial-I Class Star Destroyer Length: 1,600 meters Manufacturer: Kuat Drive Yards Crew: 37,085 Top Sublight Speed: 60 MGLT Systems: 2 Om-Thaim Broadcast Banner Shield Generators 60 Borstel NK-7 Ion Cannon Batteries 10 Phylon-Q7 Tractor Beam Projectors Seinar Fleet Systems 1-a2b Solar Ionization Reactor and Stardrive 60 Taim and Bak XX9 Heavy Turbolaser Batteries LeGrange Targeting Computers Seinar Fleet Systems S-s3a Long Range Tachyon Detection Scanner Planetary Assault Units 6 Fighter Bays 28 Landing Bays

10047-1.desc: This beautiful arch is the perfect addition to your LEGO creation. Set includes: 1x5x4 Brick with Bow (Qty. 24) 1x4 Plate (Qty. 12)

10076-1.desc: Add these gear wheels to your creation! Set includes: Gear Wheel x2 Crown and Gear Wheel x2 Steering Wheel/Crank x2 Differential Gear Casing x1 Wedge-Belt Wheel x2 Gear Wheel x2 Double Conical Wheel x2 Turn Table x1 Double Conical Wheel x2 Lever Arm x2 Tricker x2 Angular Wheel x2

10153-1.desc: Just add this 9V Train Motor and #4548 Speed Regulator to your train engine, build your track layout, and your train is ready to roll!* * #4548 Speed Regulator and train tracks sold separately. 9v LEGO Trains require 9v tracks and rails, which conduct electricity. Compatible tracks and rails are #4515, #4519, #4520, #4531 and any track collections consisting of these item numbers. When motorized with a 9v motor, this engine will not run on LEGO RC Train tracks (#7895, #7896, #K7895, #K7896).

1383-1.desc: Get ready for the climax of the movie! The Pharaoh has awakened from his long sleep, and who knows what will happen next? But wait – what's that skeleton doing in the Pharaoh's tomb? Cut! Better try that shot again!

3918-1.desc: Keep your keys on the coolest LEGO key chains in town!

4109-1.desc: Your LEGO town is getting bigger every day, and this Curved Road Plate can help it grow!

4584-1.desc: Hot Scorcher is tops on the Grand Prix-style tracks, leaving opponents in his dust – send the Scorcher into the pits to become a four-wheeled Rocket or a short Sand Racer!

4585-1.desc: Hit the jet boosters and soar over obstacles in this mean off-road machine! The competition trembles when they hear the Nitro Pulverizer engine roar. Change it to a Formula 4x4 or an Extreme Power Off-Roader in seconds!

4586-1.desc: Is your Racer ready for the challenge of the ultimate stunt race track? Build your own stunt track, complete with obstacles, long jumps, and much more. Then watch your pull back motor car do wild stunts and jumps! Includes Racer.

4587-1.desc: Two powerful race buggies… one high-speed race! Lock the two pull back motor cars into the start gate and begin the countdown. 3…2…1… they're off! Take both cars into the pits and rebuild them into a street racer and an off-road monster. Or combine both engines in one car for canyon racing! Includes starting gate and two Racers.

4588-1.desc: Build an off-road race track and watch your Racers battle it out for the victory! Construct the track any way you like, add dangerous obstacles and see who has what it takes to win! Then take the track apart and rebuild it for another race. Includes two Racers with pull back motors.

4589-1.desc: Put the sleek Nitro Flash together and make it go with your RC controller! Three channels lets up to three cars race at once. Build a tough 4x4 off-road style racecar, then take it into the pits and turn it into a high-speed dune buggy! Swap wheels with other Racers models to change how fast the Nitro Flash can go, and how well it handles the curves. You're on your way to the checkered flag! Includes all the pieces needed to build the Nitro Flash, controller, and extra set of two small wheels.

4590-1.desc: Count on Flash Turbo to take the lead in the final seconds of the race! His super-charged car lets him rocket toward the finish line!

4591-1.desc: What's that super-fast blur coming down the track? It must be the Star Strike, on its way to another victory in the Drome!

4592-1.desc: Look out! Get out of the way! The Red Monster is roaring through the final lap, and nothing will stop him from crossing the finish line!

4593-1.desc: Zero Hurricane and Red Blizzard are the top dragsters in the Drome! Wind them up for incredible head-to-head racing. Do you have what it takes to be a champion? Turn these cars into Off-Roaders, or add the Hurricane's wheels to the Blizzard to make a fast Cart Racer. Includes starting light.

4594-1.desc: These two amazing racing machines are the fastest on the beach or in the city streets! Send them soaring high off the ramp! Includes stunt ramp.

4595-1.desc: You're ready for an off-road thrill ride with Zero Tornado and Hot Rock! When these two Drome racing mean machines face off, it's non-stop action all the way to the finish line. Includes two cars and drivers, jungle bridge, trees and foliage.

4596-1.desc: When you want heart-stopping stunt driving, you want the Storming Cobra! Use the high-speed pull back motor to send it racing up the ramp and soaring into space. Break records on your way to victory!

4796-1.desc: Ogel pilots this giant mutant squid through the water at ultra-fast speeds. Foes who dodge the flying spear and rocket “stone” still have to deal with the squid’s amazing, moveable arms and snapping jaws.

7142-1.desc: Take to the skies with Luke as he battles the forces of evil! Just like the real X-wing Fighter™, the wings adjust from wide to narrow for maximum maneuverability in battle. Luke is armed with his lightsaber just in case it comes down to hand-to-hand combat. Comes with ground crew person and transport with tools to prepare the X-wing Fighter for its next mission. Also includes Luke's droid navigator, R2-D2™, and Biggs Darklighter™.

7143-1.desc:
Obi-Wan Kenobi™ is ready to pursue Jango Fett™ in his sleek Jedi Starfighter! It's fast enough to navigate through even the most dangerous asteroid field. Includes Obi-Wan and R4-P17™.
Ages 8-12. 138 pieces.

8461-1.desc: If you're looking for a hot, sleek look and all the speed you can handle – you want the new Williams F1 Team Racer! Featuring the same colors and markings as the famous Formula One car, the Williams F1 Team Racer includes a V10-cylinder engine, high-grip tires, and independent suspension. Plus a special air pressure system lets you raise the bodywork to reveal the internal components of the car!

8468-1.desc: When this off-road monster gets moving, nothing stands in its way! Its powerful bumper can smash through rocks and boulders, and oversized tires make driving over the roughest terrain a snap. But watch out! Get hit by a boulder and you might trigger the ejection cockpit! Rebuild the Power Crusher in the pits and turn it into a three-wheeled beach buggy.

8470-1.desc: Its amazing power means drivers better be ready to get slammed into their seat by the G-forces. Challenge a friend to a high-speed race, winner take all! Slam your racer and shatter every speed record! Then take your G-Force into the pits and turn it into a hot rod.

8471-1.desc: If you want to race to victory in the Drome, you want the Nitro Burner! This awesome, top-tuned dragster burns up the track on its way to another win. Draw up the pull-back motor and watch it go – the longer and straighter the track, the faster the Nitro Burner will move! Rebuild the car into a Jet Racer for racing on the salt flats.

8472-1.desc: Send the Street ‘n Mud Racer flying down the track, but watch out – if it hits an obstacle, it starts running in reverse! When the rear bumper hits something, the car rockets forward again! A built-in electric motor makes it go. Plus you can change the car into a tough off-road racer in the pits! This powerful Racer is up to any challenge on city streets or on wild wilderness tracks.

8473-1.desc: Load your hot rod onto the truck and you're off to the big race! Once you're there, just tip the ramp and your Racer is ready to go. Or use the wheels and motor from the hot rod to turn the truck into a racing machine! You can also rebuild this set into two Racers, one with a pull-back motor and one with a slammer for all-out racing action!

8550-1.desc: The Gahlok Va stalks the seas, keeping an eye out for any threats to the Gahlok's mission.

10072-1.desc: Here are the beams you need to complete your creation! Set includes: Tube x2 5M Half Beam x2 4M Lever x2 3M Lever x2 Double Angular Beam 45 degrees x2 Angular Beam 45 degrees x2 2x3M Lever x2 7M Half Beam x2 6M Half Beam x2 Angular Beam 90 degrees x2 3x5 Half Beam Curve x2 Angular Beam 45 degrees x2 15M Beam x2 Angular Beam 45 degrees x2 3x3 Half Beam Curve x2 5M Beam x2 Lever Without Notch x2 Triangle x2 3M Beam x2 Angular Beam 90 degrees x2 Comb. Wheel x2 9M Beam x2 7M Beam x2 11M Beam x2 Steering Knuckle Arm x2 2M Lever x2 2M Beam x2 3x120 Lever x2

10074-1.desc: The axles you need for your LEGO model! Set includes: Universal Joint Grey x2 4M Cross Axle x4 6M Cross Axle x4 8M Cross Axle x2 12M Cross Axle x2 10M Cross Axle x2 Angle Element 157.5 degrees x2 Angle Element 112.5 degrees x2 Angle Element 90 degrees x2 Angle Element 180 degrees x2 Angle Element 135 degrees x2 Double Cross Block x2 Double Cross Axle x2 Cross Block x2 5M Cross Axle x4 Cross Block x2 Cross Block/Fork x2 3M Cross Block x2 7M Cross Axle x4 3M Cross Axle x4 2M Cross Axle with Groove x4 Toggle Joint x2 3M Cross Axle with knob x4 Catch x2 Catch with Cross Hole x2 Cross Axle Ext. x2 Cross Block 2x3 x2

10078-1.desc: Use this wire to connect your speed regulator to your tracks and give your train the power it needs to get rolling! 9v LEGO Trains require 9v tracks and rails, which conduct electricity. Compatible tracks and rails are #4515, #4519, #4520, #4531 and any track collections consisting of these item numbers. When motorized with a 9v motor, this engine will not run on LEGO RC Train tracks (#7895, #7896, #K7895, #K7896).

10080-1.desc: This adorable set has not been available in over 10 years! Fun and easy to build, it's sure to brighten your season!

4090-1.desc:
Is it a bird? A plane? No, it’s a LEGO model! Build a Motion Madness creation and watch it fly up a string or ride a bike across the floor! Invent whatever you choose, then set the wheels in motion as you place the creation on a string or wire and watch it go.
The special Idea Book included feaures full instructions for 6 models and inspiration for 9 more!
The Idea Book included with this set will bring hours of fun, with detailed step by step building instructions for 6 great models. Once you have mastered these, there are another 9 idea starters to inspire even more creative building with this Inventor Set!
Enter a whole new dimension of building with LEGO Inventor Sets! Construct wild creations of your own that really move, and then watch them go! Each LEGO Inventor Set features a wide assortment of elements in different shapes and colors, plus inspiration for many different models! Build whatever you like, however you like, and make it move, roll, or fly down a wire -- then take it apart and build it again. Combine sets and create totally unique models that are yours alone.
All Inventor Sets feature:
At least 6 full building instructions for cool models that move
Unique elements and new LEGO brick colors
Three levels of building fun -- Quick Build, Experienced Build, and Advanced Build
Imagine it.. build it.. and make it move!

4093-1.desc:
When you mix colorful LEGO elements and wind-up action, you have all the ingredients for fun! Build a model, wind it up, watch it move – then take it apart and build something else. The possibilities are endless when you “wind up” your imagination and let it go!
The special Idea Book included features full instructions for 6 models and inspiration for 11 more!
The Idea Book included with this set brings hours of fun, with detailed step by step building instructions for 6 models. Once you have mastered these, there are another 11 idea starters to inspirae creative building with this Inventor Set!

Combine sets and create totally unique models that are yours alone!
All LEGO Inventor Sets feature:
At least 6 full building instructions for cool models that move
Unique elements and new LEGO brick colors
Three levels of building fun -- Quick Build, Experienced Build, and Advanced Build
Imagine it.. build it.. and make it move!

4094-1.desc: Now you’re motoring! Bring your models to life with the electric motor in this set. Building instructions include a climbing monkey or spooky spider.

4095-1.desc:
With Record and Play, you can build models that walk, roll, or even write, all at your command! Hit "record," move your creation forward, backward, turn left or right, stop, in any order. Then hit "play" and your model will repeat the movements you've recorded! Batteries required (not included.)
The special Idea Book included features full instructions for 6 models and inspiration for 6 more!
The Idea Book included with this set brings hours of fun, with detailed step by step building instructions for 6 models. Once you have mastered these, there are another 6 idea starters to inspire creative building with this Inventor Set!
Enter a whole new dimension of building with LEGO Inventor Sets! Construct wild creations of your own that really move, and then watch them go! Each LEGO Inventor Set features a wide assortment of elements in different shapes and colors, plus inspiration for many different models. Unique elements and new LEGO brick colors

4193358-1.desc: You're ready for the ultimate spy mission with your Spybotics watch! Rearrange the wristband elements however you choose, to keep enemy agents guessing. Additional features: water resistant to 30m/100 ft., non-allergenic, guaranteed 2 year battery life.

4202580-1.desc: Show your classic LEGO style with this cool keyring, featuring the LEGO logo and a blue brick.

4204330-1.desc: Keep your keys on the coolest key chains in town!

4204333-1.desc: Show your classic LEGO style with this cool keyring, featuring the LEGO logo and a red brick.

4511-1.desc: Commuters rely on this lightning-fast locomotive to get them to work on time! Add this high speed train to your LEGO town and keep passengers moving from place to place. Complete set includes engine and passenger car, train station platform, 3 mini-figures, accessories and more. Set also includes 16 curved rails to create a 2 foot circle, as well as a 9-volt Speed Regulator and motor.

4512-1.desc: When you have cargo that's too big and heavy for a truck, you need a train! This cargo train comes with an engine and 3 freight cars so you can get your important goods across the country in a hurry. Includes 17 curved rails, 3 straight rails, 9-volt Speed Regulator, Motor, 3 mini-figures, decals and other accessories. When assembled, track measures 28" x 37 1/2".

4514-1.desc: Getting cargo on and off your train has never been easier! This strong and sturdy Cargo Crane lifts even the heaviest LEGO cargo from the dock to the truck once it arrives by rail. This special set includes 2 mini-figures, one pallet of cargo, crane and truck.

7471-1.desc:
This detailed replica is modeled after the "robot geologists" that will explore the surface of the red planet. Ths Mars Rovers will make history in 2004, but you can create your own today!
• Controllable steering!
• Moveable radar!
• Cardboard panels
• 6 tires keep Rover steady on rocky terrain!
• Solar panels flip up for landing then unlatch!

7503-1.desc:
Need a cool way to keep track of your busy life? Now you can hang up your important notes with CLIKITS™ Memo Minis! Use jelly string, CLIKITS icons, and paper shapes to create colorful memo strings, then use the suction cups included to hang them up!
Known in the UK as " Mini Memos."

7507-1.desc:
Design and make your own unique jewelry with the Jewels-n-Rings set. Mix colors, shapes, and styles to customize rings, bracelets and necklaces. It's so easy, you'll have your own personal line of jewelry before you know it! Set includes jelly strings, CLIKITS icons, ring forms, fancy paper shapes and an organizer tray.
Known in the UK as "Pretty Jewels 'n' Rings."

8364-1.desc: Are you ready for the ultimate racing challenge? Take on a friend on the Multi-Challenge Race Track, but watch out -- if your car starts to run out of energy, you'll have to pull into the pits and recharge! It takes speed, skill and strategy to win on this track. Power slide around corners, then shift lanes and head into the pit. How long will you recharge, a few seconds or all the way to full power? Your call might decide the race! Build the track how you like and add jumps and other challenges along the way. It's LEGO racing action like you've never seen it before! Batteries required (not included).

KC584-1.desc: This awesome keychain features the BIONICLE logo and the Matoran "Unity, Duty, Destiny" symbol. Show the world you're ready for adventure on Mata Nui!

10133-1.desc:
The Burlington Northern Santa Fe engine is ready to haul freight across the country! This special locomotive features an updated look and unique brick colors, making it a great addition to your LEGO Train collection. Modelled after a GP-38 locomotive, this train features the BNSF dark green/orange/yellow color scheme. Includes Engineer Max and Conductor Charlie minifigures.
To make this engine run, add #10153 9-volt Train Motor and #4548 9-volt Speed Regulator, each sold separately.
9v LEGO Trains require 9v tracks and rails, which conduct electricity. Compatible tracks and rails are #4515, #4519, #4520, #4531 and any track collections consisting of these item numbers.
When motorized with a 9v motor, this engine will not run on LEGO RC Train tracks (#7895, #7896, #K7895, #K7896).

10161-1.desc: Use these black roof tiles to put the crowning touch on your LEGO model. 2x4 Roof Tile (Qty. 20) 2x3 Roof Tile (Qty. 12) 2x2 Roof Tile (Qty. 32) 1x2 Roof Tile (Qty. 12)

4493-1.desc: Build a detailed MINI replica of Darth Maul's feared craft, the Sith Infiltrator from Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace!

4509-1.desc: The LEGO 3-Seat Playtable combines quality, value and fun! Made of solid hardwood, this table features three colorful building areas, three chairs, and a built-in storage tray for easy clean up. Baseplates are compatible with LEGO System and LEGO DUPLO bricks! Includes handy storage compartment in center of table! Table measures 38.5 inches x 38.5 inches x 22.5 inches high! Chairs measure 13" x 13" x 23 1/8". Three included 15 inch x 15 inch large baseplates are removable! LEGO bricks sold separately. Assembly required. This item may only be shipped within the 48 contiguous United States and Canada via regular shipping (no APO/FPO addresses or P.O. Boxes) - 2-Day and Next Day delivery are not available. Please note: due to the size and weight of this item, an extra freight charge has been included in the selling price.

4683-1.desc: This happy little girl is taking a break from her trip to town to water her horse. Then it's on to a day of fun and adventure!

4687-1.desc: The farmer relies on his tractor to get lots of work done around the farm. He can use the shovel in front to pick up bales of hay, and the trailer in back to carry tools and other useful items. Help him travel around the farm and finish his job!

5349-1.desc: One hundred LEGO QUATRO bricks for big building!

5355-1.desc: Early construction for your youngest child to enjoy.

5361-1.desc: Construction quickly turns HUGE when building with these big bricks

5942-1.desc: It's time for the pop singer to record her new album! First she gets ready in her dressing room and then it's time to sing. This special set includes dressing room with makeup mirror and accessories, studio with microphone, singer and more.

tags: Boba Fett's Slave I Firespray-31-class Starship

850355-1.desc:
He’ll guard the galaxy – and your keys!
Imperial Stormtroopers never question their orders, so when you tell this one to protect your keys, you know he’ll get the job done.

851009-1.desc: Stick your important notes and favorite pictures to almost any metallic surface with these awesome LEGO magnets! Includes 8 magnets in classic LEGO colors.

851010-1.desc: Hang a favorite photo or card on the fridge (or any other metal surface) in LEGO style! Set includes 14 magnetic 2 x 4 bricks in different colors.

851098-1.desc: This half-Toa, half-beast Toa Hordika is ready to go where you go on this awesome keychain! Carry your keys in true BIONICLE® style.

8621-1.desc: Turaga Dume commands the Vahki and maintains order in Metru Nui. His mighty hawk Rahi Nivawk flies above the city watching and listening to all that goes on. What mysterious plans does Dume have for the Matoran, and how will they affect the Toa Metru?

9546-1.desc: A young designer’s paradise, this set allows children to create countless patterns while learning all about shapes, colors, sequences, and symmetry. In addition to the tiles, the set contains two white building plates, along with an extensive teacher’s guide and 12 activity cards.

10143-1.desc: No one who saw the dreaded Death Star in the classic Star Wars films could ever forget it. Now you can build your own to add to your LEGO Star Wars collection! This incredibly detailed and faithful replica of the Death Star II from Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi will make an awesome addition to any Star Wars collection. The partially constructed Death Star looms in space above the forest moon of Endor, super laser ready to fire. This unique collectable is sure to rank as one of the greatest LEGO Star Wars models ever produced! Includes display stand and Imperial Star Destroyer to scale. Measures a full 25 inches (65 cm) high and 19 inches (50 cm) wide (including stand).
tags: Death Star II Mobile Battle Station

10144-1.desc: Luke Skywalker's Uncle Owen is shopping for some new droids at the Jawa Sandcrawler. There are plenty to choose from, including R2-D2 and C-3PO. But the Jawas drive a hard bargain and danger is never far away. Recreate this classic scene from Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope with this incredibly detailed model! Includes a total of 11 minifigures and droids: Uncle Owen Lars, 3 Jawas, R2-D2, C-3PO, R5-D4, R1-G4, ASP droid, gonk droid and Treadwell droid. Remove the center section of the Sandcrawler to reveal the Jawa workshop! Use the crane to load droids into the Sandcrawler! Open the hatch to reveal the inside! Cockpit opens to load a driver! Steering mechanism lets you guide the Jawa vehicle to its next adventure! Measures 15 in/38 cm long, 7.5 in/19 cm wide and 9 in/22 cm high.

10168-1.desc: Spring brings flowers, warm sunshine and this happy bunny! A perfect addition to your spring holiday decorations.

10169-1.desc: This happy chicken and her chicks are ready for warm weather! Great fun to build and an adorable addition to your springtime decorations.

3297-1.desc: There's always lots to do at the Building Yard! Scoop helps Bob move things from place to place while Lofty puts a new roof on the house. Then it's on to the next job! Includes Bob the Builder, Lofty and Scoop.

3770-1.desc: Everyone is excited because the circus train is on its way! The engineer steers the train with the baby elephant safely on board. Big, colorful bricks are fun and safe for little hands, and make for easy building. Includes train engine and car, engineer and baby elephant figures. Compatible with all LEGO DUPLO trains, tracks and accessories!

3771-1.desc: Here's everything a little builder needs for their very first train set! With a motorized passenger train, lots of track and scenery, hours of fun await! Take the train off the tracks and it stops running, so it's safe for little builders. Includes motorized engine, fueling station, train car, station, traffic signals and complete track, plus engineer, passenger and cow. Requires 3 AA (1.5V) batteries, not included. Includes track layout suggestions and colorful inspirational photos. Compatible with all LEGO DUPLO trains and accessories.

3772-1.desc: Young "engineers" will find everything they need for a great train layout in this special set! With all of these great railroad elements, little builders can create their very own bustling frieght yard! Use the cargo crane to load up, and fill the engine at the fueling pump before riding the rails to the station. Motorized engine really runs! Take the train off the tracks and it stops running, so it's safe for little builders. Includes motorized freight train with two wagons, loading station, crane, small warehouse, traffic signals and complete track, plus engineer and two worker figures. Track includes switching rail to change train direction! Requires 3 AA (1.5V) batteries, not included. Includes track layout suggestions and colorful inspirational photos. Compatible with all LEGO DUPLO trains and accessories.

3773-1.desc: This level crossing makes a great addition to your child's first train set! Raise the bars up and down just like at a real crossing. Includes track and train crossing sign. Compatible with all LEGO DUPLO trains and accessories.

3774-1.desc:
Add a bridge to your DUPLO train set!
Add another level to your DUPLO train layout! This bright, sturdy bridge features red guard rails and pillars, and measures over 3 feet (91.5 cm) long!
Compatible with all LEGO DUPLO trains and accessories.

3775-1.desc:
Keep train traffic on the move!
Keep your LEGO® DUPLO® trains on their way to their destinations with this set of switching tracks! Move the big red lever to switch your train's direction.
Includes one left side and one right side switch.
Compatible with all LEGO DUPLO trains and accessories.

4271174-1.desc: Carry R2-D2 with you wherever you go and let the ultimate astromech droid help you write your letters and do your homework! This great new pen features a clip so you can attach it to your belt or your backpack.

4277613-1.desc: It's not just a LEGO minifigure head…it's a LEGO egg timer! Just twist the top to set the timer to ring after anything from a minute to an hour. Ticks off the seconds and rings when done! Timer is decorated with three minifigure faces -- set the timer to swap eyes and mouths! Counts minutes up to an hour, just turn the timer to 60 before winding it up!

4277645-1.desc: These ice bricks are so cool, they're freezing! Pour yourself a glass of juice and make it nice and cold with these faboulous, LEGO ice bricks!

4659-1.desc: The garbage man has an important job to do. Can you help him keep the city clean? Includes a garbage man, garbage truck, trash cans, and much more.

4665-1.desc: There's always something exciting to do on the Big Farm! You can help the farmer and his wife gather the crops and feed the animals. You can even drive the tractor! This colorful set includes a barn, lots of barnyard animals, the farmer, his wife and their child, a tractor, and everything else you need for farm fun!

4768-1.desc:
A magical ship emerges from the lake by Hogwarts™ castle! Professor Karkaroff is here, and he's brought Viktor Krum, Harry Potter's newest rival in the Triwizard Tournament. Climb aboard the Durmstrang ship and discover its hidden traps and treasures! With removable decks, an opening cabin and more, this wizard's ship is full of surprises from the top of its crow's nest to the tip of its anchor!
• Includes Professor Karkaroff and Viktor Krum minifigures.
• Ship's cabin opens to reveal more surprises!
• Drop the anchor and go ashore!
• Table opens to reveal tools!
• Ship measures over 21 inches (53cm) high and over 20 inches (51cm) long!
• Press the plank to launch a mini-figure into the lake!

4779-1.desc: Can the heroic knight defend his tower against the evil Dragon Knight in his siege tower? Defense tower and siege tower are easy for young builders to constuct. Includes noble knight and dragon knight.

4820-1.desc: This magical royal palace has everything a princess has ever dreamed of. Climb the tall towers and waltz through the banquet hall. Does the clock say it's time for bed? Let's take one more ride on the merry-go-round instead! Set includes many accessories, a prince and two princess dolls with hair that can be brushed!

5524-1.desc: Build the complete travel experience on a micro-scale with the LEGO Factory Airport! This amazing airport includes all of the micro-travel necessities! Learn how to create this communications tower, passenger terminal, landing strip and jet plane, plus build your very own airport 5-star hotel! With a variety of great LEGO elements, this set makes a wonderful introduction to the world of micro-building or a great addition to any LEGO collection! Features the contest-winning designs of LEGO fan builders Neal McClatshey and Philip Hedleskey. Download the 2D and 3D building instructions at www.LEGOFactory.com! Get Building instructions now! Please note that you will need to download building instructions for this model. Building instructions are available in printable PDF format or in LEGO Digital Designer 3D interactive format.
tags: Lego Factory and Lego Design Byme

5525-1.desc: Discover the fun of micro-building by creating four different awesome attractions at the Amusement Park! This colorful and detailed set includes a swashbuckling pirate ship, a racecar speedway, an alpine ski slope and the incredible Robo Destroyer, plus a multitude of micro-people! Build all four at once or use your own imagination to create even more micro-attractions! Features the contest-winning designs of LEGO fan builders Neal McClatshey, Glenn Nissen and Michael Cozine. Download the 2D and 3D building instructions at www.LEGOFactory.com! Get Building instructions now! Please note that you will need to download building instructions for this model. Building instructions are available in printable PDF format or in LEGO Digital Designer 3D interactive format.
tags: Lego Factory and Lego Design Byme
Lego Factory and Lego Design Byme

5552-1.desc: James the Red Engine has a full load of cargo today to bring to Knapford Station! Switch the rails to help him get to his destination right away. Includes: James Coal Car Signal 2 straight tracks, 1 curved track and 1 switch track Switch rails to change direction! Set is compatible with the complete LEGO DUPLO system!

5554-1.desc: Thomas has a big job to do today! Load him up at the cargo tower, then send him on his way to Tidmouth Station. Includes cargo tower with slide so you can open it to drop cargo. Also features full track that measures 23" x 35"/60 x 90cm, train signal and station. Hours of fun for Thomas the Train fans! Over 7 feet/2 meters of running track! Includes 16 curved track pieces! Set is compatible with the complete LEGO DUPLO system!

5555-1.desc: Toby the Train Engine is always happy to work. Today he is at Wellsworth Station looking for something new to do. Can you help him find a job that needs doing? Build and rebuild Toby for new adventures! Includes 2 straight tracks. Set is compatible with the complete LEGO DUPLO system!

5961-1.desc:
The magical Snow Queen is riding through a wintry landscape in her horse-drawn sleigh. It's time for fairytale fun!
Iceberg features a miniature ice castle and enchanted snowflake.
Ice skates fit on Snow Queen figure and rabbit.
Includes Snow Queen, winged horse and rabbit.

5963-1.desc: The princess needs a place to sleep. There's a beautiful bed with lots of mattresses, but the little pea beneath them is sure to keep her up all night! Recreate the classic story with this special set. Includes the princess, the pea, a cute puppy and more.

7235-1.desc:
Patrol the streets of LEGO® City!
Help keep the streets of LEGO® City safe! The police officer travels around on his motorcycle, keeping an eye out for crooks, speeders and people in trouble. What will be his next adventure?
Includes police officer minifigure.

7236-1.desc: The police car is on patrol, keeping the city streets safe! The police officer has his radar gun to watch for speeders. When he spots one, he takes off in his super-fast police car and tracks the driver down! Includes police officer minifigure.

7237-1.desc: The police station is the place to go for LEGO City adventure! The brave officers are ready to fight crime with their police helicopter, van, and cycle. Launch the copter from the heliport, then bring the crook back to jail. Monitor the city from the control room and send out the police at the first sign of trouble! Move the heliport platform so the helicopter can take off and land. Features police helicopter, van & cycle. Includes 5 officers, 2 robbers & 2 police dogs.

7238-1.desc: Jump into the fire helicopter and save LEGO City! When you spot a fire, use the twin water cannons to put it out. Open the cockpit to put the pilot inside. Save the day and be a hero! Rotors spin just like a real helicopter. Includes pilot minifigure.

7239-1.desc: Race to the fire in the fire truck!

7241-1.desc: Get to the scene of the fire first in your fast fire car! You're the fire chief, ready to lead a team of firefighters as they battle the blaze. Includes fire chief mini-figure.

7242-1.desc: Every morning,the Street Sweeper is on the job making sure the avenues of LEGO City are sparkling clean! Raise the hatch to put the driver inside, then roll it down the streets of your LEGO Town to keep them looking neat. Includes driver.

7243-1.desc: It's another busy day at the construction site! The crane rig is lifting rock and soil and putting it in the dump truck, while the conveyor belt carries stone to be ground up into gravel. When the job is done, there will be a new building in LEGO City. Set includes 3 pieces of construction machinery and 3 operators for hours of building fun. Tip the bucket to unload the dump truck. Use the winch to help the crane raise and lower heavy loads.

7245-1.desc: There's no escape from the prisoner transport! Once the police officer captures the crook, he puts him behind bars in this heavily armored van and takes him to jail. LEGO® City is safe once more! Includes police officer & crook Open the back of the van to put the prisoner inside.

7246-1.desc: Another building is being constructed in LEGO City, and it's your job to help make it happen! Use the mini digger to get the job done. Raise and lower the shovel. Includes construction worker with tools.

7248-1.desc: Every construction site needs a heavy duty digger to help get the work done. This mean machine is ready to scoop up your LEGO bricks and clear the way for new construction. Includes driver with jackhammer and other accessories.

7249-1.desc: Construction jobs are easy when you have the Mobile Crane on your team! This detailed vehicle is fun to build and fun to play with, as you help your LEGO City to grow! Raise and lower the crane arm and then use the winch to lift construction materials and other loads. Over 15 inches (38 cm) long! Includes 2 crane operators and accessories.

tags: Death Star II Mobile Battle Station

7280-1.desc:
Add roads to your LEGO® town!
Expand your LEGO® town with this set of straight and crossroad plates. Includes one straight plate and one cross plate.
Each plate measures 10" (25cm) by 10" (25cm) or 32 studs by 32 studs.

7281-1.desc:
Roads for your LEGO® layout!
Add a T-junction and curved roads to your LEGO® town with this set of building plates. Includes one T-junction plate and one curved road plate.
Each plate measures 10" (25cm) by 10" (25cm) or 32 studs by 32 studs.

7843-1.desc: The DUPLO Plane is getting ready for takeoff! Once the crewman finishes fueling up and loading the cargo, the pilot can get started on his next adventure! Radio the control tower and taxi down the runway! Includes pilot and crewman figures, plus fuel cart, cargo and more!

8415-1.desc:
Build a hard-working dump truck to transport bricks around the constuction site. This six-wheeled powerhouse is tough enough to take on any job in your LEGO town.
• Turn knobs to steer and tip the bucket for unloading.
• Includes step by step building instructions for alternate street sweeper model.

8416-1.desc:
This detailed replica of a forklift is packed with powerful functions! Steer it where you want to go, then use the lever to alter the pitch of the forks so you can pick up the pallet. The telescoping lift can rise to twice its original height as it carries the load. A great building experience for LEGO fans!
• Authentic model for skilled builders!
• Includes pallet!
• Lift rises to over 14 inches/35 cm!
• Includes instructions to rebuild into a Forest Truck with functioning grapple hook!

8418-1.desc:
Ready to tackle the toughest jobs on the construction site. A great addition to any LEGO TECHNIC collection!
• Raise the bucket to load bricks, then lower it to go back for more.
• Includes step by step building instructions for alternate construction vehicle model.

8419-1.desc:
Construct your own authentic looking and functioning excavator, complete with cool crawler tracks and a cab that really rotates. Make it a part of your construction crew!
• Turn the knobs to control the excavator arm and bucket.
• Includes step by step instructions to make a track-type tractor alternative model.

8420-1.desc:
A stunning spectacle of style and speed, the street bike features a mono-swing arm, 2 new designer wheels, a 4-cylinder engine and adjustable rear suspension. Take it apart and rebuild it into a custom chopper! Build it, display it, or stage your own street bike race!
• Authentic model for skilled builders!
• Includes kickstand for display!
• Includes instructions for rebuilding into custom chopper!
• Measures 7 inches/17.78 cm high by 10 inches/25.4 cm long!
• Chain drive moves pistons in V4 engine!

8421-1.desc:
The Mobile Crane towers above the construction site! This huge, detailed set features six-wheel steering, a telescoping boom that extends to twice its original length, pneumatic cylinders to raise and lower the boom, four retractable outriggers, motor and battery box. Authentic model for skilled builders!
• Includes motor and battery box to extend arm and lower hook!
• Measures over 18 inches/46 cm long!
• Pneumatic cylinder and air pump lift crane arm - release air pressure to lower boom.
• Arm extends over 25 inches/64 cm long!
• Boom rotates a full 360 degrees!
• Includes instructions to rebuild into an Aerial Lift!
• Realistic 6-wheel steering! Wheels drive pistons in V6 engine!
• Requires 6 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included.

851091-1.desc:
The coolest keyring in the galaxy!
R2-D2™ is here to make sure your keys stay safe! A great gift for LEGO® Star Wars™ fans!

851499-1.desc:
Play an exciting game of chess with real LEGO Knights! Choose your color and you're ready to begin. Will you checkmate your opponent's king and win, or will you go down in defeat? It's a game of skill and strategy that's fun for chess fans and LEGO fans too!
Includes full-size chess board (measures 10 x 10 inches/ 25.4 x 25.4 cm) with sturdy storage case featuring leather handle & bindings and snap closure.
Chess board is held inside carrying case with touch fasteners -- play at home or on the go!
Total of 32 chess pieces, including 24 minifigures! Storage case includes compartments to hold them all!

8641-1.desc:
A chrome engine and twin exhausts spitting flames make this racer a winner on the track!
Combine with #8642 Monster Crusher to build an orange and red, eight-wheeled monster truck.
• Each Tiny Turbo comes in a “garage” with a tire top – store racers in their garage once they’re built!
• Includes building instructions for monster truck combination model.

8642-1.desc:
This tough off-roader features an aerodynamic cockpit and big chunky wheels for racing across the toughest terrain. Combine with #8641 Flame Glider to build an eight-wheeled monster truck with awesome engine.
• Each Tiny Turbo comes in a “garage” with a tire top – store racers in their garage once they’re built!
• Includes building instructions for monster truck combination model.

8643-1.desc:
This dark, mysterious mean machine is ready for hot street action. Check out the chrome front grill, huge engine, chrome rims and wicked flame decoration! Combine with #8644 Street Maniac to build a truck with eight low profile tires and rooftop spoilers.
• Each Tiny Turbo comes in a “garage” with a tire top – store racers in their garage once they’re built!
• Includes building instructions for power truck combination model.

8644-1.desc:
With its low aerodynamic front and cockpit, big spoiler on the back and huge engine, the Street Maniac is one sight no other racer wanted to see on the track! Combine with #8643 Power Cruiser to build a power truck.
• Each Tiny Turbo comes in a “garage” with a tire top – store racers in their garage once they’re built!
• Includes building instructions for power truck combination model.

8645-1.desc:
Have you got what it takes to control the ultimate slammer bike? Flames from the exhaust, glow in the dark tire discs and headlights make this a super hot speed demon!
• Includes slammer for high speed action!
• Includes glow-in-the-dark pieces!

8646-1.desc:
This wicked slammer bike is built for speed, speed, and more speed! Race it to the limit and leave the competition in your dust. Glow in the dark tire discs and headlights are great for night racing.
• Includes slammer for high speed action!
• Combine with #8645 Muscle Slammer Bike to build an powerful hotrod.
• Includes building instructions for hotrod combination model.

8647-1.desc:
The Night Racer fears nothing, not even the toughest tracks in total darkness. A powerful pull-back motor plus glow-in-the-dark tire discs and headlights help this sleek machine cross the finish line!
• New glow-in-the-dark tire discs!
• Pull-back motor

8648-1.desc:
A heavy duty pull-back motor, two "buzz saws" and mega tires with glow in the dark discs help this off-roader cut its way through any terrain.
• Combine with #8647 Night Racer to build a dual-engine truck.
• Includes building instructions for monster truck combination model

8649-1.desc:
A gigantic oversized engine, lots of dazzling chrome and sizzling hot decals make the Nitro Menace look like the fastest LEGO Racer ever -- even when it's parked! A detailed, exciting addition to any racer collection.
• Includes steering function.
• Measures a full 14 inches/36 cm long.

8650-1.desc:
This high speed, slammer-powered racer features glow in the dark headlights for night racing! Send it flying down the track and watch it take the checkered flag.
• Includes slammer for high speed action!
• Rebuild the Furious Slammer Racer into an awesome truck for street racing. Building instructions included for this alternate model.

8651-1.desc: This tough monster truck is made for all-terrain indoor action. With oversized tires, pull-back racing action and mega-detailing, there's no road too rough for it to conquer! Pull-back motor!

8652-1.desc:
Build your own 1:17 replica of the famous Enzo Ferrari, one of the fastest street cars in the world. Introduced in 2002, the Enzo Ferrari, named after the founder of the Ferrari empire, uses many of the awesome design elements of a Formula 1 race car. Put it on display or race it against your friends. A must-have set for any racing fan!
• Detailed and accurate recreation of the famous street car.
• Take apart the Enzo Ferrari and rebuild it as a fabulous F333 SP Racer.
• Open the hood to reveal the Ferrari engine inside!
• A full 10 inches/26 centimeters long!
• Also includes building instructions for an F333 SP Racer (Scale 1:16) too

8653-1.desc:
This authentic, detailed replica of the Enzo Ferrari in 1:10 scale is yours to build! A great addition to the collection of any LEGO fan or racing enthusiast, it captures the sleek look of the supercar of the 21st century.
• Doors open
• Raise the hood to see the V12 engine
• Steering really works
• Measures over 18 inches/45cm long and over 9 inches wide!

8654-1.desc: Build an authentic replica of the Scuderia Ferrari Truck and join the Ferrari F1 racing team as they get ready for the Grand Prix! Open the truck to reveal all the equipment the team needs to do its job, plus parts to build a Ferrari racer. When you're done, pack the gear up and head off for the next racetrack and the next victory! Measures over 16 inches/40cm long and 3.4 inches wide. Includes 6 Ferrari F1 racing team minifigures.

8655-1.desc:
This sleek and stylish mini rally car is ready to race! Attach the spoiler for high speed control and challenge your friends.
• Combine with #8658 Big Bling Wheelie to make an 8-wheeled muscle machine (building instructions included).
• Includes garage-shaped carrying case.

8656-1.desc:
Put the pedal to the metal with this super-slick mini 6-wheeler! With its chrome engine and awesome detailing, the F6 Truck rules the road.
• Combine with #8657 ATR 4 to build a 10-wheeled racing machine (building instructions included)!
• Includes garage-shaped carrying case.

8657-1.desc:
When the going gets hot, the mini ATR 4 always keeps its cool! With rugged multi-terrain tires and a spoiler for speed, this 4x4 is going places fast.
• Combine with #8656 F6 Truck to build a 10-wheeled racing machine (building instructions included).
• Includes garage-shaped carrying case.

8658-1.desc:
This is one mean mini off-roader! With its styling chrome grill, turbo engine and racing rims, the Big Bling Wheelie leaves rivals eating its dust.
• Combine it with 8655 RX-Sprinter to make an 8-wheeled muscle machine (building instructions included)!
• Includes garage-shaped carrying case.

8736-1.desc: The six Toa Metru returned to the city of Metru Nui, intending to save the sleeping Matoran and bring them to their new home. Ambushed by Visorak spiders, the Toa Metru are mutated into Hordika ... half Toa, half beast! Can they overcome their new enemies and their own bestial natures in time to rescue the Matoran? Toa Hordika Vakama fights to lead his team of Toa on the most dangerous mission of their lives, while trying to contain the beast within himself! His Rhotuka fire spinner can burn through any obstacle, and his blazer claws can charge it up to even greater power. New feature! Pull the ripcord to send the Rhotuka spinner flying! Includes instructions to build a Rahi cable crawler with #8736 and #8738!

8791-1.desc: A brave hero, the Knight of the Wolf is the wisest warrior in all the land. His skill and raw power mean Sir Danju can turn the tide of any battle! Includes new armor, sword and shield. Defeats any foe using his new Alendan Twist-Slash action maneuver! Stands over 7.5 inches/19 cm high!

8877-1.desc:
Seize the Dark Fortress and save the Kingdom!
The biggest LEGO Castle set ever! The Knights of Morcia must lower the drawbridge and capture the Dark Fortress. If they fail, Lord Vladek will conquer all of Morcia! The Knights have courage, skill, and horse-mounted and horse-drawn catapults on their side. But the Dark Fortress is protected by two fireball catapults! Even if they get past them, they must still face Lord Vladek and knock down his Vlad-Mask to end his reign. Who will win? You decide!
Launch fireballs and stones as the two sides clash!
Dump the cauldron of fire on invaders.
Includes 9 minifigures - Sir Danju, Sir Santis, Sir Rascus, Sir Jayko, Lord Vladek, skeleton and 3 Shadow Knights.
Shadow Knights' armor and Vlad-Mask are metallic-colored!
Includes horse-mounted catapult, horse-drawn catapult and mobile blunt shooter!

9247-1.desc: Every town needs police, fire, and rescue workers, plus crossing guards, bakers, mechanics and more. Includes over 31 minifigures from all different occupations Features an assortment of helmets, 3 bicycles, 4 trikes, and a variety of accessories so you can customize your minifigures however you like.

9544-1.desc: Build LEGO® Maths Machines and use them to investigate mathematical concepts, such as number facts, measurements and data handling. There are 8 mathematical machines to build and 24 activities to practice basic maths and problem solving skills, delivered in a sturdy plastic box.

tags: Lego Star Wars The Video Game
Lego Star Wars The Video Game

K2226-1.desc: The bedcover features a full-coloured image of the 3 lovely CLIKITS girls: Heart, Daisy and Star. The Pillow Case features the stylish CLIKITS symbol. The bedcover (140cm x 200cm) and pillow case (75cm x 50cm) are 100% cotton and are machine washable at 40'ºC. A very cool and stylish gift for any LEGO fan!

tags: Lego Star Wars The Video Game
Lego Star Wars The Video Game

10106-1.desc:
This special holiday ornament features over 30 transparent pieces and a hanger for attaching string or ribbon. Add it to your LEGO holiday collection today!
• Includes special hanger brick for displaying ornament!
• Snowflake measure 9" x 9"!
• Design your own unique snowflake in LEGO Factory!

10174-1.desc:
The Imperial AT-ST (All Terrain Scout Transport), also known as the Scout Walker, carries the Empire's forces swiftly and efficiently across the ice plains of Hoth and through the dense forests of Endor. Now you can build the ultimate collector's model of this famous Star Wars vehicle from over a thousand LEGO pieces!
Fully armed and armor-plated, the incredibly detailed and realistic AT-ST stands over 16.5" (42cm) tall!
Features rotating weapons, an opening pilot hatch, moving window panels, and more!
Enemies of the Empire beware!

10175-1.desc: Rebels beware! The TIE Advanced x1 is Darth Vader's personal starfighter, heavily modified and customized by the Dark Lord of the Sith himself. With its enlarged, angular wings, extended ion engine block and reinforced hull, Vader's TIE can withstand -- and deliver -- far more punishment than any ordinary TIE fighter. Now you can add this incredible model to your LEGO Star Wars collection! The Ultimate Collector Series Vader's TIE Advanced is packed with realistic details straight from Star Wars: Episode IV, A New Hope, from the unique wings and body shape to the cockpit compartment and twin laser cannons. Includes special display stand and collector's card with detailed specifications.

10176-1.desc:
Inspired by the legendary #6090 Royal King's Castle, the all-new Royal King's Castle rises majestically over the kingdom. From the royal throne room to the wizard's magical laboratory, this is one of the biggest and best LEGO Castles ever! Discover the hidden treasure chest and protect the castle from attackers with catapults and traps…but make sure they don't find the secret entrance! !
Includes king, royal knight, crossbow knight, 2 castle guards, wizard, blacksmith, 2 skeletons, evil knight and squire!
Even the king's faithful dog and a glow-in-the-dark ghost to haunt the castle!
Raise and lower the drawbridge!
Defend the gate with swinging halberds, guard the dungeon and help the blacksmith in his workshop!

10177-1.desc: The newest and most revolutionary aircraft in the legendary Boeing fleet, the 787 Dreamliner is designed for ultimate in air travel, and now it can be yours in this exclusive collector's model! With authentic colors, scale and details, the LEGO Boeing 787 Dreamliner is just like the real thing! The Dreamliner features a display stand and display card listing the real aircraft's specifications and details. Overall length is 26" (66cm) and wingspan is 27" (69 cm)! Includes collector's display stand and display card with detailed specifications for the real aircraft! A LEGO exclusive, based on exact specifications from Boeing Commercial Airplanes for the ultimate in scale, details and authenticity!

2159-1.desc: This set includes a complete oval 9v train track, plus 6 train car connector magnets! Includes 16 Curved Rails for 9v Trains and 2 Straight Rails for 9v Trains. This track is also compatible with LEGO RC Trains.

2598-1.desc: Give your little builders a bright, safe surface for their LEGO® DUPLO® creations!
