This durable plate is compatible with all DUPLO bricks and elements; providing your child with a solid creative foundation to build on. Plate measures 24 x 24 studs. Rounded corners make plate safe for carrying!

3299-1.desc: Visit Bob in his fun new workshop in the Sunflower Valley! It has all the tools he needs, a buzz saw and a drill that really move! Dizzy and Scrambler are ready to help get the job done by transporting all of the materials Bob needs! Includes Bob, Dizzy and Scrambler, tools and more! Create your own Bob the Builder stories!

3301-1.desc: It's a busy day at the docks for Cranky! Help him use his strong hook & pulley to load cargo into the Troublesome Truck. Little builders will have lots of fun incorporating this big, bright crane into their Thomas & Friends adventures! Cranky moves from side to side! Move the pulley up and down! Includes 2 tracks, a troublesome truck, and 2 pieces of cargo!

3568-1.desc:
Improve your soccer skills with this new set, by aiming for the target grid in front of the goal. Kick it in the top box for 10 points and watch it go right over the goalie’s head. Or shoot low, to the left or right for 5 points, so the ball is just out of the goalie’s reach. Keep practicing and soon you won’t need the grid anymore because your shot will be so precise! Set includes target grid, goal, an adidas™ soccer ball, a goalie and a kicker, plus stickers for their uniforms!
Includes stickers for the players' uniforms!
Move the goalie from side-to-side!
Press down on the circle the make the player shoot!

3569-1.desc:
It’s the blue team against the red team in this exciting game of soccer. The huge stadium measures over 22 inches (55 cm) long and over 14 inches (35 cm) wide, making plenty of room for a very large crowd! The spotlights are aimed down onto the field and the scoreboards show a score of 0-0. Suddenly the red team has the ball, the center takes a hard shot to the left, the goalie dives right, and the red team scores!! This should be a good game!
Stadium measures over 22 inches (55 cm) long and over 14 inches (35 cm) wide!
Includes 6 red players, 6 blue players, 2 spectators, 1 adidas™ soccer ball and 2 standard LEGO footballs!
Also includes adidas, Philips, and LEGO stickers for the stadium side boards and stickers for the players’ uniforms.
Goalies and defenders move side-to-side!

3825-1.desc: Join SpongeBob, Squidward, Mr. Krabs and Plankton in a Krabby Patty adventure at the Krusty Krab restaurant! Push down on the lever to flip the Krabby Patties and let SpongeBob know there's an order up! When it's time for closing, help SpongeBob clean up by tossing the trash in the dumpster. Then, place the money in the safe and be sure to hide the Krabby Patty secret formula so Plankton doesn't find it! Just another day at Bikini Bottom's premier fast food restaurant! Set includes SpongeBob, Squidward, Mr. Krabs and Plankton minifigures. Even includes Krabby Patties and more! SpongeBob comic strip on the box!

3826-1.desc: Just when you thought things couldn't get any wackier in Bikini Bottom…Plankton has taken over SpongeBob's brain and is making him do some wild things! Plankton can make SpongeBob spin his eyes, shoot jellyfish from his mouth, and change SpongeBob's expression from a frown to a smile. Set includes Plankton minifigure, jellyfish to shoot and much more! SpongeBob measures over 11.5 inches (29.2 cm) tall! Includes SpongeBob comic strip on the box!

3827-1.desc: Dive into the neighborhood and check out SpongeBob's pineapple...Squidward's Tiki house...and Patrick's humble rock. Discover a whole treasure of activities in Bikini Bottom - like hoops in the pineapple, and the jellyfish launch, great for creating your own jellyfishing adventures! Includes SpongeBob, Squidward, Patrick, and Gary minifigures, plus plenty of jellyfish! Also includes Patrick's motor boat with a pull-back motor!

4227952-1.desc: Hang a favorite photo or card on the fridge (or any other metal surface) in LEGO style! Set includes 14 magnetic 2 x 4 bricks in different colors.

4293150-1.desc: Take your Dino 2010 action to the beach with this special sand mould dino set!

4293263-1.desc: Take over the island of Voya Nui -- or fight to save it -- with this new BIONICLE Piraka zamor launcher. Fun and safe for play!

4293771-1.desc: Now you can fight fire just like the LEGO firemen! Just fill up your water tank, pump the shooter, and start blasting! Be a firefighting hero with the NEW City Water Blaster!

4293816-1.desc: Have your eye on a certain LEGO set? Start saving your change now in this fantastic LEGO brick shaped, ceramic coin bank, and before you know it, you'll have enough saved to get it. Coin bank measures 8cm long, 16.5 cm high and 6cm deep.

4294192-1.desc: Personalise your keyring with this LEGO keyring name kit. Whether you spell your name, your favorite sports team, or a secret code, there will be no mistaking your keys for anyone else's!

4294199-1.desc: Show the world you're a real football fan with this great keyring, featuring a German football player mini-figure!

4329943-1.desc: Show the world you're a LEGO fan -- carry your lunch in this great LEGO lunchbox! Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

4415-1.desc: Finally! Super fast vehicles that can keep up with you! This new Auto Pod is made for the LEGO fan who is always on the move. Packed inside this pod are pieces and building instructions for three different models! Build a race car, a truck or a rolling monster…it's your choice! Put it in your pocket and build anywhere! Includes building instructions for all 3 vehicles! Quick to build and rebuild for hours of fun! Combine them all to make cool combo models! Handy carry case with studs, so you can build it right into your models! Unique assortment of hard to find LEGO elements! Fits into backpacks, pockets and more for on-the-go play!

4416-1.desc: Brush up on your robot building skills whenever, wherever! Build a rolling monster or two different robots, one model at a time -- there are building instructions for all three packed inside your pod! Put it in your pocket and build anywhere! Includes building instructions for all 3 robots! Quick to build and rebuild for hours of fun! Combine them all to make cool combo models! Handy carry case with studs, so you can build it right into your models! Unique assortment of hard to find LEGO elements! Fits into backpacks, pockets and more for on-the-go play!

4493777-1.desc: Make it a magical day with this new Wizard keyring!

4493780-1.desc: Let the Dark Knight guard your locker or refrigerator from his arch-foes with these great minifigure magnets. Includes Batman, Two-Face, and The Penguin.

4493781-1.desc: Collect all the LEGO Batman magnets! This set includes The Joker, Catwoman, and Robin minifigure magnets.

4493785-1.desc: Protect yourself in 'battle' with the shield of the Vikings!

4494410-1.desc: The Dark Knight strikes again with this amazing new cap, featuring the Bat symbol and an image of the LEGO Batman minifigure. Sure to be a collector's item!

4494709-1.desc: You'll never lose another LEGO piece again, no matter how small it is because this toolbox storage box is sure to keep you organised. Place the small, easy to misplace pieces in the separate compartments on top and the larger pieces in the bottom compartment. Measures 23cm high, 30cm wide and 23cm deep.

4496-3.desc: Our newly redesigned tub features lots of great new elements, including translucent bricks and 2 minifigures! Also includes Idea Book with building instructions for 5 models and inspiration for 50 more!

4499563-1.desc: Let them know there's LEGO fun in store this Christmas! This festive wrapping paper features images of the LEGO Santa Claus minifigure and a snow-covered LEGO tree on a background of drifting snowflakes. Each pack includes two wrapping sheets measuring 70 x 100 cm each and 2 gift tags!

4499574-1.desc: Add a whole new level of fun to Tic Tac Toe with this great LEGO game set! Includes studded baseplate and 10 LEGO minifigures to mark your moves. May the best minifig win!

4500744-1.desc: Lots of fun with this LEGO version of the classical Ludo game. Which figure will you be - construction worker, policeman or racing driver? Will you roll a six and be able to move your figure onto the game? Or will your opponent catch up with you and send your figure home? The luckiest roller will win! Set includes 4 orange construction workers, 4 blue construction workers, 4 policemen and 4 racing drivers.

4505956-1.desc: Now even the smallest builders can go to sleep dreaming of their next big creations. This junior duvet set features animals from the popular DUPLO zoo. The duvet cover (120cm x 150cm) and pillowcase (40cm x 60cm) are 100% cotton and machine washable at 40'ºC.

4507042-1.desc: This cool EXO-FORCE watch will show you if it is time to fight the Robots of Sentai Mountain! The watch comes with a comfortable elastic strap that stretches to fit your wrist. Watch face measures 2.5cm in diameter. The watch strap can be removed and swapped with any other LEGO watch strap. Includes 2 bezels: Red and Grey. Battery included.

4891-1.desc:
This new set is crammed full of pieces that make up 6 different super cool vehicles! Build a car transporter and two cars at the same time, or build a dune buggy, a dump truck, or a race car! That's 6 different vehicles and there's building instructions for all 6 in just 1 box!
Includes building instuctions for all 6 vehicles!
Build the car transporter and two cars at the same time!
Transporter measures over 8 inches (20.3 cm) long!

4892-1.desc: Years ago, dinosaurs roamed the earth and this is your chance to bring them back! This new set has enough prehistoric pieces inside to build at least 8 different dinosaurs, one at a time! Build a Triceratops, a Stegosaurus, and more. Or, build and discover your own dinosaur! Includes building instructions for all 8 dinosaurs! Triceratops measures 12 inches (30.5 cm) long!

4893-1.desc:
Build a street bike and dirt bike at the same time. and stage your own motorbike race! Each Revvin' Rider looks just like the real thing, from the body details to the suspension.
* Includes building instructions for 8 models!
* Build the street bike and dirt bike models at the same time!
* Includes a special sound brick for a real roaring engine sound!

4895-1.desc: Build a motor-powered helicopter with a 17" (43cm) spinning propeller and missiles that really shoot! Rebuild into a missile-firing spider that really crawls or a bumper car that automatically changes direction when it hits an obstacle! Includes 2 Idea Books with building instructions for all 3 models, plus inspiration for additional models.

4896-1.desc: Get noticed on the road in this hot convertible sports car! Lean the seats back for comfort, open the doors to check out the interior, and pop the hood to show off the cool engine. Then, re-build your roadster into a drag racer or a jeep! Features awesome red and chrome-colored details! Roadster measures over 1 foot (30.4 cm) long! Includes instructions for 3 models! Seats recline and doors open! Raise the hood to view the engine!

4960-1.desc: Enter the gate of the LEGO Ville Giant Zoo and prepare to be amazed. Observe all of your favorite animals in their own special areas. You'll find penguins and polar bears chilling out in the arctic section, monkeys hanging around in the jungle, lions lounging in the caves, and zebras, giraffes and elephants eating the grass and leaves and tending to their young. Set includes bananas, carrots, fences, a zoo keeper, 4 zoo visitors, and 14 animals!

4961-1.desc: The sign is up and your zoo is officially open! Now it's time to play with all of your favorite animals! Watch the monkeys go bananas as they swing on their rope swing and slide down their slide. Give them bananas and watch them do tricks! Visit the crocodile in his watery croc pit, but careful not to get too close! Then, look over the fence to watch the zebra eating the grass. There's always something to do at the Fun Zoo! Includes 2 monkeys, 1 crocodile and 1 zebra! Includes a banana bunch! Build the zoo however you want!

4962-1.desc:
Baby animals have arrived!
The friendly zoo keeper has lots to do as she nurses the young animals at the Baby Zoo. Learn all about giraffes, polar bears, elephants and lion cubs by helping the zoo keeper take good care of these adorable baby animals!
Includes animals, zoo keeper, and large building bricks

4963-1.desc: Patrol the highway in your super speedy police car. If someone breaks the law, turn on your lights and siren and pull them over. Use your cone and guard fence to keep you safe on the side of the highway. And, put up your police sign to let everyone know that it's official business! Includes police man

4964-1.desc: A sports car is broken down on the highway! Switch on the warning lights in your tow truck and rush to the rescue. When you arrive at the scene, don't forget to put up the yield sign to warn other drivers to pass with caution. Then, use the tools to fix the sports car right on the highway, or hook it to your truck and tow it to the shop. You've saved the day! Includes 2 minifigures! Also includes yield sign, tools, tow truck and sports car!

4965-1.desc:
The police are here to save the day! Run, drive and fly into action with this fully-equipped DUPLO police station.
Includes prison cell, helicopter, landing pad, escape motorbike, police car and more!
Police car features light and sound!
Easy construction for younger builders!

4966-1.desc: Even the littlest members of the family can play house with this colorful, easy to build set. With a family car, pet cat, special elements and lots of exciting features, this three-story house is home to plenty of possibilities! Cook in the kitchen, relax on the terrace or sit down at the table for a meal with the family. Includes mother, father and 2 child figures! Includes fully assembled family car! Features special elements like a fish tank brick and milk carton brick!

4967-1.desc: This big helicopter is equipped with a water cannon and working winch, so the brave firefighters can put out the fire and stay out of the heat! The pilot keeps the propeller spinning and the copter steady, as the firefighter uses the water cannon to put out the fire! For a job this big, teamwork is necessary! Set includes pilot and firefighter! Spin the propellers and move the winch up and down! Open the cockpit to place the pilot inside!

4968-1.desc: The two zoo keepers have their hands full taking care of all of the animals at the zoo, and they sure could use a helper like you! Set up the cave for the lion and lioness and give them some room to run around. Then, build a house for the panda to keep him safe and sound. Use the shovel to dig a pit, so the crocodile has somewhere to swim. Then, check on mommy and baby elephant, the giraffe, and the zebra to make sure they've all been fed. Finally, open the zoo gates to let the visitors in! Set includes 2 zoo keepers, 8 animals, zoo building, and plenty of trees and plants. Inspirational building ideas right on the box!

4969-1.desc: This awesome tractor makes your farm work fun and easy. Transport the crops on the back of your tractor and drop them off along the way. Before you know it, your work will be done and it'll be time to play. Set includes boy and brick with plant.

4971-1.desc: Help the zoo keepers deliver food and supplies faster in their special zoo vehicles. Use the tractor to pull the trailer and take the mummy cheetah to see her new baby. Then, use the special zebra camouflaged truck to deliver food and supplies to the new baby cheetah and panther. Set includes 2 zoo keepers and 3 animals! Also includes 2 zoo vehicles, with cargo to load on the back.

5476-1.desc: An exciting collection of bricks for the youngest member of the family, including the very first QUATRO car.

5477-1.desc: Younger builders will love building their first LEGO house! Design a summer cottage, apartment building, family home, or invent a new and unique building! Set includes flowers, trees, windows, doors, roof tiles & lots of other great elements! Use container for easy clean up and storage!

6205-1.desc: The sleek V-wing fighter can adapt to any situation! Position the wings and flaps in attack mode to protect Palpatine's shuttle from enemies. Or position the wings in flight mode to survey the area for intruders! Either way, the V-wing is ready to strike for the Republic. Includes Clone pilot and R4 droid. Position wings in attack or flight mode!

6206-1.desc:
Blasting out of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi, the TIE Interceptor is the fastest fighter in the Imperial fleet! Open the cockpit canopy and fold down the instrument panel to put the TIE pilot inside and recreate your favorite classic Star Wars battles!
• Includes TIE fighter pilot!
• Cockpit opens and instrument panel folds down!

6207-1.desc:
The Rebel Alliance A-wing fighters were the fastest in the fleet during the Battle of Endor. This authentic model of the A-wing includes a cockpit canopy that opens, guns that rotate, and a small cargo room with supplies.
• Includes Rebel pilot and technician with military cargo speeder.
• Great for any Star Wars fan!
• Guns rotate!
• Canopy opens!

6208-1.desc: Build the Rebellion's heavy strike ship with this exciting set! Just like the classic Star Wars vessel, its wings can fold for flight or vertical landing. Challenge the forces of the Empire and use your launchers to save the day! Service tower doubles as a display stand for the fighter and can fold down for easy storage. Cockpit opens so you can put the B-wing pilot at the controls. Includes Rebel pilot. Fold the wings for landing or flight! Missiles launch! Service tower doubles as a display stand!

6209-1.desc:
Fearsome bounty hunter Boba Fett is back, stalking the spaceways in his ship, Slave I™! The sophisticated anti-detection gear and stealth hardware make sure that his quarry never sees him coming until it is too late. The Slave I can take on any foe with its bombs, blasters, and launchers that really fire! Han Solo is trapped in carbonite and locked in the storage hold, but you can save him.
• Cockpit and wings rotate for flight and landing.
• Includes Boba Fett, Han Solo in carbonite, Bespin Guard, Dengar and IG-88.
• Bombs, blasters and launchers really fire
tags: Boba Fett's Slave I Firespray-31-class Starship

6210-1.desc: As he sails across the dunes of Tatooine in his mighty Sail Barge, little does Jabba the Hutt know that he's in for a nasty surprise! With its opening panels and rotating blaster cannon, the giant Sail Barge seems unstoppable…until Luke Skywalker and his friends break free on the desert skiff above the hungry Sarlacc Pit! Even bounty hunter Boba Fett may not be able to keep the heroes from escaping. Includes Jabba the Hutt, Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Lando Calrissian in guard disguise, prisoner Princess Leia, Boba Fett, Gamorrean Guard, and R2-D2 with serving tray! Sail Barge measures 18" (46cm) long! Includes Sarlacc pit and desert skiff! Sarlacc's jaws open and close! Sail Barge's side flips down to reveal inner chambers! Desert skiff measures over 8" (20cm) long!

6211-1.desc:
With the Imperial Star Destroyer, no one escapes the clutches of the Empire! This incredible vehicle opens up to reveal all the details of the Empire's most famous starship. Lower Darth Vader's mask in his meditation chamber, kneel before the Emperor's hologram, fire the turbo laser cannons, direct the battle from the command bridge with Grand Moff Tarkin, and release the escape pod for emergency evacuations!
Includes Darth Vader, Grand Moff Tarkin, Imperial Officer, two Stormtroopers, two Emperor's Royal Guards, Imperial Astromech Droid, and Mouse Droid minifigures.
Top lifts off and sides swing open to reveal all of the inner workings of the ship!
Imperial Star Destroyer measures over 23" (58cm) long!

6212-1.desc: Build one of the most famous ships of the Star Wars" saga! In the hands of the Rebel Alliance's brave pilots, the X-wing starfighter helped to destroy two massive Death Stars". With S-foil wings that open to attack position, folding landing gear, a cargo hold and lots of authentic details, this Star Wars set includes the first-ever LEGO minifigure of Rebel hero Wedge Antilles, as well as several hard-to-find characters.Features parts to customize your starfighter as either Luke Skywalker's" Red Five or Wedge's Red Two X-wing!Includes Wedge Antilles, Luke Skywalker, Princess Leia", Han Solo", Chewbacca" and R2-D2" minifigures.

6638-1.desc:
This special canister contains the parts you need to build a BIONICLE creation or modify one of your existing ones.
Includes Kanohi masks, tools, Rahkshi heads and spines, and much more!

7021-1.desc: The Vikings face their toughest opponent of all, the fire-breathing armored dragon Ofnir! Use the double catapult to fight back against the fierce monster. Decorated with a dragon skull from past victories, the catapult launches 2 blazing boulders at the enemy! Includes 3 Viking warrior minifigures! Ofnir dragon wears a suit of armor! Use the double catapult for multiple shot action!

7577-1.desc: It's an exciting day at the Winter Wonder palace! Snow has just fallen and the king and princesses are ready to go skiing! Help the princesses get ready in front of their vanity, and the fun begins! Groom their beautiful, white pony and give the bunny some carrots, or have tea party at the table or play dress up! With so much to do, the fun never ends! Includes 2 princesses, 1 King, 1 bunny, and 1 pony! Includes lots of fun accessories for dress-up, tea parties and more! Look for inspirational building ideas on the box!

7578-1.desc:
It's another perfect day in Belville, where the princesses relax and play. Their horse-drawn carriage is ready to take them to a picnic in the pavilion! The princesses even have their favorite book - the one about the prince and princess, who live happily ever after!
Includes 2 princesses, 1 cat, and 1 horse!
Includes many special accessories!

7579-1.desc:
Just beyond the trees, surrounded by flowers, lives the beautiful Blossom Fairy and her cat. Her glittery wings and sparkling wand shine in the sun as she waters the flowers surrounding her charming palace. Fill up the watering can and keep the garden beautiful!
Includes the Blossom Fairy and her cat!

7700-1.desc: When the evil robots attack, Stealth Hunter is there to stop them! This battle machine strikes from the sky, protected by a stealth coating that makes it invisible to sensors. Armed with a laser rifle and a dual-blade electro sword, it is ready to defend humanity against invasion! Includes minifigure human pilot Hikaru! Includes special light brick and energy tubing to make the Stealth Hunter "power up!" Stealth Hunter stands over 7.5 inches (19cm) high! Rebuild into the Stealth Wasp or combine with #7701 Grand Titan to build a giant Battle Machine. See www.EXO-FORCE.com for building instructions and more building inspiration photos. Hikaru's head turns to change facial expressions!

7701-1.desc:
The Grand Titan is the most powerful battle machine in EXO-FORCE. Heavily armored, it can take on any opponent and come out on top! Equipped with an electro-magnetic pulse pincer and a rotating laser cannon, it could mean the difference between victory and defeat for the humans!
• Includes minifigure human pilot Takeshi!
• Includes special light brick and energy tubing to make the Grand Titan "power up!"
• Grand Titan stands over 7.5 inches (19cm) high!
• Rebuild into the Titan Tracker or combine with #7700 Stealth Hunter to build a giant Battle Machine. See www.EXO-FORCE.com for building instructions and more building inspiration photos.
• Takeshi's head turns to change facial expressions!

7702-1.desc:
The most frightening of robots and the most powerful opponent of EXO-FORCE, Thunder Fury's titanium power saw and automatic laser cannon make it a major threat to the safety of the humans of Sentai Mountain!
Includes Devastator robot pilot minifigure!
Includes special light brick and energy tubing to make the Thunder Fury "power up!"
Thunder Fury stands over 7.5 inches (19cm) high!
Rebuild into the Fire Fury or combine with #7703 Fire Vulture to build a giant Battle Machine. See www.EXO-FORCE.com for building instructions and more building inspiration photos.

7703-1.desc:
Fire Vulture, the flying battle machine of the evil robots, has powerful flame throwers to keep the humans at bay! Its electro-vulture claws can tear enemy armor to bits.
• Includes Devastator robot pilot minifigure!
• Includes special light brick and energy tubing to make the Fire Vulture "power up!"
• Fire Vulture stands over 7.5 inches (19cm) high!
• Rebuild into the Hover Hawk or combine with #7702 Thunder Fury to build a giant Battle Machine. See www.EXO-FORCE.com for building instructions and more building inspiration photos.

7707-1.desc: The ground shakes and humans flee as the Striking Venom approaches! This massive spider-like robot battle machine can carry Meca One and 6 Iron Drones into battle. Its shovel claws can dig holes in rock so the Striking Venom can tunnel and surprise its foes. Rotating laser machine cannons, thick armor and energy disc shooter make it the most powerful battle machine ever known! Can the EXO-FORCE team defeat Striking Venom, or will Sentai Fortress fall prey to its might? You decide! Includes special light brick! Includes Meca One and 6 Iron Drone robot minifigures! Gold robot Meca One mans the controls! Striking Venom stands over 11" (28cm) tall and 18" (46cm) wide! Use the rapid-fire disk launcher to battle the humans!

7708-1.desc:
When a human battle machine gets damaged, Uplink is ready to fix it and send it back into battle. With its mini missile launchers and laser cannons, it can defend itself while it repairs a Grand Titan or Stealth Hunter.
• Includes minifigure human pilot Ryo!
• Ryo's head turns to change facial expressions!
• Uplink stands over 5 inches (13cm) high!

7709-1.desc:
The robot army has stormed Tenchii Bridge and is attacking Sentai Fortress! Can the humans fight them off and win the battle? You decide! This giant-sized EXO-FORCE battle set features a massive gate, two towers, human and robot battle machines, a repair bay, laser cannons, light-up elements, and much more! Get set for adventure as Hikaru, Takeshi, Ha-Ya-To, and Ryo fight the Iron Drones led by Meca One.
Includes Sensei Keiken, leader of EXO-FORCE, not available in any other set!
Total of 8 minifigures are included: Keiken, Hikaru, Ryo, Ha-Ya-To, Meca One and 2 Iron Drone robot pilots!
Includes Hikaru's full-sized blue battle machine, Silent Strike!
Use the repair bay to fix the battle machines!
Fortress is over 31" (79cm) wide and 17" (43cm) tall!
Set includes 2 light bricks for powering up!
Special vehicles ride the rails atop the fortress!
Robot battle machine features rapid disk launcher!

7713-1.desc: Here comes the giant Bridge Walker! Piloted by the gold robot leader itself, it's the biggest and toughest EXO-FORCE battle machine on two legs. With two light-up power bricks, a firing missile, twin robot gunners and incredible weaponry, the Bridge Walker seems unstoppable…and it's up to brave Ha-Ya-To in the White Lightning to save the day! Will the White Lightning's speed and electro-scrambler disc launcher be enough to defeat the robot invasion? Includes two light bricks! Includes Ha-Ya-To minifigure! White Lightning battle machine features auto-disk launcher! Bridge Walker includes gold robot minifigure Meca One at the controls, plus two Devastator robots! Bridge Walker battle machine stands 14" (36cm) tall!

7779-1.desc:
Batman's dragster rockets through the streets of Gotham City™ in hot pursuit of Catwoman on her speedy motorbike. With his flick-fire missiles and a spinning laser cannon, nothing escapes the Dark Knight's high-speed justice!
Includes grey-suited Batman and Catwoman minifigures!
Batman's dragster features flick-fire missile!
Also includes Batman and Catwoman vehicles!

7780-1.desc:
The Batboat hovercraft is in hot pursuit of Killer Croc and his swamp jet ski, but Batman™ has to watch out for Croc's flick-fire missiles! Batboat features dual-action props, a secret speedboat and a docking port to tow the captured criminal back to jail.
Includes Batman and Killer Croc minifigures!
Batboat contains secret speedboat for small-space pursuit!
Killer Croc has flick-fire missiles!
Batboat measures 10'' (25cm) long!
Use the secret speedboat's dock to tow the Croc's jet ski back to jail!
Also includes a collection of Batman gadgets!

7781-1.desc:
When Two-Face™ tries to get away with an armored car full of stolen money, it's time to send the Batmobile into action! Dodge the two-sided truck's hidden weapons, then fire the Batmobile's rocket at the secret panel to send Two-Face flying!
Includes black-suited Batman™, Two-Face and evil henchman minifigures!
Includes Batmobile, bank truck and city roadblock!
Batmobile has blunt shooter rocket!
Batmobile measures 9.5'' (24cm) long!
Secret panel on bank truck sends Two-Face flying!
Also includes a collection of Batman gadgets!

7782-1.desc:
When The Joker™ and his henchman take to the skies, it's up to Batman™ and the Batwing to stop him! Launch the Batwing's missile at The Joker Copter and stop the villain from dropping laughing gas on the city of Gotham!
Open the Batwing's wings to reveal slide-out rockets!
Launch the Batwing's missile at The Joker's hidden-weapons helicopter!
Sleek Batwing measures 10" (25cm) wide and 15" (38cm) long!
Hit the spotlight to knock the ladder and the crooked clown from the air!
Batwing's wings opens to reveal slide-out rockets!
The Joker Copter measures 9" (22cm) long!
Includes stand for Batwing with flip-down ladder!
Batman has lots of cool gadgets!
Includes grey-suited Batman, The Joker and henchman minifigures.

7783-1.desc:
Mr. Freeze™ and The Penguin™ are out for revenge! Can Batman™, Robin™ and loyal butler Alfred™ stop them from bringing an early winter to the Dark Knight's hidden lair? Set includes:
Batman, Robin, The Penguin, Mr. Freeze, Alfred, Bruce Wayne and henchman minifigures, plus 3 penguins!
Includes vehicles for Batman and Robin, plus The Penguin's sub!
Two-level control center includes net and rocket launcher!
Includes Batman's costume transformation chamber!
Batcave also includes a dock for the Batboat™ and repair bay for the Batmobile™!
Find the secret entrance in the prison cell!
Fire the Bat-Signal™ launcher!

7784-1.desc:
Ultimate size! Ultimate detail! Ultimate power! It's the ultimate Batmobile! With moving engine turbines and rotating booster flames, this is one vehicle of justice that no villain can escape!
Open the roof to reveal the detailed interior!
Turn the steering wheel to raise the hood shield for added speed!
Measures over 17.5" (45cm) long and over 6" (15cm) wide!

7785-1.desc: Do you dare enter Arkham Asylum? The worst criminals in Gotham City are imprisoned behind the gloomy walls of Arkham Asylum. The Scarecrow, the master of fear; The Riddler, the prince of puzzles; Poison Ivy, beautiful and deadly queen of the plant kingdom -- all have been sent to Arkham by the Batman. Now they threaten to escape, and only the Dark Knight and Nightwing can stop them! Includes a guard tower, asylum van, cells for the criminals, a bed sheet 'rope' for escapes, Nightwing's cycle and much more! Includes Batman, Nightwing, The Riddler, The Scarecrow, Poison Ivy, and two Arkham Asylum guard minifigures.

7844-1.desc:
Save the day with the airport rescue truck! With bright colors, cool gear and working winch, little heroes will have lots of fun fighting fires. Siren really sounds and lights really work for even more creative play opportunities!
Includes 2 firefighters.
Includes light and sound brick!
Winch really works!
Move the cannon from side to side!

7846-1.desc:
Fight in the great dragon tournament and show the King that you’re a true warrior! The torches are lit and the boundaries are marked. Put the armor on your dragon and then on yourself. And when you’re ready to fight, raise your sword up high and charge!
Set includes 3 minifigures!

7880-1.desc: Join the jolly crew of this pirate ship and prepare for thrills and fun on the high seas! Packed with play features, the Big Pirate Ship lets you fire the cannon, crank the winch, walk the plank, 'monkey' around in the sails, dig up treasure, stow prisoners in the hold, and more! Ship really floats and rolls! Safe, durable construction for younger builders.

7881-1.desc: This ghostly ship haunts the Seven Seas in search of spooky fun and pirate adventure! Help the Captain and his First Mate load the child-safe launching cannon, lower the anchor, or keep watch from the crow's nest above the sail. Ship can float or roll! Sail and decorations really glow in the dark!

7882-1.desc:
When he set sail with his trusty raft, pirate flag and cutlass, this pirate never expected to come face to face with a giant toothy shark! Can he escape to adventure another day?
Shark’s mouth can open and close to swallow pirate figures whole!

7883-1.desc: Following an old treasure map, the pirate has discovered a hidden chest on a long-lost desert island. But the ghost pirate won't give up his gold without a fight! Who will get the treasure? Ghost pirate really glows in the dark!

7890-1.desc: Someone has dialed "911" and the ambulance is on its way! Carry the patient on the stretcher then check their vital signs on the monitor! Includes EMT minifigure, stretcher and more. Back door and side compartments open!

7892-1.desc:
When someone is sick in LEGO City, the staff of the City Hospital jumps into action! With three floors of medical rooms and equipment, a rescue helicopter and EMT truck, there's no emergency they can't handle!
Includes doctor, patient and 2 rescue worker minifigures with lots of accessories!
Includes rescue helicopter and EMT truck!
Hospital has three floors of exam rooms!

7893-1.desc:
There's lots of excitement as everyone boards the plane! The pilot is already in his seat, making last-minute checks and waiting for direction down the runway. The passengers are ready to stow their bags and take their seats!
Includes rolling staircase for boarding the plane!
Includes 1 pilot, 1 worker and 2 passenger minifigures!
Open the doors and remove the top of the plane to see what's going on inside!

7894-1.desc:
It's always a busy day at the LEGO CITY Airport! Load the luggage truck and drive it to baggage claim, then check the plane for any needed repairs and prepare for the next flight. Prepare for security check and help more passengers board the plane.
Comes complete with control tower, security check, baggage claim, viewers' platform, airplane and luggage truck!
Includes 5 airport personnel minifigures!
Revolving door really spins!

7895-1.desc:
Change train direction!
Add switching tracks to your train track layout and change direction with the flip of a lever!
Set includes 4 curved rails, 1 left side switching track and 1 right side switching track
Tracks do not conduct electricity and therefore are not compatible with LEGO® 9V trains.

7896-1.desc:
Add straight and curved rails to your train track layout -- turn more corners and go even further than before!
Includes 8 curved rails and 8 straight rails
Tracks do not conduct electricity and therefore are not compatible with LEGO® 9V Trains.

7897-1.desc:
The new high-speed passenger train is ready for departure! Stop at the platform to pick up the passengers and load up the luggage. Use the infrared remote control handset to toot the horn and control the train's speed.
Includes engineer and 2 passenger minifigures, plus train platform!
Includes 16 curved and 4 straight rails for a complete 28" x 37.5" (71cm x 95cm) track layout!
Train has working lights and horn!
Open the top of the train car to see the passengers inside!
Complete train includes engine and two cars, and measures 31.5" (80cm) long!
3-channel infrared remote control moves train forward and backward at 3 different speeds!
Requires 9 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included.
Train also runs on 9v LEGO train tracks.

7898-1.desc: This deluxe train set has everything you need for awesome railroad adventures! The infrared remote control operates on 3 different channels at 6 different speeds, and even has a real working horn. Full track includes 20 curved, 8 straight and 2 switching rails. Complete train features engine with working headlights, cargo wagon, caboose, crane car and flatbed car. There's even a roadster, truck and forklift, all with working parts! Includes 5 minifigures with lots of tools and accessories! Includes 20 curved, 8 straight and 2 switching rails for a complete 57" x 33" (145cm x 84cm) track layout! Train has working lights and horn! Included cargo truck has a bed that lifts to unload cargo! Working crane on crane car hoists cargo! Complete train includes engine and 3 cars, and measures over 3 feet (92cm) long! 3-channel infrared remote control moves train forward and backward at 3 different speeds! Requires 9 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included. Train also runs on 9v LEGO train tracks.

7899-1.desc:
When trouble threatens LEGO City, the police are ready to race to the rescue in their high-powered police boat! While one officer mans the boat, his partner provides air support in the included police helicopter! With a fully working motor, this swift craft flies through the water to save the day.
• Boat really floats!
• Includes police helicopter!
• Includes 2 police officers and 1 robber minifigure!
• Shine the boat's spotlight on the crook as he tries to swim away!
• Police officer has his own life jacket for water safety!
• Boat is over 16" (40cm) long!
• Motor requires 1 AA (1.5v) battery, not included.

7900-1.desc:
This special truck is ready for any cargo! Whether you're hauling construction supplies or even other vehicles, the Heavy Loader is up to the job. Set the trailer to handle heavy loads or low loads, or remove the bridge section for use in your LEGO city!
• Front and back wheels are articulated for taking turns and cab detaches from body.
• Truck measures over 2 feet (61cm) long and extends to over 33" (84cm) long!
• Includes construction worker minifigure.

7901-1.desc: The airplane mechanic is busy checking the airplane engine! Transport the engine with the crane and perform the maintenance! Includes mechanic minifigure with tools! Includes crane and airplane engine!

7902-1.desc: When a patient calls, the doctor is ready to rush to help! The doctor's car is fully equipped to handle any emergency. Includes doctor minifigure with accessories!

7903-1.desc:
By sea or land, the rescue helicopter is always prepared to save the day! Equipped with a stretcher and fully functional winch, the rescue officers are ready to handle any situation.
• Copter rotors really spin, and cockpit and doors really open!
• Includes civilian and 2 rescue minifigures.
• Includes working winch for airlifting patient!

7905-1.desc:
Build the tallest buildings ever with this special edition LEGO City Building Crane! With working functions straight out of real-world construction equipment, this towering crane is ready for any challenge. The extra-wide base provides stability for lifting loads and the side ladder allows construction workers to climb to the very top!
• Includes 2 containers, 3 mini-figures, barriers and more.
• Crane stands a towering 26" (68cm) tall!
• Arm extends up to 26" (68cm) long!
• Turn the crank to lower and raise the working hook!
• Slide the hook dolly along the arm for precision lifting and lowering.
• Seat the worker at the controls atop the tower.
• Crane rotates a full 360.
• Containers have loops on top for picking up with crane hook!
• Divided into sub-models for easy building and instant play.

8281-1.desc: With a fully functional farming attachment, this tough little tractor is all you need to take care of the fields. Activate the attachment by moving the tractor and watch the gears spin around, or lift the attachment off the ground when not in use. When the hard work is finished, treat yourself to a joy ride and re-build your tractor into a motorcycle with a sidecar! Set includes alternate model building instructions for a motorcycle with sidecar! Authentic models for skilled builders! Fully functional!

8282-1.desc:
With its rear suspension, working engine, and handlebar steering, this fully functional model is just like the real thing! This 6 inch (15+ cm) Quad Bike has incredible details for realistic building. When you’re ready for a new challenge, re-build it into a 3 wheel chopper with the included alternate model building instructions!
• Equipped with rear suspension!
• Features handlebar steering!
• Move the model to see enging working!
• Authentic models for skilled builders!
• Re-build into a 3 wheel chopper!
• Includes building instructions for 2 models!
• Fully functional!

8283-1.desc: This mean machine makes the biggest jobs seem small, with its fully functional boom and bucket. Turn the knobs on the back to extend, raise and lower the boom, and turn the knob in the front to tilt the bucket. Then, steer the massive, 2 inch high tires by turning the yellow, translucent knob. Put your model building skills to the test with this authentic model, then re-build it into a front loader! The set includes building instructions for both models. Raise, lower, and extend the boom! Tilt the bucket! Measures 7 inches (17+ cm) long! Authentic models for skilled builders! Re-build into a front loader! Includes building instructions for 2 models! Fully functional!

8284-1.desc: This rugged set includes instructions to build a fully-functional Dune Buggy or realistic Tractor! Dune Buggy features rack and pinion steering, gull wing doors, a working boxer engine with moving pistons and lots of other realistic details. Tractor features 4 cylinder engine, working steering and detachable rotary equipment which spins into action when the tractor moves forward! Turn the wheels to watch the engine pistons move!

8285-1.desc: This amazing, fully-functional Tow Truck is equipped with rack and pinion front wheel steering, and an operating crane, winch and lift -- just like the real thing! Its rear telescopic towing mechanism lifts pneumatically to rescue stranded vehicles, while the ratchet-regulated winch secures the load. Open the hood to reveal the detailed V6 engine with moving pistons and spinning radiator fan! Side compartments conceal manual controls for raising the hook or extending and lowering the boom. Authentic model for skilled builders! Pump the pneumatic cylinder to lift the telescoping boom! Tow Truck measures over 26" (66cm) long! Turn the wheels to see the realistic V6 engine pistons move! Lower the stabilizers for towing heavy loads! Telescoping boom extends, retracts, lifts and lowers! Open the hood to see the detailed engine and spinning radiator fans! Includes building instructions to rebuild into a heavy load flat-bed truck! Also includes instructions for integrating #8287 Motor Set (sold separately) into the alternate model. The motor will lift and lower the arm and pull the string up and down.

8287-1.desc: Power up your LEGO TECHNIC creations! This supplementary set with motor and battery box includes lots of useful gears and cross-axles as well as the torque-limiter, the cardanic joint and differential. Includes elements needed to integrate the motor into sets #8284 and #8285. Requires 6 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included.

8288-1.desc:
With rugged crawler tracks, a low, wide base and heavy counterweights, the Crawler Crane is unique in its lifting abilities. Two separate cranks control the positioning of the booms, and a third crank raises the hook. At its highest, this crane measures an amazing 20" (50cm)!
• Authentic model for skilled builders!
• Lift objects and control positioning of booms with 3 separate winches!
• Entire model turns 360 degrees on base!
• Detailed model features heavy counterweights for precise lifting!
• Includes building instructions to rebuild into a High Lift Crane.

8289-1.desc: This authentic model is ready to fight any fire! Open the control panel on the side of the truck and use the 3 separate gears to operate the aerial lift with ultimate precision. Adjust the boom incline, angle and rotation -- the aerial lift raises to over 21" high and rotates a full 360 degrees! Working outriggers lower to stabilize the truck! Use the gear at the back to control the steering! Rebuild into an equally authentic light-duty rescue truck! Includes building instructions for 2 models.

850150-1.desc: Have a little holiday charm with a LEGO® Santa Claus Key Chain!

850373-1.desc: Show the world you're a LEGO fan -- carry your lunch in this great LEGO lunchbox! Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

850374-1.desc: For the ultimate LEGO Fan pack your sandwiches and a drink in LEGO lunchbox, making your lunch colourful. Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

850377-1.desc: For the ultimate LEGO Fan pack your sandwiches and a drink in a LEGO lunchbox, making your lunch more colourful. Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

851008-1.desc: What better way to put your awesome report card, drawing, or photo up on the fridge than with a LEGO brick magnet!? Set includes 4 magnetic bricks.

851228-1.desc: Are you looking for extra minifigures? Add your favourite LEGO Star Wars characters to your locker or fridge with this new magnet set, featuring Chewbacca, Darth Vader and Obi Wan Kenobi!

851532-1.desc: Celebrate the holidays in true LEGO style with this attractive ornamental snow globe. A minifigure Santa Claus and a snow-covered tree are ready to welcome in the season!

851584-1.desc:
No one will dare mess with your keys when they see the fierce Viking that protects them!
Includes LEGO logo plate.

851683-1.desc: The crimson-robed Imperial Royal Guards defend the mighty Emperor, and now you can have one to protect your keys as well!

851729-1.desc: Carry your keys on the most amazing keychain in town, featuring EXO-FORCE pilot Takeshi!

851730-1.desc: Keep your keys safe with the magical Professor Dumbledore, the powerful wizard from the world of Harry Potter! This unique key ring features a Dumbledore minifigure from the Harry Potter and The Goblet of Fire series, plus Harry Potter and LEGO logo plates to make it even more fun!

851746-1.desc: Need someplace to carry the keys for your jet plane? Or maybe just your house and school locker? The pilot is ready to take you and your keys on an exciting trip!

851749-1.desc: Bring some LEGO® fun to your next meal! This adorable set features two shakers, both designed to resemble LEGO minifigure heads. Just fill them with salt and pepper and shake away!

851818-1.desc: Carry your keys on the most amazing keyring in town, featuring EXO-FORCE pilot Hikaru!

851831-1.desc: You're ready for adventure with this horned helmet of the Vikings!

851847-1.desc: Lots of fun with this LEGO version of the classical Ludo game. Which figure will you be - construction worker, policeman or racing driver? Will you roll a six and be able to move your figure onto the game? Or will your opponent catch up with you and send your figure home? The luckiest roller will win! Set includes 4 orange construction workers, 4 blue construction workers, 4 policemen and 4 racing drivers.

851861-1.desc: Pillage your opponent in this exciting game of skill and strategy! This exclusive LEGO Vikings Chess set includes a total of 32 chess pieces, featuring 24 minifigures. Just choose your color and you're ready to begin! One-piece chess board measures 10" x 10" (25.4 x 25.4 cm). Includes sturdy carrying case with leather handle, snap closures, touch fastener for holding board in place and storage compartments for each piece. 32 chess pieces include 24 LEGO Vikings minifigures! Available exclusively from LEGO!

8527-1.desc: Create the smartest, strongest and most advanced LEGO robot ever, in as few as 30 minutes! The new NXT Intelligent Brick, your robot's "brain," features a powerful 32-bit microprocessor and more memory, plus support for USB 2.0, Bluetooth and more! A highly versatile palette of LEGO TECHNIC elements combines with state-of-the-art ultrasonic, sound, light and touch sensors in the next generation of intuitive robotics. With included Quick-Start guide, easy-to-use software and step-by-step building instructions, beginners and experts alike can create humanoid, vehicle and animal robots that obey every command! Programming software is now available for both PC and Macintosh, plus with Bluetooth support, you can even command your robot from your mobile phone! LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT Includes: All-new NXT Intelligent Brick with 32-bit microprocessor, more memory and FLASH 3 Interactive Servo motors feature built-in rotation sensors to align speed for precise control New sound sensor reacts to sound commands, patterns and tones New ultrasonic visual sensor responds to movement Improved touch sensor reacts to touch and release Improved light sensor detects different colors and light intensities 519 specially selected LEGO TECHNIC elements for sturdy and durable building and improved functionality and movement 4 input ports, 3 output ports and 7 6-wire cords Matrix display Real sound speaker USB 2.0 and Bluetooth support Easy-to-use PC and Mac compatible interface Intuitive, icon-based drag-and-drop program "building" environment.

8528-1.desc:
Connect sensors and motors from your old MINDSTORMS® RIS 2.0 (#3804) to your new MINDSTORMS® NXT Intelligent Brick! One end of the cable features a 2x2 studded connector plate, while the other end has an RJ12 plug.
• Each cable measures 15.25" (39cm) long; including connectors.
• Set includes 3 cables.

8529-1.desc:
Connect additional bricks, sensors and motors to your MINDSTORMS® NXT robotic creations! If you've added extra components to your original #8527 MINDSTORMS® NXT set, you'll need these additional cables to connect them.
• Includes one 8.5” (20cm) cable, four 14.5” (35cm) cables and two 18.5” (50cm) cables. (Cable measurements include connectors.).
• Includes 7 cables.
• Both ends of the cable have RJ12 plugs.

8624-1.desc:
As they fight their way toward the Mask of Life, the Piraka and Toa Inika come to a great lava river. Now they must race down the treacherous molten river, each side trying to be first to reach the powerful mask. A mysterious tower is only the first of many obstacles that block their way!
Includes two lava craft, tower, and zamor sphere launchers!
Includes 8 all-new and mini Toa Inika and mini Piraka figures with moving parts!
Includes 6 zamor spheres!

8625-1.desc:
The mighty Umbra has served as guard of the powerful Mask of Life for almost 100,000 years. His incredible light-based powers and ultra-speed skates make him a formidable foe for Toa and Piraka alike. How do you stop an enemy so fast he can turn into a beam of light? The Toa must find out, or their quest will come to a shattering end.
Includes awesome dual-strobe sword that really lights up!
Includes Rhotuka spinner and launcher!

8626-1.desc:
As the Piraka travel the secret path to the Mask of Life, they are challenged by Irnakk, a monstrous creature drawn from their own nightmares! This special collection includes:
• #8900 Reidak
• #8905 Thok
• #8902 Vezok
• Features light-up eyes and glow-in-the-dark teeth!
• Includes 12 zamor spheres and multiple launchers! Chest piece stores extra zamor spheres!
• Includes building instructions to create Irnakk using pieces from all three included sets.
• Plus, this awesome set also features an exclusive gold Piraka spine!

8669-1.desc:
You’re sure to make heads spin with this racer’s dark colors and awesome stickers. Rev up the Fire Spinner and watch it do donuts to knock the competition right off the track! Do a donut to win the race!
• Equipped with Fly Wheel motor!
• Combine with #8668 Side Rider to make a twin-engined racing monster!

8671-1.desc: Own the newest, hottest Ferrari! This amazing new set is an authentic 1:17 scale copy of the Ferrari F430 Spider that was launched at the Geneva car show in March 2005. With a convertible top, fully detailed engine and adjustable mirrors, it's authentic down to every last detail! Spider measures over 10" (27 cm) long! Includes realistic Ferrari decals! Features fully detailed engine and adjustable mirrors!

8672-1.desc:
Stage the ultimate Ferrari race! With two Ferrari race cars, two famous drivers, cameraman, announcer, complete pit crew and finish line, you have everything you need for an exciting world-class event! Finish line includes lots of cool details like checkered flags and video cameras. Pit area includes tons of great accessories like tools, air hoses, pit crew and more. Who will win the shiny silver trophy?
• Includes 2 Ferrari race cars!
• Total of 10 minifigures, including 2 drivers, 5 pit crew, 1 announcer and 2 newscasters!
• Includes Italian Grand Prix, Schumacher and Barrichello stickers!
• Includes lots of great detail pieces such as video cameras, checkered flags, pit crew tools -- even a shiny silver trophy!

8673-1.desc: The trusty Ferrari pit stop crew is always ready to fuel up the famous race car! Four crew members jump into action to change tires, check air pressure, refuel and get the driver back in the action! Includes Ferrari race car, clocking station, fuel truck and tools! 5 minifigures include pit crew and driver! Even includes a dolly to wheel in an extra tire!

8674-1.desc: Bigger, more detailed, and with more built-in functions than ever before, the 1:8 scale LEGO Ferrari F1 Racer is the ultimate driving machine! With a working steering wheel, engine and suspension, a removable engine cover, spoiler and nose, this authentic model captures all the sleek details of the real-life Scuderia Ferrari F1 race car. For a LEGO builder, Ferrari collector or racing fan, this is a great addition to any collection! Remove the engine cover to see the moving pistons! Includes real working suspension! Model measures over 24" (61cm) long! Detailed tires measure over 3" (8cm) wide! Working steering wheel turns front tires! Built in realistic 1:8 scale!

8675-1.desc: This mean, green, remote-controlled machine is the definition of tough! With bold details, extra wide tires, massive chassis, and a top speed of 12 mph (20 km/hr), this Racer is ready for anything--water, mud, dirt, grass, you name it! Use the tip tronic speed shift to change channels and tackle the toughest terrain. Build it, race it, and win! Includes batteries, charger and remote control. Runs at a top speed of 14 mph (20 km/hr)! Race outdoors in rain, mud, dirt or grass! Massive tires measure 3.75" (9.5cm) wide! Racer measures over 13.5" (34cm) long!

8676-1.desc: Build your own super strong remote-controlled car with sleek orange and black details! With extra wide tires and a top speed of 6.2 mph (10 km/h) this racer tears up the road! Top speed of 6.2mph (10km/h) Huge 3" (7.6cm) wide tires! Requires 1 9v and 6 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included. For use on dry surfaces only.

8681-1.desc:
Use the tools and labels at the tuner garage to make your racer flashier and faster, then test out your new ride with a slammer powered race! Get ready, get set, and slam your racer into full speed with the garage's working ramp and 2 slammers.
Includes 2 street racers, 1 off-roader, 1 hot rod, and 1 police car.
Bring all your tiny turbos to the tuner garage!
Garage includes ramp and 2 slammers for staging races!

8682-1.desc: Meet the Nitro Intimidator! This super-charged truck has everything you'll need to make your customized statement, from a supercharged V8 engine to nitro bottles and a stereo set-up, plus a big screen and game system in the back. Scorching white flame decals, working steering and oversized exhausts keep this revved-up street machine racing ahead of the pack! Includes decals to customize truck body! Trunk opens to reveal speakers and game system! Steering really works! Features detailed V8 engine! Truck measures over 15" (39cm) long!

8705-1.desc: Dracus is the mighty Rogue Knight of the Dragon. As leader of the Rogue Knight horde, this scarred warrior is rough, tough and cruel. He's led a hundred armies into battle, and thanks to his Rogue iron armor and slashing dragon-claw sword, he's never known defeat! NEW Collectable Dracus metal can! Slashing dragon sword!

8706-1.desc: Karzon is the sneaky Rogue Knight of the Snake, and a master of weapons and deadly traps. This cunning warrior knows every trick in the book, and he's not afraid to use them to win. With his Rogue iron armor and swinging-action spiked flail, he's a match for any knight! NEW Collectable Karzon metal can! Swing the spiked flail!

8722-1.desc:
Kazi is the only Matoran who knows the deepest secrets of the island of Voya Nui!
Sharp and sarcastic, he defends himself using twin echo forks which produce a devastating sound wave!

8723-1.desc: Stealthy and quick, Piruk can sneak in and out of enemy bases to gather information for the Matoran resistance on Voya Nui. If he's caught, his shredder claws can rip through solid metal and make an escape route.

8724-1.desc:
Brave and smart, Garan leads the Matoran of Voya Nui in their fight against the invading Piraka!
His twin pulse bolt generators fire a ball of energy that grows more powerful the farther it travels!

8726-1.desc:
Dalu is the most skilled fighter in the Voya Nui resistance, and she's always ready for a fight!
Twin chargers enable her to increase one attribute of a target (strength, speed, etc.) for a brief time!

8727-1.desc:
Using his Kanohi Calix, the Mask of Fate, Toa Inika Jaller can pull off feats others might think impossible! His energized flame sword fires blasts of flame and lightning intertwined, while he can use his zamor sphere launcher to free enslaved Matoran.
Includes a zamor sphere launcher!
Jaller's flame sword lights up with a strobe effect!

8730-1.desc:
Toa Inika Hewkii can beat an enemy with the power of his stone-lightning blasts, laser axe or zamor launcher – or he can use his Kanohi Sanok, the Mask of Accuracy, and turn virtually anything that can be thrown into a weapon!
Includes a zamor sphere launcher!
The Toa of Stone’s laser axe lights up with a strobe effect!

8731-1.desc:
Toa Inika Kongu knows what his enemies are thinking, thanks to the Kanohi Suletu, the Mask of Telepathy. And he knows how to stop them using his laser crossbow and zamor sphere launcher!
Includes a zamor sphere launcher!
The Toa of Air’s crossbow lights up with a strobe effect!

8733-1.desc:
Immensely powerful, Axonn was a champion of justice long before the first Toa ever came to be. He has vowed to fight the Piraka and keep them from stealing the Mask of Life! Axonn wears the Kanohi Roden, the Great Mask of Truth, which can pierce any disguise and spot any deception. His enormous axe can cleave a mountain in half, and fires pure energy from its blade!
Axonn stands over 9" (over 22cm) high!
Includes Great Mask of Truth!

8734-1.desc:
Once he was a loyal guardian of the Matoran and Axonn’s best friend, but now he has turned evil! Powerful enough to defeat six Toa with one blow of his double-bladed weapon, Brutaka alone is as great a threat as all the Piraka combined! He wears the Kanohi Olmak, the Mask of Dimensional Gates, which can be used to transport a target to another location or even into another dimension!
Brutaka stands over 10" (over 25cm) high!
Includes gold-colored armor and elements!
Double-blade is 10" (over 25cm) long!
Includes Mask of Dimensional Gates!

8764-1.desc:
Brought to life by a horrible accident, the seventh Piraka called Vezon dared to try and steal the Mask of Life for himself. But the mask cursed him to be fused to the monstrous spider Fenrakk and serve as a new guardian of the ancient artifact. Now the mad Vezon and his terrifying steed wait for anyone brave enough – or foolish enough – to try to steal the mask!
Vezon comes with the Spear of Fusion and a flip-mask, one side of which is the first-ever version of the Mask of Life!
Vezon's eye light up and his teeth glow in the dark!
Beware of Fenrakk's massive, chomping jaws!

8892-1.desc:
The evil Piraka are prepared to defend Voya Nui from their outposts around the island. But don't worry -- Toa Inika Jaller and Toa Inika Kongu are on their way to take it back! They're riding atop a giant Fenrakk Spawn Spider to capture the outpost and stop the Piraka!
Features missile launcher and zamor sphere launcher!
Includes 2 mini Toa and 2 mini Piraka figures.
All-new mini Toa and Piraka have cool masks & moving parts!

8893-1.desc:
The Lava Chamber Gate stands between the Toa Inika and the Mask of Life – but the Piraka got there first! The Toa must use zamor sphere launchers to try and hit the shields and bring the drawbridge crashing down. If they fail, the Piraka will steal the mask!
Includes 4 mini Toa Inika and 4 mini Piraka figures.
All-new mini Toa and Piraka have cool masks & moving parts!
Toa lava boards include zamor sphere launchers!
Press the button to launch the tower catapult!
Other tower features rapid-fire zamor sphere launcher!
Includes 4 green and 6 blue zamor spheres!

8894-1.desc:
The evil Piraka have built a massive stronghold in the center of Voya Nui. Here they produce their zamor spheres and hatch plans to steal the Mask of Life. But now, the Toa Inika have arrived and the battle for Voya Nui has begun! Zamor spheres fly as the Toa battle Piraka and a Fenrakk Spawn Spider in this deluxe battle set. Who will win this all-out battle?
Includes 6 mini Toa Inika and 6 mini Piraka figures.
All-new mini Toa and Piraka have cool masks & moving parts!
Includes special light brick and magnifying glass for laser effect!
Giant Piraka mask features huge fangs!
Includes 6 green and 2 blue zamor spheres!
Send zamor spheres down the track to the tower launcher!

8900-1.desc:
Strongest of the Piraka, Reidak lives for destruction. His power to adapt after every defeat makes him virtually unstoppable! His infrared and thermal imaging vision lets him track down his enemies so he can send them to crushing defeat. His combination drill and buzz saw can turn solid ground to quicksand!
• Includes zamor spheres and launcher.
• Piraka eyes light up and teeth glow in the dark!

8901-1.desc:
Enemies of Hakann never know just how he will defeat them - with heat vision, lava launcher, or devastating mental blasts. Hated by the other Piraka for his constant scheming, Hakann plans to eliminate them all and steal the Mask of Light for himself.
Includes zamor spheres and launcher!
Piraka eyes light up and teeth glow in the dark!

8902-1.desc:
Nasty and vicious, Vezok's fury is always on the verge of exploding. In battle, he relies on a harpoon that pulls him through the water and a buzzsaw that hurls water daggers. His powerful impact vision and ability to absorb the powers of his enemies makes him a devastating opponent.
Includes zamor spheres and launcher!
Piraka eyes light up and teeth glow in the dark!

8903-1.desc:
Brilliant and ruthless, Zaktan is feared even by the other Piraka. His laser vision and three-pronged blade help him put down rebellions by the others as they search for the Mask of Life. The strangest and most mysterious Piraka, Zaktan alone may know the true secret of the zamor spheres.
Includes launcher and zamor spheres!
Piraka eyes light up and teeth glow in the dark!

8904-1.desc:
The most talented engineer among the Piraka, Avak can make a tool or weapon out of virtually anything. He can use his X-ray and telescopic vision to seek out foes and then create a perfect prison from thin air to hold them! If it comes to a fight, Avak can rely on his zamor sphere launcher and his seismic pickaxe/jackhammer combination.
• Includes zamor spheres and launcher!
• Piraka eyes light up and teeth glow in the dark!

8905-1.desc:
Thok's plan is simple - convince all the other Piraka he is on their side, and then betray them all! He has the power to bring inanimate objects to life to serve him and spellbinder vision to disorient a foe. If those fail, he relies on his ice peg and ice gun to freeze enemies and his zamor spheres to make them slaves.
Includes zamor spheres and launcher!
Piraka eyes light up and teeth glow in the dark!

9211-1.desc: This set of community service vehicles includes police, fire, waste collection, ambulance, and a tow truck. Road signs and community characters are included to help young learners further explore how communities are kept on the move.

9224-1.desc: This set features three generations – kids, parents, and grandparents – in different clothes and uniforms indicating the jobs they have. Use these figures to populate towns with citizens and workers.

9247-2.desc: Every town needs police, fire, and rescue workers, plus crossing guards, bakers, mechanics and more. Includes over 31 minifigures from all different occupations Features an assortment of helmets, 3 bicycles, 4 trikes, and a variety of accessories so you can customize your minifigures however you like.

9798-1.desc: Add the rechargeable battery to your LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT robot and end your need for AA batteries! Rechargeable battery is lithium. Requires #9833 Transformer, sold separately, to recharge battery. Please Note: Building instructions for NXT models do not include instruction for incorporating the rechargable battery. This battery will increase the depth of your NXT intelligent brick so you will need to adjust your models accordingly.

9833-2.desc:
Recharge your battery!
This standard 9v transformer plugs in to an AC outlet to recharge your #9798 Rechargeable Battery for LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT.
9 volts; requires AC outlet.
Related charger is no longer available. If charger is also needed, please order #9693 and #8887.

9840-1.desc: This large storage box comes in packs of six. The boxes have transparent lids and are ideal for stacking. Each box has drainage holes so that LEGO® elements can be washed in the containers. Ask your local distributor for options to purchase single boxes. Suitable for use with children from 1½ years.

9841-1.desc:
The robot's "brain!"
The all-new NXT Intelligent Brick, your robot’s “brain,” features a powerful 32-bit microprocessor and Flash memory, plus support for Bluetooth™ and USB 2.0! The NXT intelligent Brick includes:
32-bit ARM7 microprocessor.
Support for Bluetooth wireless communication.
1 USB 2.0 port.
4 input ports.
3 output ports.
Powered by 6 AA (1.5v) Batteries, not included, or lithium Rechargeable Battery (#9798), sold separately.
Up to three NXT Bricks can be connected at the same time; however, you can only communicate with one NXT Brick at a time.
This is the individual component, and does not include any sensors, motors, cords, software or other accessories; for the complete LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT set, please see item #8527 or #8547.

9842-1.desc:
Take precise steps!
The Servo Motor has a built-in rotation sensor that measures speed and distance, and reports back to the NXT Intelligent Brick (sold separately.) This allows for precise steps and complete motor control within one degree of accuracy! Several motors can be aligned to drive at the same speed.
Includes 1 Servo Motor.
Does not include connector cable.
This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

9843-1.desc:
Your robot's "fingers!"
The Touch Sensor reacts to touch and release, enabling your LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT robotic creation to "feel" like never before! It can detect single or multiple button presses, and reports back to the NXT Intelligent Brick (sold separately.)
Includes 1 Touch Sensor.
Does not include connector cable.
This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

9844-1.desc:
Detect light intensity!
The Light Sensor assists in helping your robot to "see." Using the NXT Brick (sold separately), it enables your robot to distinguish between light and dark, as well as determine the light intensity in a room or the light intensity of different colors.
Includes 1 Light Sensor.
Does not include connector cable.
This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

9845-1.desc:
Your robot's "ears!"
Using the NXT Brick (sold separately), the Sound Sensor allows your LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT robot to hear! The Sound Sensor is able to measure noise levels in both dB (decibels) and dBA (frequencies around 3–6 kHz where the human ear is most sensitive).
Includes 1 Sound Sensor.
Does not include connector cable.
This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

9846-1.desc:
Your robot's "eyes!"
The Ultrasonic Sensor helps your LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT robot judge distances and "see" where objects are! Using the NXT Brick (sold separately), the Ultrasonic Sensor is able to detect an object and measure its proximity in inches or centimeters.
Includes 1 Ultrasonic Sensor.
Does not include connector cable.
This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

9847-1.desc:
Wireless communication with your robot!
Enable wireless communication between your LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT robot and your Apple or PC computer! If your computer is not already Bluetooth enabled, you will need this device for wireless communication with your NXT robot.
Supported Bluetooth® software includes Widcomm Bluetooth for Windows (newer than v. 1.4.2.10 SP5), and the Bluetooth stacks included in Microsoft Windows XP (with Service Pack 2) and Apple MacOS X (10.3.9 and 10.4).
Requires USB connection.

B014-1.desc: Stick them on your refrigerator, school locker, or anywhere!

CDB26-1.desc: This brand new 2-disc CD-Rom set is packed with excitement and fun, including: All-new building ideas from the LEGO Master Builders, available nowhere else! Exclusive behind the scenes videos of the building of awesome life-sized LEGO models, including LEGO Batman, LEGO SpongeBob SqaurePants, and BIONICLE Piraka! Special demos of the upcoming BIONICLE Heroes video game, LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy video game and LEGO Builder Bot Game! The newest version of LEGO Digital Designer (v1.6), so you can create your own models on your computer and print out building instructions! And much, much more!

EL571-1.desc: Keep your table finish safe and your drinking glasses slip-free with these flexible, 3-D textured LEGO coasters! Set of 4 coasters includes two red and two light blue. Dishwasher safe up to 150 degrees F (65 ºC). Each coaster measures 3.5" (9cm) square.

EL715-1.desc: It's the perfect gift for the adult fan of LEGO in your life! Set includes sturdy red LEGO brick-themed corkscrew and orange bottle opener. Dishwasher safe up to 150 degrees F (65 ºC). Each measures 4.5" (11.5cm) wide. Please note: colors of items may vary from those shown here. Please note: This item is not a toy and is intended for adult fans only.

EL792-1.desc: Bring some LEGO fun to your next meal! This adorable set features two shakers, both designed to resemble LEGO minifigure heads. Just fill them with salt and pepper and shake away!

G1752-1.desc:
Build your way across the board with LEGO® Dominos - the first ever color-based Dominos game! Players match and stack their dominos based on color, choosing to zig zag their way to the finish line or block an opponent. It's a great way for kids to learn colors and practice fine motor skills and fun for adults, too! For 2 to 4 players. Includes:
• 56 LEGO bricks
• 28 LEGO plates
• Game board
• Instructions

G1753-1.desc:
The traditional game of Checkers comes alive with the bright colors of LEGO® DUPLO® bricks! Whether children are just learning to play Checkers for the first time or using the included bricks for their own creations, this set provides hours of fun and learning.
Includes 24 LEGO DUPLO bricks, game board and instructions.
Game board measures 10" x 10" (25.4cm x 25.4cm).
Safe and fun for children as young as 4 years old!
For 2 players.

G1754-1.desc:
The evil Piraka are searching Voya Nui for the Mask of Life -- can the Toa Inika find it first? Challenge your friends in a race for the mask in this exciting new BIONICLE board game. Play as any of the six Toa Inika and challenge the dangers of Voya Nui and the monstrous Hakann. But watch out -- other players may work together to try to stop you!
Features double-sided board, six exclusive Toa Inika game pieces, 50 quest cards, Piraka target card, launcher with zamor sphere, and one die.
Play as any of the 6 Toa Inika!

GBA275-1.desc: Embark on the ultimate BIONICLE adventure on the mysterious island of Voya Nui, through over 25 unique levels and 6 different elemental zones! Discover secret areas and hidden extras for a truly interactive experience that reveals something new every time you play! Play as any of the 6 Toa Inika, master all of their elemental powers and special weapons! Uncover and collect unique LEGO pieces to upgrade weapons and activate special abilities! Unlock special playable characters, such as the villainous Piraka! Battle classic foes like the Bohrok and Visorak! For Nintendo Game Boy Advance.

GBA960-1.desc: The power of the Force and the power of the Brick combine in the all-new LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy video game! This exciting sequel to LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game takes the fun and endless customization of LEGO and combines it with the epic story, characters and action from the revolutionary Star Wars: Episodes IV, V and VI! From Darth Vader's pursuit of Princess Leia aboard her Blockade Runner to Luke's final confrontation with Emperor Palpatine, you can build and battle your way through your favorite film moments! Includes all-new character-specific fighting moves, a cooperative multiplayer environment and adaptive difficulty levels! Experience more puzzles, adventure, humor and family-friendly LEGO action than ever before! For the first time, characters can get in and out of vehicles, as well as ride creatures! LEGO style lets you mix and match the body parts of more than 50 playable characters to create one of millions of possible LEGO Star Wars heroes!

This festive wrapping paper features images of the LEGO Santa Claus minifigure and a snow-covered LEGO tree on a background of drifting snowflakes. Includes 2 sturdy sheets of 27.5" (70cm) x 39" (100cm) wrapping paper. Also includes 2 matching gift tags.

GW980-1.desc: For birthdays, holidays and more, let them know there's LEGO fun in store! There's no better present than a LEGO set, and no finer way to wrap it than in LEGO wrapping paper! This gift wrap features images of classic LEGO themes like Police, Fire Rescue and Construction, set against a colorful background of studded LEGO pieces. Includes 2 sturdy sheets of 27.5" (70cm) x 39" (100cm) wrapping paper. Also includes 2 matching gift tags.

K2356-1.desc: Let the Toa Hordika guard your bed with this great, full-colour BIONICLE bedcover! A perfect gift for the BIONICLE fan in your life. Duvet cover measures 140 x 200 cm and pillowcase measures 50 x 75 cm.

K2357-1.desc: Let the Toa Hordika guard your bed with this great, full-colour BIONICLE bedcover! A perfect gift for the BIONICLE fan in your life. Duvet cover measures 140 x 200 cm and pillowcase measures 80 x 80 cm.

M229-1.desc: Decorate your refrigerator -- or other metal surface -- with LEGO Star Wars magnets! Set of fully posable minifigures includes Darth Vader, Chewbacca and Obi-Wan Kenobi.

M780-1.desc: Set of 3 fully-posable magnetic minifigures! Includes Batman, The Penguin and Two-Face.

MS1034-1.desc: Using the NXT Brick (sold separately), the Compass Sensor is able to measure the earth's magnetic field and calculates a magnetic heading to tell which direction your robot is facing. The compass has a built-in calibration to help reduce magnetic interference from other sources. Includes 1 Compass Sensor. Does not include connector cable. This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

TS40-1.desc: Send the Piraka running in fear when you wear this awesome Toa Inika t-shirt! Long sleeve, dark grey shirt features Toa Nuparu with lit laser drill. 100% cotton. Made in the USA. Available in youth sizes YS (6-8), YM (10-12), YL (14-16) and adult sizes AS, AM, AL, AXL.

W099-1.desc: It's the only watch you build yourself! Start with the silver-colored and black edged face, then choose from a yellow, blue or red bezel. Connect the watchband links in any pattern you choose. The cool metal hands have a TECHNIC-inspired look! Watch face measures 1" (2.5cm) in diameter. Include 40 watchband links: 10 Red, 10 Yellow, 10 Green, 10 Blue. Watch face has a silver-colored and black edge for a more grown up look! Includes 3 bezels: Red, Blue and Yellow.

W341-1.desc: Build your own amazing LEGO watch and more! Start out with the white face, then use the red, yellow and blue links to build the band in any size or pattern. The two links around the face feature standard LEGO studs for attaching the additional bricks and elements that are also included! Add more to your watch or create your own little LEGO creature! Includes 19 additional LEGO bricks and elements. Watch face measures 7/8" (2.2cm) wide and features red and blue numbers. Links on either side of the watch face feature LEGO studs for attaching more elements. Smooth fabric band measures 8" (20cm) long and has a standard buckle clasp. Includes removable red bezel with LEGO studs! Water-resistant to 165ft (50m). Battery included.
