10178-1.desc: Behold the power of the Empire! For the first time ever, the ultimate Motorized Walking AT-AT is ready to crush the Rebel Alliance at your command. Thanks to the Power Functions System, the mighty All-Terrain Armored Transport really walks forward or backward into battle! Features an opening cockpit and rotating laser cannons! Motorized Walking AT-AT really walks and its head moves up and down! Handle on top allows for easy transport! Stands over 12" (30cm) tall and over 14" (36cm) long Includes AT-AT Pilot, General Veers, Snowtrooper and Luke Skywalker with grappling line and lightsaber! Includes battery box and motor Requires 6 AA (1.5V) batteries, not included.

10179-1.desc: This is it - the biggest, most spectacular LEGO Star Wars model ever! Straight out of the classic Star Wars movies comes the Ultimate Collector's Millennium Falcon , Han Solo's famous smuggling starship. Every detail of the modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1300 freighter is here, all constructed to scale with LEGO minifigures. At almost 3 feet (90cm) long, it's the ultimate centerpiece to any Star Wars collection! With over 5,000 pieces, this is the biggest LEGO set ever made! Model is built completely to minifigure scale - minifigures can sit inside and man the controls! Landing gear provides a stable base for model to stand on! Ship is over 33" long, 22" wide and 8" tall! (84cm long x 56cm wide x 21cm tall) Radar dish rotates and elevates and boarding ramp extends! Top and bottom quad-laser turrets rotate for realistic play! Cockpit top can be removed to access minifigures! Includes 5 minifigures: Han Solo, Chewbacca, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia Organa! This special set also includes a display card with detailed ship specifications!

10181-1.desc: Created by popular demand, the LEGO Eiffel Tower is a stunning model for construction and display, built to 1:300 scale from the real tower's original blueprints. From the flag at the top to the elevators and other realistic details, this is as authentic as it gets. Eiffel Tower stands 42.5" (108 cm) high and base measures 20" x 20" (50 cm x 50 cm)! Can be disassembled in 3 sections for easy transport and storage!

10182-1.desc: Developed by LEGO fans and designers working together, this detailed and realistic street corner scene features plenty of special colors, rare LEGO pieces and creative building techniques, as well as authentic interior details and modular construction to let you enlarge the neighborhood as your LEGO collection grows. Built completely on minifigure scale! Includes 3 townspeople minifigures! Street base measures 10" x 10" (25.4 cm x 25.4 cm) and building stands over 14" (36 cm) high! Realistic features include opening front door, Café tables with umbrellas, striped awning, "Hotel" sign, trash can, street light, bench and more! Top two stories lift off to reveal inner rooms and staircases! Connectors at base of model allow you to join 4 Café Corners together!

tags: Lego Factory and Lego Design Byme

10190-1.desc: Designed by a LEGO fan, this realistic LEGO Factory exclusive features interesting colors and details like spiral staircases, awnings, removable balconies and a terrace roof. The modular construction allows you to put it together in different ways and to enlarge your LEGO town or city as your collection grows! Combine with set 10182 Café Corner to expand your LEGO neighborhood! Designed to minifigure scale! Includes 3 townspeople! Build each floor separately and put them together to complete the building! Top three stories lift off to reveal inner rooms and staircases! Street base measures 10" x 10" (25.4 cm x 25.4 cm) and the building stands 13"" (33 cm) high! Realistic features include opening doors and windows, gate, street light, striped awning, fruit to sell at the market and more! The set comes with printed building instructions which are also available online at www.LEGOFactory.com/buildinginstructions.
tags: Lego Factory and Lego Design Byme

3288-1.desc: Bob the Builder needs to put up a new building. Good thing he has Packer to help him out! Help Bob load the construction equipment onto Packer's trailer. Thanks to Packer and you, they'll be done in no time! Includes Bob the Builder and Packer!

3289-1.desc: Time to make sunflower oil in the sunflower factory! Muck and Roley will help Wendy get everything done in time. Safe and durable DUPLO pieces for younger hands! Includes Wendy, Muck and Roley!

tags: Lego Star Wars The Video Game

3352-1.desc: Salty the Dockyard Diesel carries cargo in his trailer from the docks to anywhere and everywhere on the Island of Sodor. DUPLO pieces are colorful, sturdy and safe for young hands. Includes Salty, trailer, and 2 pieces of cargo!

3353-1.desc: Straight from the Island of Sodor comes Spencer the speedy train and the famous Sir Topham Hatt! Whenever Sir Topham Hatt needs a really fast train, he calls for Spencer as he can drive to anywhere on the island in no time at all. Includes Spencer, Sir Topham Hatt, 12 pieces of track, signal house and tunnel entrance!

3354-1.desc: Chug, chug, chug! Here comes Gordon, the most powerful steam engine around! Build him and help him pull his passenger trailer all across the Island of Sodor. Safe, colorful and durable DUPLO pieces are perfect for little hands!

4206-1.desc: This set includes 21 track pieces, plus 6 train car connector magnets! Includes 17 Curved Rails for 9v Trains, 3 Straight Rails for 9v Trains, plus 1 right-side Switching Track for 9v Trains. This track is also compatible with LEGO RC Trains.

4494715-1.desc: It's the perfect gift for the adult fan of LEGO in your life! Set includes sturdy red LEGO brick-themed corkscrew and orange bottle opener. Dishwasher safe up to 150 degrees F (65 ºC). Each measures 4.5" (11.5cm) wide.

4498051-1.desc: What better way to put your LEGO wish list, drawing, or photo up on the fridge than with a magnet of your favourite football player!? Set includes 3 magnetic minifigures from the German, English and Brazilian team!

4524081-1.desc: The LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT software version 1.1 CD-ROM provides support for Windows Vista (both 32-bit and 64-bit) and Intel-based Mac computers. Programs and sound files are compiled more effectively and faster so they use less space on the NXT microcomputer. This CD includes the following languages: English, French, German, Dutch and Japanese.

4825-1.desc: It's a lovely day for a ride! The Princess takes her beautiful white horse out for a stroll in the countryside. You can brush her silky hair and take care of her pet cat, too! Includes Princess figure, pony, flowers, mirror and more! Bigger pieces are perfect for little hands!

4826-1.desc: Come and share an enchanted picnic with the Princess and her sweet pony friend at the royal summer pavilion. You can even brush their flowing hair! Includes Princess figure, pony, cat and more! Bigger pieces are perfect for little hands!

4828-1.desc: Time to play at the royal stables! Come and visit with the Princess and her magically beautiful ponies. You can brush their long hair and go on a wagon ride with the handsome prince! Includes Princess and Prince figures, with crowns! Includes 3 different ponies with tails you can brush! Bigger pieces are perfect for little hands!

4861-1.desc: Here comes the speedy LEGO DUPLO Police Boat! Help the police capture the escaping robber. Can you catch him before he reaches the lighthouse island? Includes 2 boats and 2 figures. Features safe and sturdy pieces for younger hands. Both boats really float!

4915-1.desc: These mighty mini machines are built for construction anywhere you take them! A great selection of LEGO pieces in a pocket-sized portable and reusable container lets you build any of the three models from the instructions one at a time, or create your own all-new vehicles on the go. Includes building instructions for 3 different models! Pieces come packed in a portable plastic container!

4916-1.desc: Create a whole zoo's worth of cool and crazy animals, one mini-model at a time! This fun selection of LEGO pieces comes in a pocket-sized container that you can carry with you anywhere. Instructions include directions for building three different creatures, and inspiration for many more! Includes building instructions for 3 different models! Pieces come packed in a portable plastic container!

4917-1.desc: These mini robots are tiny, tough and ready to go wherever you want them to be! With a great selection of LEGO pieces in a reusable pocket-sized container, you can build any of the three models from the instructions one at a time, or create all-new 'bots straight from your imagination. Includes building instructions for 3 different models! Pieces come packed in a portable plastic container!

4918-1.desc: Rocket into adventure with these fun and exciting mini flying vehicles! With a pocket-sized carrying container full of great LEGO pieces, instructions for building three air-themed models one at a time, and inspiration for many more, your imagination can take flight any time, any place! Includes building instructions for 3 different models! Pieces come packed in a portable plastic container!

4936-1.desc: Doctor, doctor! Help the sick patient get well with the LEGO City doctor. Includes 2 minifigures and exam table!

4939-1.desc: Get ready to build, then get ready to burn rubber! Cruise the roads in a cool yellow sports car with fully functional gull-wing doors, or take your creation apart and rebuild it into a sleek racecar or a mighty truck. Includes building instructions for all 3 models! With LEGO Creator, the possibilities are endless! Gull-wing doors and trunk really open! Main model measures 5.5 inches (14 cm) long!

4953-1.desc: These awesome LEGO creations are ready to fly! Build a realistic modern jet with movable wings and lots of great detailing. When you're done, take it apart and rebuild it into a helicopter or hovercraft! Includes a variety of bricks and elements in red, white and blue. Includes building Instructions for all 3 models. Helicopter rotors really spin! With LEGO Creator, the sky's the limit!

4954-1.desc: This detailed set includes instructions for 3 different models, plus all the pieces you'll need to create your own original model! Features a garage that opens and closes to store a sporty car, plus lots of roof pieces, windows and doors. Includes extra elements for light fixtures, chimney, flowers and tons more to create the house of your dreams! Lift off the roof to see inside! Garage door opens and closes! Model Town House stands 9" (23 cm) high! Includes instructions to build 3 different models!

4955-1.desc: Build a Big Rig equipped with heavy-duty tires, adjustable mirrors and doors that open. Includes instructions to rebuild into a fast go-cart or a convertible with doors that really open! Lift up the front to see the truck's engine! Model measures 11" (28 cm) long! Includes instructions to build all 3 models!

4956-1.desc: Build the house of your dreams with LEGO Creator! This spectacular set includes instructions for 3 different house models, plus all the parts you'll need to design your own original creations. Add a garage, driveway and fence in the yard - the possibilities are endless! Features plenty of pieces for roofs, walls, doors, windows, even trees and gardens! Lift off the roof to see inside! Add a mailbox, porch lights and other realistic details! Includes building instructions for 3 models and inspiration for more!

4957-1.desc: Build a Ferris Wheel that really spins and has carts that sway back and forth! Features a ticket booth, micro people, trees and baseplates to complete the scene. Ferris Wheel measures over 17" (43 cm) wide and 18" (46 cm) high! Includes a 10" x 10" (25 cm x 25 cm) baseplate and a 5" x 10" (13 cm x 25 cm) baseplate! Includes battery box and motor to make models really move! Includes instructions to rebuild into a moveable drawbridge or a working building crane! Requires 6 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included.

4958-1.desc: Build a roaring and walking dino creature that has a glow-in-the-dark spine! Monster Dino's arms and mouth really move! Includes instructions to rebuild into a spider that crawls or a crocodile that really moves! Includes remote control, battery box, receiver, two motors and sound brick! Requires 3 AAA (1.5v) and 6 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included.

4972-1.desc: It's time to feed the animals! Help the boy take care of his playful farm pals. Includes dog, cow, sheep, piglet and wheelbarrow with pretend grass and hay bricks.

4973-1.desc: Time to bring in the harvest! Help the farmer drive his big red harvester through the fields to 'make' hay bale bricks. Vehicle's drum rotates when it rolls!

4974-1.desc: It's always a fun time at the LEGO Ville stables! The children can sit on the two friendly horses or go for a ride in the pony-drawn cart. There are carrots and a silver trophy cup for the best horses in town, plus a kitty too!

4975-1.desc: It's always busy here at the LEGO Ville farm! There's plenty of work to do, but thanks to the manual conveyor belt, quad bike, friendly farm animals and DUPLO bricks to stack and play with, there's lots of imagination and fun, too!

4976-1.desc: Heavy duty work is no problem for this construction worker and his tough cement mixer. Mixer can turn and tip manually for lots of construction fun!

4977-1.desc: It's an emergency! Drive the brave firefighting team to the scene and put out the fire. Sturdy, colorful fire truck has working siren and a movable ladder to help you save the day!

4978-1.desc: The colorful Road Sweeper is here to clean the streets of LEGO® Ville! Brush really spins when you push vehicle forward. Includes a friendly figure and extra bricks to sweep up! LEGO DUPLO® pieces are safe and sturdy for younger hands.

4979-1.desc: There's no need to fear when this fun ambulance is on the scene! With a siren with real lights and sounds, everyone will know help is on the way. Includes a doctor's bag and stretcher, too!

4981-1.desc: At the Chum Bucket, Plankton hatches his evil plans to steal the Krabby Patty recipe. With the help of his computer, he'll use his spinning brainwasher, the Krabby Patty analyzer and even a robotic SpongeBob to get it! Includes SpongeBob and Plankton, plus Plankton's Burger Walker, Robot SpongeBob and a robot customer!

4982-1.desc: SpongeBob needs to get his boating license, so it's off to Mrs. Puff's Boating School! But will the school still be standing when he's done? Pull back SpongeBob's boat and let go to send him zooming down the driving course and through the brick wall. SpongeBob's boat has a pull-back motor! Crash through the wall and get past the anchor in the driving course! Lighthouse has a light that spins! Includes SpongeBob, Mrs. Puff and Patrick minifigures!

4986-1.desc: No job is too tough for this Digger! With its big working treads, rotating cabin, moving arm and tilting shovel, it can reach every corner of the construction site. LEGO® DUPLO® pieces are safe and sturdy for younger hands!

4987-1.desc: Welcome to the LEGO Ville Gravel Pit! Scoop up the bricks with the digger's big shovel, drop them onto the working conveyor belt, and transport them through the chute into the dumper below. Includes 2 vehicles, 2 figures and much more! LEGO DUPLO pieces are safe and sturdy for younger hands.

4988-1.desc: Help the construction workers build a new house in LEGO Ville! Drive up in the transport truck, unload it with the big crane, and use the front-end loader to carry 'cement' to the mixer. The house is almost done! Includes 3 figures and 2 vehicles. Features safe and sturdy LEGO DUPLO bricks.

5378-1.desc:
Harry and his friends are back for their fifth year at Hogwarts™, and they have a new defense against the Dark Arts professor, the evil Dolores Umbridge.
• Discover all the rooms of Hogwarts Castle!
• Find the hidden book, document and envelope!
• Retrieve the confiscated items in Umbridge's office!
• Includes greenhouse!
• Includes 2 Thestrals!
• Includes Professor Snape™, Death Eater, Hagrid™, Hermione Granger™, Harry Potter™, Draco Malfoy™, Professor Umbridge™, Professor Dumbledore™ and Ron Weasley™ minifigures!

5380-1.desc: Younger builders will have hours, weeks and years of imaginative construction and play with this box of DUPLO bricks. This collection of safe, colorful pieces includes a building plate, a wheeled car body, a DUPLO figure and much more, plus a sturdy box with a transparent lid for storage! Includes large 8 stud x 8 stud blue DUPLO building plate! Includes 1 DUPLO figure!

5416-1.desc:
Colorful and creative play!
Creativity starts with LEGO® DUPLO® bricks! These safe, durable pieces are perfect for young hands and imaginative minds. Includes a cat, a window, flowers, and lots of bricks for building, all in a sturdy storage box with lid.

5417-1.desc: This deluxe DUPLO set is the perfect introduction to creative building and play for younger children. Storage box with transparent lid includes a building plate and lots and lots of safe, durable and colorful construction bricks, with plenty of special shapes and designs to help imaginations grow. Includes large 8 stud x 16 stud DUPLO baseplate! Includes lots of special elements like windows, a swing, wagon bottom and more! Also includes 1 DUPLO figure!

5419-1.desc: Younger builders can make a farm with lots of friendly animals and even a rolling tractor! Colorful DUPLO bricks are sturdy and safe for small hands. Imagination starts here!! Farmer figure included.

5515-1.desc: Build people, animals, and anything else you can imagine with this collection of LEGO bricks in fun shapes and colors. 240-piece set includes bricks in blue, white, red, yellow, green and black, plus specially decorated pieces for even more building fun.

6161-1.desc:
A perfect introduction to LEGO® building!
This sturdy storage box with lid includes everything an imaginative builder needs to get started making lots of fun and fantastic creations. With a great selection of colorful and classic LEGO® bricks, plus a booklet full of building instructions and inspirations, it’s the perfect way to expand a LEGO collection, or begin a brand-new one!
Includes Idea Book with building instructions and inspirations

6162-1.desc: LEGO Mosaic is a great new way to build color, artistic and creative skills while having fun at the same time! Follow the instructions to build 4 different mosaics, or use your imagination to create even more with colorful LEGO pieces. Display your creation or take it apart and start on your next masterpiece! The possibilities are endless. Includes a special 5" x 5" (12.7cm x 12.7cm) transparent baseplate for building over your favorite image. Includes building instructions for 4 different models and inspiration for more! Build 2D or 3D models! Includes coupling plate for hanging your creation!

6163-1.desc: Build, rebuild and display your favorite LEGO Mosaic creations over and over again! You'll have fun while developing color, artistic and creative skills with this unique new system of LEGO building. Includes instructions for 9 different mosaics, plus lots of extra LEGO pieces in different shapes, colors and sizes to spark active imaginations! Includes 2 special 5" x 5" (12.7cm x 12.7cm) transparent baseplates for building over your favorite images. Create 2 mosaics at once or join both baseplates together for a larger image surface! Includes building instructions for 9 different models and inspiration for more! Build 2D or 3D models! Includes 2 coupling plates for hanging your creations!

6164-1.desc: Build a fire station and fire truck, a hospital with an ambulance, a rescue helicopter, or anything else you can imagine with the ultimate rescue building set. Plenty of LEGO pieces included for unlimited building possibilities. In addition to bricks and plates of all colors and sizes, this set also features wheels, windows, doors and much more!! Includes Idea Book with building instructions for 6 models and inspiration for dozens more!! Includes one minifigure!

6166-1.desc:
The building possibilities are endless!
With a transparent lid and a great selection of LEGO® pieces, this big storage box lets builders create at home or on the go. The colorful and classic collection of bricks also includes a LEGO minifigure, base plate, wheels and special house elements!
Includes Idea Book of building instructions and inspirations
Includes a 16 stud x 16 stud green baseplate
Also includes 1 minifigure

6167-1.desc: This big, durable storage box features a transparent lid and is filled with LEGO elements in lots of shapes, colors and styles. With a large base plate, 2 LEGO minifigures and special house and vehicle pieces, builders will have enough for years of imagination, creativity and fun! Includes Idea Book with building instructions and inspiration! Includes 16 stud x 32 stud green baseplate! Also includes 2 minifigures!

66175-1.desc: Save the day in LEGO City by land, sea or air with this special collection! Includes: 7236 Police Car 7238 Fire Helicopter 7890 Ambulance 7944 Fire Hovercraft Purchase them all together and SAVE!

66208-1.desc: From 'Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium' comes Mr. Magorium's Big Book! Packed with fun and traditional building, this set includes pieces and instructions to let you create 9 classic LEGO models, including a shark, speed boat, jet, truck, and more!

66254-1.desc:
Introducing the LEGO® Star Wars™ Luke Skywalker Pilot minifigure maquette – a great collectible for the grown-up LEGO Star Wars fan, just in time for the holiday season! This limited-edition maquette comes with a Certificate of Authenticity and features a removable, magnetic head and logo plate, and stands 6" high.
• Luke Skywalker Maquette stands 6" high, 4½" wide and 4½" deep!
• Magnetic attachment allows Luke's head to turn in any direction!
• Includes Certificate of Authenticity!
• Great gift for adult LEGO Star Wars collectors!
• Please note: Due to the magnetic features and polyresin construction of this figure, it is intended as a display collectible only and should not be used as a toy.

7009-1.desc: The tournament has begun! Who will be victorious in the final joust, the brave knight on horseback, or the evil skeleton rider? Includes knight and skeleton minifigures, 2 horses and a rack with extra weapons for battle!

7029-1.desc: Evil skeleton warriors are attacking in their haunted ship with tattered sails and glow-in-the-dark pieces! Help the knights protect the harbor's hidden treasure and fight back with a working catapult and trap! Harbor playset can be combined in different ways for more battles and adventures. This special-edition LEGO Castle set includes an exclusive Skeleton Captain figure and his pet rat!

7036-1.desc: The dwarves are working hard mining, transporting and hiding rare diamonds and gems, but can they protect their treasure from the evil troll warriors and the giant troll? This special-edition set includes a rolling mine cart, a wheel powered bucket and launching catapult to fire at the attacking trolls! Includes 4 dwarves, 2 troll warriors, a giant troll and lots of accessories! Giant troll is 3" (8 cm) tall!

7090-1.desc: It's a battle of brave knights against the evil skeleton rider! Includes 2 knights, skeleton and a skeleton horse! Rolling wagon has a launcher that really fires!

7091-1.desc: Who goes there? The brave knights of the kingdom do! Defend the castle and demolish the skeleton warriors' barricade with the knights' powerful firing catapult. Includes 2 knights and 2 skeleton minifigures!

7092-1.desc: The evil skeleton warriors have captured one of the good knights and are racing off with him in their armored prison carriage. Can the knight on horseback defeat the skeletons and set his friend free? Includes 2 knights, 3 skeletons, horse and 3 skeleton horses! Horse and carriage measures 18" (46cm) long!

7093-1.desc: At the sinister Skeleton Tower, the evil Wizard plots his next move to capture the castle. To defeat the villains and rescue the imprisoned Princess, the brave knight must face the fire-breathing dragon and enter the lowering skull jaw gate. Includes dragon, wizard, knight, princess, horse and 2 skeletons! Dragon measures 14" (36cm) long and has a 13" (33cm) wingspan! Dragon's wings move up and down! Skeleton Tower stands 11" (28cm) high! Turn the crank to raise and lower the bridge! Launch rocks at the intruders! Save the princess from the hanging skeleton prison! Watch out for the evil wizard and his crystal ball!

7094-1.desc: From this mighty Castle, the good King rules over all he surveys. Help him defend his kingdom against the evil skeleton warriors and their powerful flying dragon! Raise the drawbridge, launch the catapults to fire boulders at attackers, and knock over the bridge to send skeletons to their doom! Includes treasure chest, dungeon, dragon, 4 knights, 4 skeletons, king and more! Protect the treasure chest of jewels! King has gold-colored crown and sword! Castle measures 12" (31cm) tall and 15" (38cm) wide! Lower the bridge and gate to keep the skeletons out! Lock the skeletons in the castle prison! Evil dragon is 13" (33cm) long and has a 13" (33cm) wingspan!

7580-1.desc: The royal pond has frozen, and that means it's time for ice skating! Join the Princess and her bunny friend as they sleigh down the snowy banks to the ice skating pond for a wonderful winter afternoon. Includes Princess figure with sparkly winter dress! Includes lots of special elements and colorful stickers!

7581-1.desc: The snow is freshly fallen, and it's time for the Princesses to visit their beautiful horses at the elegant royal stables! Dress them up in their beautiful winter dresses and they're ready to go riding for hours! Feed the horses carrots or apples from the feed table and stow the riding gear in the chest. The riding fun never ends! Set includes stables, 2 Princesses, 2 horses and more! Includes lots of special elements and colorful stickers!

7582-1.desc: The royal family is taking a trip to the Royal Summer Palace to relax in the beautiful surroundings! Take a romantic boat ride on the lake or have tea in the courtyard. Includes King, Queen and Baby Princess figures! Includes lots of special elements and colorful stickers!

7654-1.desc: The Trade Federation is on the march! Send your Separatist forces into battle against the Republic with a droid transport carrier and 'hovering' STAP vehicle, complete with a full squad of armed and combat-ready battle droids. Set includes 4 Battle Droid and 3 Super Battle Droid minifigures! Build your own army and stage a battle against the #7655 Clone Troopers Battle Pack!

7655-1.desc: The Clone Wars are on! When the Separatists attack, the Republic fights back with its legions of Clone Troopers. Build your army with an assortment of battle-ready troopers, complete with a blaster turret and speeder bike! Set includes Shock Trooper, Star Corps Trooper and 2 Clone Trooper minifigures. Build your own army and stage a battle against the #7654 Droids Battle Pack!

7656-1.desc: General Grievous is on the loose! The sleek lines of the droid general's personal starfighter hide its impressive firepower. Now you can build it yourself, straight out of Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith! Features sliding cockpit, folding tail landing gear, lightsaber holder and flip-up laser cannons. Includes General Grievous minifigure with blaster and 4 lightsabers. Store the landing gear and lightsabers underneath the craft for flight!

7657-1.desc: Move out with the All-Terrain Scout Transport (AT-ST)! Patrol the forests of Endor or the ice fields of Hoth with this all-new version of the Imperial scout walker. Features side-mounted weapons and an opening pilot hatch straight from the movies. Turn the knob to make the cockpit rotate side to side! Includes AT-ST pilot minifigure with helmet and blaster! Features side-mounted weapon pods!

7658-1.desc: Here comes the Rebel Y-wing starfighter! This all-new model of the classic Star Wars vehicle is packed with incredible movie-accurate details, from its twin nose-mounted laser cannons and movable cockpit turret to its droid co-pilot and extended engine nacelles. It can even drop 'bombs' on Imperial targets! Includes Rebel pilot and astromech droid minifigures. All-new model features incredible, realistic details!

7659-1.desc: Battle the forces of the Rebellion wherever they hide! Equipped with twin blaster cannons, 'bombs,' a troop compartment and firing rockets, the Imperial Landing Craft is ready to deploy your forces anywhere in the galaxy. Gear system lets wings fold up together at the twist of a dial! Includes Imperial pilot, 2 Sandtrooper and 2 Stormtrooper minifigures with blasters.

7660-1.desc: Defend the world of Naboo in the Naboo Starfighter against the might of the Vulture Droid! Send Anakin Skywalker or the Naboo Fighter Pilot up the access ladder to pilot the Starfighter. Raise R2-D2 into the droid socket and fire the missile at the Vulture Droid! Enemy droid starfighter features flick-launching missiles and converts into flying, attack and walker modes! Use the drop function to release R2-D2! Naboo N-1 Starfighter measures 15" (38 cm) long! Includes Anakin Skywalker, Naboo Fighter Pilot, and R2-D2 minifigures!

7661-1.desc: When Jedi Knights need to cross the galaxy in a hurry, they attach their Jedi Starfighters to hyperdrive booster rings and head into hyperspace! Remove the Jedi Starfighter from the ring and you'll find it has retractable landing gear, multi-position wings and a cockpit that opens. Hyperdrive booster ring features flick-launching missiles and opening starfighter connection plates! Hyperdrive booster ring measures 11.5" (29 cm) wide and 10" (25 cm) tall! Includes Obi-Wan Kenobi and the first ever Kit Fisto minifigure!

7662-1.desc: When the Trade Federation MTT shows up, it's time for the enemy to start running! Open its hatches and extend the secret storage rack to deploy a legion of battle droids, armed and ready to fight. Top opens to reveal pilot cabin and steering controls. Open the hatch in the back to reveal a battle droid carrier vehicle! Open the sides to see inside! Turn gear on side to extend the storage rack and deploy the battle droids! Trade Federation MTT has hidden wheels for easy movement! Includes 16 regular battle droids, 2 red security battle droids, 2 blue pilot battle droids and a destroyer droid! Trade Federation MTT measures 16" (41 cm) long and 10" (25 cm) high!

7663-1.desc: The Sith have returned! Darth Maul gives pursuit in the Sith Infiltrator, a sinister starship with folding wings and launching missiles. Extend the landing gear and open the hatches to reveal a Sith speeder vehicle, 3 stealthy probe droids, and all the equipment a Sith Lord needs to hunt down his prey wherever they hide! Fire the flick-launching missiles! Includes Darth Maul minifigure! Sith Infiltrator measures 10" (25 cm) long!

7664-1.desc: TIE fighters aren't just a danger in space! From the Star Wars Expanded Universe comes the TIE Crawler, a powerful ground vehicle with working treads that move independently for rough terrain. Fire the missiles and hidden cannons, or rotate the treads to rise high above the battlefield. Fire the flick-launching missile underneath the TIE Crawler! Open the cockpit and put the Shadow stormtrooper at the controls! Includes 2 all-new Shadow stormtrooper minifigures! TIE Crawler is 8" (21 cm) long and 10" (25 cm) wide!

7665-1.desc: The limited edition Republic Cruiser is ready to shuttle Jedi Knights, ambassadors and diplomats to trouble spots all across the galaxy! The famous red starship from Star Wars Episode I features an opening cockpit, extending hidden blaster cannons, rotating sensor dish, landing gear, detachable escape pod, and more. Roof removes to reveal detailed interior with cargo containers and space speeder mini-vehicle! Includes Obi-Wan Kenobi, Qui-Gon Jinn, and all-new Republic Pilot, Republic Captain, and R2-R7 astromech droid minifigures.

7666-1.desc: The Empire has discovered the secret Rebel base on Hoth! Defend Echo Base with the snowspeeder and firing laser turret. Turn the gear to open the sliding blast doors, but watch out for the Imperial probe droid and the snowtroopers with their blaster cannon! Limited edition set features detailed command center, rotating repair platform and crane and removable spare engine. Includes 7 LEGO minifigures: Luke Skywalker, co-pilot Dak Ralter, 2 Hoth Rebel troopers, 2 Imperial Snowtroopers and all-new K-3PO protocol droid.

7690-1.desc: Aliens are attacking the MB-01 Eagle Command Base on Mars! Fight back with air-powered missiles, then turn the air pump to transfer captured aliens and energy crystals through the base's tubes. Launch the high-tech shuttle to battle the alien ship! Complete base set includes alien transport pods, alien attack ship, futuristic space shuttle and air pump system! Includes 4 foam missiles that are safe for play! Includes 4 astronaut minifigures and 4 glow-in-the-dark alien minifigures! Space shuttle stands 15" (38cm) high! Examine captured aliens on the command base!

7691-1.desc: It's the ultimate 4-in-1 alien strike ship! With its advanced weaponry, firing missile and three detachable attack vehicles, the giant ETX Alien Mothership will stop at nothing to steal energy crystals from the Mars Mission team. Can the astronauts fight back with their defense station's launching air-powered missiles? Includes separating Alien Mothership, defense station, air pump system and 4 foam missiles that are safe for play! Includes 2 astronauts and 5 glow-in-the-dark alien minifigures! Push down on the air pump system to fire the foam missiles! Move the drill back and forth to find energy crystals! Alien Mothership has a launcher that really fires!

7692-1.desc: When the going gets tough, the Mars Mission team calls in the MX-71 Recon Dropship! Cruising across the Martian surface, the dropship can carry captured aliens back to base and deliver its mining vehicle cargo anywhere it needs to go. Includes Recon Dropship, mining vehicle and alien ship! Includes 2 astronaut minifigures and 4 glow-in-the-dark alien minifigures! Fire MX-71 Recon Dropship's missile to battle the alien attack ship! Detach the mining vehicle to drill for energy crystals! Watch out for the alien attack ship's rotating shooters!

7693-1.desc: In its sneaky stealth mode, the ETX Alien Strike ship flies in to steal energy crystals from the Mars Mission mining vehicle, equipped with a drill and alien transport sled. Then it transforms to attack mode to unleash its full firepower! Includes alien strike ship and mining vehicle! Includes astronaut minifigure and 2 glow-in-the-dark alien minifigures! Open the Alien Strike ship to attack mode to see its shooters!

7694-1.desc: The Mars Mission team can transport energy crystals and captured aliens anywhere across the Martian surface with the all-terrain MT-31 Trike vehicle with working suspension system! Includes astronaut minifigure and glow-in-the-dark alien minifigure! Trike has all terrain wheels and suspension!

7695-1.desc: With its laser cannon and moveable wings, the high-speed MX-11 Astro Fighter can scout for energy crystals and take the battle against the aliens to the skies. Includes astronaut minifigure and alien minifigure that really glows in the dark!

7697-1.desc: With its disc shooter, storage tanks, and a powerful claw for capturing crystals and alien attackers, the hi-tech MT-51 Claw-Tank is ready to defend the Mars Mission team against the alien strike ship. Includes futuristic mining tank, alien strike ship, astronaut minifigure and 2 glow-in-the-dark alien minifigures! Features working treads, rolling wheels and poseable arms to vanquish any foe! Load and launch the disk shooter! MT-51 Claw-Tank turns 360 degrees to capture any alien!

7699-1.desc: Rumbling across the rocky surface of Mars, it's the MT-101 Armored Drilling Unit! With 2 detachable flyers to scout and protect the main unit, this special-edition mining tank is really 3 vehicles in 1. Includes a drilling arm to dig for energy crystals, a sphere-launching blaster, alien capture tubes, and 6 big wheels with working independent suspension for rough terrain! Plus an alien attack ship out to steal the crystals!

7721-1.desc: Look out, EXO-FORCE -- here comes the special-edition Combat Crawler X2! This massive mechanical menace packs twice the danger and twice the firepower, because it's two mighty battle machines in one! In combined mode, it scales the cliffs of Sentai Mountain or the walls of the Golden City with its clawed legs, prison capture cage and powerful firing cannon, but when the battle gets tough, its front end detaches to fight as a raging robot battle machine of its own! It's up to Ryo and his missile-launching strike flyer to stop them both…if he can! Combat Crawler X2 has a prison transport and a missile that really fires! Detach the battle machine in front to send it to battle on its own! Includes Ryo minifigure with his strike flyer that really launches a missile! Includes special code to unlock extra content at www.EXO-FORCE.com.

7771-1.desc: What's that light shining in the darkness of the ocean depths? Is it hidden treasure? No, it's a giant anglerfish -- and it's hungry! Can the divers drill out the ancient coins hidden in the rock and escape the creature's gaping jaws and glowing fangs? It'll take all the speed of their mini-sub to succeed! Includes 2 diver minifigures! Anglerfish features glow-in-the-dark fangs!

7772-1.desc: This high-tech underwater exploration rover has it all: working treads, a robot arm, and a drill for collecting precious undersea crystals. But do it and its crew of two have what it takes to fight off the giant lobster? With its huge size, armored body and giant claws, this creepy crustacean means business! Includes 2 diver minifigures! Lobster's legs, tail and claws really move! Rover has a spinning drill and "robot" arm that moves! Open the rover's hatch to seat the operator at the controls!

7773-1.desc: The crew of this trident-tipped battle submarine has discovered a jewel-encrusted treasure deep beneath the sea. Unfortunately, it's in the path of a giant tiger shark! Will the divers' harpoon cannon and firing aqua-missile be enough to survive the shark's ferocious teeth and powerful thrashing tail? Includes 2 diver minifigures! Shark features a jointed body for realistic movement! Shark has jaws that really chomp! Battle sub has a launcher that really fires! Open the sub's hatch to take a seat at the controls!

7774-1.desc:
Here comes the biggest Aqua Raiders submarine of all! Equipped for undersea adventures with cannons, harpoons, a detachable mini-sub and a launching aqua-missile, this aquatic explorer is the king of the depths…at least until it encounters the giant monster crab! Now it's a fight to the finish between submarine and savage sea beast. Better hope the crew doesn't end up like that old pirate skeleton and his treasure!
Includes 2 diver minifigures and skeleton!
Sub measures 10.5" (26 cm) long!
Press to fire the sub's undersea launcher!
Open the sub's hatch to take a seat at the controls!
Launch the mini-sub!
Giant crab has legs and claws that really move!
Crab measures a huge 6.5" (16.5 cm) wide!
Skeleton guards his sunken treasure!

7775-1.desc: Constructed on the sea bed deep beneath the waves, the hi-tech Aqua Raiders headquarters has a vehicle dock, a control station and crane arm, a mini-sub launching ramp, and an exploration pod for deep-sea missions. Good thing it's protected by plenty of harpoon cannons and a firing aqua-rocket, because a giant squid is on the attack! With posable tentacles and a skeleton in its transparent belly, this sea monster will be tough for the Aquabase crew to beat. Includes 4 diver minifigures and skeleton! Giant squid's tentacles open and close! Man the harpoon turret and press to fire the launcher! Deploy the mini-sub from the launching ramp! Take the exploration pod for an undersea mission! Have a cup of coffee at the control panel!

7776-1.desc: Deep below the waves, the Aqua Raiders have discovered a long-lost shipwreck with an ancient king's fortune in gold and jewels. Help the deep-sea divers use their high-tech sub's robotic arms and working magnetic collector to pick up the sunken treasure, but watch out for the poisonous sea snakes and the ship's falling mast! Includes 2 diver minifigures and 1 skeleton! Open the hatch to seat a diver at the controls! Use the sub's magnetic arm to pick up the treasure!

7786-1.desc: The evil Scarecrow is on the loose, spreading fear gas from his biplane! But Batman is ready to stop him in his high-tech Batcopter. Can Batman use his Batcopter missiles to stop Scarecrow before he drops his fear gas bombs? You decide! Propellers really spin! Launch Batcopter's missile! Includes Batman and Scarecrow minifigures!

7787-1.desc: The evil Bane and The Riddler have teamed up to make trouble for Gotham City! It's up to Batman to stop them in his new Bat-Tank! Use the Bat-Tank's missiles to smash Bane's hideout and bring the criminals to justice. Launch Bat-Tank's missile to break through the chained fence to get into Bane's hideout! Bat-Tank has flick-fire missiles! Bat-Tank measures 10" (25 cm) long! Includes Batman, The Riddler and Bane minifigures, plus accessories!

7876-1.desc: Add a cement truck to your LEGO construction site with this special set!

7906-1.desc: With its real working motor, the LEGO City Fireboat races to the rescue! This big fire-fighting boat really floats and moves on water and features lots of authentic details like a water cannon, emergency lights and pilot controls to help you put out the 'blaze'. Includes 3 fully-equipped firefighter minifigures! Boat measures 16" (41 cm) long! Use the winch to lower the emergency rescue raft into the water! Includes real working motor! Motor requires 1 AA (1.5v) battery, not included.

7907-1.desc: It's 24 days of LEGO building fun with the LEGO City Advent Calendar! Includes 24 city-themed surprises for the season, including LEGO minifigures, accessories and more! Each day open a new window in the specially designed Advent Calendar box to reveal a new set - 24 in all! Models include LEGO City equipment and minifigures, plus a tree, fireplace and more!

7942-1.desc:
Ready for off-road rescues!
No matter where the emergency is, the fire chief is ready to speed to the scene and save the day! Set includes fire chief’s off-road fire rescue truck, trailer, and lots of great firefighting equipment!
Inlcudes fire chief minifigure to take command of your rescue team!

7944-1.desc: The fire hovercraft is ready to save the day! The hovercraft has wheels for dry land, and can move in any direction -- so you're ready wherever adventures takes you! The firefighters on board have lots of accessories and tools for any rescue situation! Hovercraft measures 11" (28cm) long! Rear fans and lift turbines really spin! Deck hoses rotate to fight fire in all directions! Control seat roof lifts off to seat the captain at the wheel! Turn the knob on the deck's storage container to lift the lid and access more tools! Includes three firefighter minifigures with life preservers and gear!

7945-1.desc: When the fire alarm sounds, it's time for action! This fire station has everything you'll need to save the day, from a central station with control and alarm rooms, to two garages with working doors, to a team of brave firefighters and a pair of realistic firefighting vehicles. Race to the rescue in the big fire truck and fire chief's car! Truck's ladder extends to 15 inches (39 cm). Includes 4 firefighter minifigures with equipment! Raise and lower the garage doors! Climb the ladder to the highest window! Set is divided into sub-models for easy building and instant play!

7990-1.desc: Get ready to build some new houses in LEGO City! Pull out the long flexible hose, rotate the drum to mix the cement and pour it out! Includes worker minifigure and accessories! Cement drum really turns! Truck measures 7" (18 cm) long!

7991-1.desc: Keep your LEGO City clean and tidy with this realistic Recycle Truck! Sweep up the rubble then use the double tipping function to collect and unload trash and recycling. Container detaches from the cab! Store the recycle can on the back of the container for easy transport! Use the platform on back to hop on and off! Includes worker minifigure, plus recycle can, cart and accessories! Truck measures 7" (18 cm) long!

7992-1.desc: When it's time to unload cargo or clean up the docks in LEGO City, the Container Stacker is ready to do the heavy lifting! Raise and extend the boom, then lift the containers to put them in their place! Boom extends 8" (21 cm) long and lifts 7" (18 cm) high! Includes 2 containers, pallet, cargo and worker minifigure!

7993-1.desc: The Service Station is at the center of LEGO City, ready to take care of all of your vehicles' needs! Fill up your tank at the gas pump, take it through the carwash, and then buy a snack in the shop - the hours of play are endless! Includes special road baseplate! Check the gas price on the board before filling up! Car wash brushes spin to get your car clean! Includes 3 minifigures, plus a car and motorcycle!

7994-1.desc: Drop the anchor, the cargo ship is at the LEGO City Harbor. Use the massive pier crane and cargo truck to empty the cargo ship and get it ready for its next destination. Cargo ship really floats! Cargo ship measures 23" (58 cm) long! Raise and lower the ship's anchor! Crane is over 19" (48 cm) tall! Crane spins 360 degrees! Crane arm moves side to side and up and down! Raise and lower the crane's hook to load and unload containers! Port measures 27" (69 cm) long! Includes 2 containers, pallet, cargo truck and speed boat! Includes captain, fisherman, 3 worker minifigures and lots of accessories!

7996-1.desc: Make your RC railway bigger and more advanced with the Train Rail Crossing set. Includes 2 crossing halves with control switch. Tracks do not conduct electricity and therefore are not compatible with LEGO 9v Trains.

7997-1.desc: The Train Station is busy with trains coming and going. Passengers are waiting on the platform for the next train to arrive in LEGO City. Buy a ticket, enter through the turnstiles, and get your luggage ready for the next departure. Ride the rail car along the track! Have a cup of coffee or look at the map while you wait for the train! Includes 4 RC track pieces and 5 minifigures!

7998-1.desc: The Heavy Hauler is ready to tackle any job in LEGO City! Load it up, attach the trailer and rumble off to your destination. Once there, use the truck's tipping function to unload your cargo and move on to the next job! Complete truck includes cab, dump truck bed, plus a second container for hauling extra large loads! Both truck beds lift and stay in position! Store the tire stops in the side compartment! With the extra container attached, this truck is 20" (50 cm) long! Includes driver minifigure!

8100-1.desc: With plenty of firepower and a rotating defensive shield, the Cyclone Defender provides the humans with an edge in battle! Includes Ryo minifigure. Spin the gear to rotate the shield and drive back robot attackers! Includes special web code to unlock exclusive content at www.EXO-FORCE.com Cyclone Defender stands 5" (13 cm) tall! .

8101-1.desc: Armed with rotating laser cannons and gigantic ripping claws, these mini robot Battle Machines are a great threat in close combat! Includes Devastator robot minifigure. Watch out for its massive claws! Also includes a special web code to unlock exclusive content at www.EXO-FORCE.com. Claw Crusher stands 5" (13 cm) tall!

8102-1.desc: Unstoppable swarms of robots mean nothing to the mighty Blade Titan! With the brave warrior Takeshi as its pilot, this massively armored EXO-FORCE battle machine carries an arsenal of heavy-duty weapons and a double-bladed assault shield that expands and rotates at the turn of a gear. Time to slice and dice! Includes Takeshi minifigure. Turn the gear to expand and spin the assault shield! Also includes special web code to unlock exclusive content at www.EXO-FORCE.com. Blade Titan stands over 11" (28 cm) tall!

8103-1.desc: EXO-FORCE soars to victory with the high-flying Sky Guardian! Piloted by sharp-shooting Hikaru, this multi-winged, jet-powered battle machine is the fastest and most agile opponent the robots have ever faced. What the Sky Guardian's long-range launching energy sphere doesn't take care of, its massive armor-slicing sword will! Includes Hikaru minifigure and 2 energy spheres! Press to launch the long-range energy sphere shooter! Also includes special web code to unlock exclusive content at www.EXO-FORCE.com. Sky Guardian stands over 11" (28 cm) tall!

8104-1.desc: No cliff is too high to climb for the Shadow Crawler, the robots' most dangerous and sinister new creation. With its energy disc shooter, laser cannons and missiles, this stealthy three-legged battle machine is a major threat to the EXO-FORCE team. The skeleton in its prison pod is proof enough of that! Includes Devastator robot pilot minifigure and skeleton! Spider-like legs crawl up any terrain! Launch the rapid-fire disk shooter! Also includes special web code to unlock exclusive content at www.EXO-FORCE.com. Shadow Crawler is 14" (36 cm) wide and over 7" (18 cm) high!

8105-1.desc: With a metallic screech, swarms of Iron Condors dive to attack the heroes of EXO-FORCE! Equipped with massive mechanical wings and supersonic speed, these fast and fearless robot battle machines are programmed to conquer the Golden City at any cost. Watch out for their razor-sharp talons and firing missile! Includes Devastator robot pilot minifigure! Press to launch the blunt shooter! Also includes special web code to unlock exclusive content at www.EXO-FORCE.com. Iron Condor stands over 11 '½" (29 cm) tall!

8106-1.desc: When EXO-FORCE needs air support, they call in the incredible Aero Booster! Piloted by daredevil aerial ace Ha-Ya-To, this powered-up battle machine rules the skies. A detachable booster pack rockets it into action with 3 gigantic turbojet engines, movable wings, a firing missile and massive laser cannons to blast robot invaders! Aero Booster has a detachable battle machine! Laser cannons can also connect to the battle machine! Aero Booster measures 11" (28 cm) long! Includes Ha-Ya-To minifigure! Includes special code to unlock extra content at www.EXO-FORCE.com.

8107-1.desc: Don't let this majestic tower fool you - it's a battle station in disguise! Guarded by new pilot Hitomi, the Golden Tower protects the secret codes that EXO-FORCE needs to win the battle against the robots. When the Sonic Raven attacks from the skies with double firing rockets and twin rotating turbines, fight back with the tower's launching missile, golden swords and more! With a hi-tech computer center at the base and a training room at the top, this tower may just be the key to victory. Turn the crank to lower the Golden Tower gate! Launch the Golden Tower missile! Turn the crank on the Sonic Raven to spin its turbines! Sonic Raven has moveable wings and launchers that really fire! Golden Tower measures 9" (23 cm) tall! Sonic Raven is 9" (23 cm) long and 12" (31 cm) wide! Includes Hitomi minifigure! Includes special code to unlock extra content at www.EXO-FORCE.com.

8108-1.desc: Crushing EXO-FORCE defenses, here comes the unstoppable Mobile Devastator! Commanded by robot leader Meca One, the ultimate wheeled fortress opens up to reveal an elevating battle tower with rotating laser cannons and energy sphere launchers, twin scout fliers, prison pods with skeletons, and a legion of robot warriors equipped and ready to deploy into battle. The only thing that stands in its way is Ryo in the Blazing Falcon battle machine with slashing claws and firing rocket! Mobile Devastator measures 23.5" (60 cm) long and 13.5" (34 cm) tall! Sides unfold to reveal robot base! Includes 10 robots and 2 skeletons! Includes Blazing Falcon battle machine and Ryo minifigure! Includes special code to unlock extra content at www.EXO-FORCE.com.

8130-1.desc: Crush everything in your path with the Terrain Crusher monster truck racer! With its oversized wheels, bumpers and side bars, this high-suspension vehicle is one tough racing machine! Combine with #8131 to make the ultimate monster racer!

8133-1.desc: You'll leave them eating your dust when you drive the Rally Rider! On the track or on the streets, this low-built racer with run-flat tires and exposed rear engine is made to blaze around corners and win the race! Combine with #8132 to make a scorching street racer!

8134-1.desc: It's a whole muscle truck show in one spectacular package! Drive to the scene with the massive team truck and transport trailer, then deploy everything you need to put on a major stunt racing event. Set up the flags, line up the ramps, get the giant-wheeled monster truck ready, and go! Will you jump over the stunt car, or crash into it? It's all up to you! Includes transport truck and trailer!

8135-1.desc: The motorized drawbridge is opening fast! Can the cool street cars jump over the bridge before it opens too far? Make sure to stop at the gas station to get ready for the next chase. Includes 3 Tiny Turbo vehicles and police off-roader! Includes motorized bridge, 2 ramps and a slammer to set the chase in motion!

8136-1.desc: With its oversized tires and powerful pull-back motor, the Fire Crusher is ready to cruise -- and crash! This revved-up off-road hot rod blasts apart on impact, but just snap down the hood and you're back in the race! Combine with #8140 Tow Trasher to make a monster racer vehicle! Features cool "crashing" function! Includes pull-back motor!

8137-1.desc: With its two engines and giant tires, the twin-cockpit Booster Beast is one serious off-roader. That's bad news for anything that gets in its way! Front end pops up on impact when you use the pull-back motor to race and crash. Combine with #8141 Off Road Power to build the ultimate rugged racing vehicle! Features cool "crashing" function! Includes pull-back motor!

8138-1.desc: The Phantom Crasher is built for speed -- and crashing! This turbo-charged racer powers down the track with its pull-back motor, and the entire front end pops up on impact. Good thing it's easy to snap back down and get back in the race! Combine with #8141 Off Road Power to make a mean green monster machine! Features cool "crashing" function! Includes pull-back motor!

8139-1.desc: Watch out for the pull-back powered Night Blazer! This mighty blue street racer is customized for extreme speed to burn rubber and smash up the opposition. Body panels pop up on impact, but snap them down again and you're ready to take on the next challenger! Combine with #8140 Tow Trasher to make an ultimate racing vehicle! Features cool "crashing" function! Includes pull-back motor!

8140-1.desc: The skull on the hood and the hook on the back are a warning that this is no ordinary tow truck! The mighty Tow Trasher is here to smash all comers and haul its beaten opponents off to the junkyard. With its pull-back motor and smash-apart action, the hood and side spoilers pop off on impact, then reset for the next crash! Combine with #8136 Fire Crusher or #8139 Night Blazer to make a monster racer vehicle! Features cool "crashing" function! Includes pull-back motor!

8141-1.desc: This big green monster pick-up truck is built to drive over -- or through -- anything in its way! With its pull-back motor, big engine intake, flame details and huge tires, Off Road Power's name says it all. The engine top and side panels pop off on impact, so snap them back into place and you're ready to race and crash again and again! Can combine with #8137 Booster Beast or #8138 Phantom Crasher to make two different ultimate racing vehicles! Features cool "crashing" function! Includes pull-back motor!

8142-1.desc: Build your very own Ferrari F1 Racer and watch it fly down the race course. The official 1:24 scale Ferrari F1 is over 8.5'' (22cm) long and ready for some action! Use the pull-back motor to speed down the track and join the Ferrari racing legend. Includes sponsor logo stickers! Pull-back motor makes car really run!

8143-1.desc: Join the Ferrari racing team with this special Racing Edition Ferrari F430 Challenge car. Loaded with authentic details just like the real thing, this official Ferrari model can be customized with optional yellow or red body panels and extra rims -- all included in the set! Racer measures over 10" (27cm) long! Open the hood to see the realistic engine! Use the alternate yellow body parts to build the first yellow LEGO Ferrari Racer!

8144-1.desc: This action-packed racing garage with pit crew features 2 Ferrari race cars, a service bike, spare parts, tools and more! Includes 8 minifigures, including 2 Ferrari drivers!

8145-1.desc: At last, you can build the amazingly detailed and functional Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano in an incredible 1:10 scale! With its sophisticated design, V12 engine with working pistons, opening doors and hood, and working steering system, this authentic LEGO TECHNIC model is perfect for any fan of Ferrari racing, cars, or building. Doors, hood and trunk really open! Working steering system turns front tires! Features V12 front mounted engine with working pistons! Model measures 18" (46 cm) long!

8146-1.desc: With its oversized rear wheels, custom interior and massive engine, this tough street car with metallic detailing is ready to burn tracks down the street! Flip open the body to reveal the interior! Wheel in the back turns the front tires! Comes with metallic decals! Model is over 15" (38 cm) long!

8147-1.desc: Use both slammers and ramps to see which Tiny Turbo car can jump the farthest over the highway toll station or crash the cars into the tractor trailers and use the tow truck to haul them away. Includes 2 street cars, an off-roader, limousine, tow truck and 2 tractor trailers! Includes 2 slammers and 2 ramps!

8270-1.desc: No matter where you want to build, the Rough Terrain Crane is ready to help with realistic functions! Flip down the outriggers to stabilize the load and extend the powerful telescoping boom! Rotate the base and activate the working controls on the back to lower the winch and raise the payload. Entire crane rotates 360 degrees! Includes instructions to rebuild into an 8.5" (22cm) high Tower Crane! Authentic model for skilled builders!

8271-1.desc: The mighty Wheel Loader is packed with real-life details! Dig in deep and raise the boom-style lift arm to clear the way. Use the control panel on the back of the vehicle to control the loader's rear-axle steering, then tip the bucket to dump your cargo. Raise, lower and tip the bucket! Includes instructions to rebuild into a Grader! Authentic model for skilled builders!

8272-1.desc: Race over the slopes with the powerful Snowmobile, loaded with realistic functions and detailing. Rugged, movable tracks grip the terrain while the working handlebar steering and independent front ski suspension take care of obstacles in your path. Realistic drive track is built from individual segments! Includes instructions to rebuild into a Bulldozer! Authentic model for skilled builders!

8273-1.desc: With flexible axles that adapt to the toughest terrain, the powerful TECHNIC Off Road Truck can go anywhere! Use the back-mounted crane to load cargo and tip the back to unload at the end of the ride. If you get stuck, use the working front winch to get back on track! Packed with realistic, functional details. Turn the gear in front to wind up the 78" (198 cm) rope cable! Knob on top turns the front tires! Truck cab tilts forward! Use the side knob to raise the truck bed! Truck has a working boom and hook! Boom raises and lowers and turns 360 degrees! Truck measures 12" (30 cm) long and tires are 2" (5 cm) wide! Includes instructions to rebuild into a Utility Cargo Truck!

8274-1.desc: Take this authentic Combine Harvester for a spin and watch the whirl of the wheel-driven rotor! Rear-axle steering ensures precise maneuvering around the field. When the job is finished, detach the header, put it on the trailer and bring home the harvest. Harvester measures 17" (43 cm) long! Rotating cylinder measures 16" (41 cm) wide! Harvester has a detachable, wheel driven cutting bar! Raise, lower and spin the cutting bar! Harvester has a moveable thrashing bar! Includes instructions to rebuild into a Dragster!

8275-1.desc: 100% pure power -- it's the ultimate LEGO TECHNIC creation! With its immense size and remote-controlled Power Functions, this giant yellow machine is the king of the construction site. Set it in motion at the push of a button and send it to do your bidding. Working pistons, turning treads, and other details that move and function just like the real thing! Raise and lower the front blade and the ripper on the back using the remote control! Use the remote control to drive and steer the Bulldozer! Bulldozer measures 18" (46 cm) long and 7" (18 cm) high! Includes remote control, 2 receivers, 2 motors, 2 XL motors and a battery box! Requires 6 AA (1.5V) and 3 AAA (1.5V) batteries, not included.

850152-1.desc: This fun and colorful key chain features an authentic 2x4 blue LEGO® brick. Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

850154-1.desc:
A red LEGO® brick for your keys!
This fun and colorful key chain features an authentic 2x4 red LEGO® brick.
Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

851197-1.desc: Crunch numbers the LEGO way with the fun and functional LEGO Calculator! Big numbers make it easy to use for younger mathematicians. Perfect for LEGO fans of any age!

851462-1.desc: Before he was Darth Vader, he was Anakin Skywalker, Jedi Knight and hero. Now Anakin can defend your keys along with the Republic! Includes LEGO logo plate.

851463-1.desc: This Star Wars Clone Trooper is ready and willing to guard your keys!

851464-1.desc:
Never try to take a Wookiee's keys!
Chewbacca the Wookiee is here to protect your keys with this fun LEGO minifigure keychain!

851501-1.desc: It's not just a LEGO minifigure head…it's a LEGO egg timer! Just twist the top to set the timer to ring after anything from a minute to an hour. Ticks off the seconds and rings when done! Timer is decorated with three minifigure faces -- set the timer to swap eyes and mouths! Counts minutes up to an hour, just turn the timer to 60 before winding it up!

851502-1.desc: Serve the coolest drinks around with ice that looks like LEGO bricks, or build your own LEGO ice "sculpture!" Made of durable silicone. Ice cube tray makes 10 ice "bricks" at a time! Dishwasher safe.

851524-1.desc: It's not just a LEGO Minifigure head…it's an egg cup in disguise!' This fun and functional pair of egg cups with minifigure face decorations makes a great gift for the LEGO fan in your life, not to mention a terrific conversation piece at breakfast. Includes 2 egg cups with lids!

851537-1.desc: This brave LEGO firefighter is here to protect your keys from any danger. Keychain features a real LEGO minifigure and logo plate. Makes a great gift!

851617-1.desc: This fun and colorful LEGOville Zoo dinner set is made of safe and durable plastic melamine. It features so many friendly zoo animals, it's sure to be a hit at mealtime! Includes dishwasher-safe fork, spoon, cup with handle, bowl and plate.

851624-1.desc: Bad guys beware! With a police logo on the front and a badge on the side, this cap will tell the world that you're on patrol in LEGO City! Blue cap features LEGO logo on front and a LEGO City badge on the side!

851627-1.desc: You'll never have to worry about mixed-up keys again with the LEGO Key Chain Name Kit! Black and silver tiles let you spell out your name -- or any other label you want -- right on your keychain. Brick is 2x10 and measures 3" (7.5 cm) long! Makes a great personalized present or office gift! Includes special text and decorative elements!

851641-1.desc: Can you match LEGO minifigures from memory? The LEGO City Memory Game is full of fun and colorful character game cards to help you remember, match and win! Includes 60 cards, 2 of each picture, featuring LEGO minifigures!

851652-1.desc: It's the perfect gift for the adult fan of LEGO in your life! Set includes sturdy red LEGO brick-themed corkscrew and orange bottle opener. Dishwasher safe up to 150 degrees F (65 ºC). Each measures 4.5" (11.5cm) wide.

851680-1.desc: Your favorite LEGO fan will love their presents even more when they're wrapped in this fun and festive LEGO Santa Minifigure gift wrap! Two wrapping sheets measure 27'½' ' x 39' each. Includes 2 matching 3'½' x 2'½' gift tags! Features LEGO Santa minifigure print!

851686-1.desc: You can trust Batman to keep your keys safe from villains on this great keyring!

851687-1.desc: The Caped Crusader's partner is ready to guard your keys! Includes LEGO logo plate.

851689-1.desc: Collect all of the LEGO Batman magnets! This set includes The Joker, Catwoman, and Robin minifigure magnets. Includes headgear!

851757-1.desc: Battle imaginary blazes with this kid-sized Fire Extinguisher! Press down the handle and it shoots water just like a water gun. Not for use on real fires. For use as a toy only.

851814-1.desc: The Clown Prince of Crime comes to this life in this amazing minifigure keyring!

851815-1.desc: She may be a master thief, but you can count on Catwoman to keep your keys safe on this amazing keyring!

851838-1.desc: Whether you're in school or at the bottom of the sea, this SpongeBob SquarePants key chain will add some wacky fun to your day! Makes a great gift, too!

851839-1.desc: SpongeBob's starfish friend Patrick is ready and willing to hang out on your keys! Makes a great gift for SpongeBob fans of all ages!

851841-1.desc: Let them know there's LEGO fun in store this Christmas! This festive wrapping paper features images of the LEGO Santa Claus minifigure and a snow-covered LEGO tree on a background of drifting snowflakes. Each pack includes two wrapping sheets measuring 70 x 100 cm each and 2 gift tags!

851846-1.desc: Keep your table finish safe and your drinking glasses slip-free with these flexible, 3-D textured LEGO coasters! Set of 4 coasters includes two red and two light blue. Dishwasher safe up to 150 degrees F (65 ºC). Each coaster measures 3.5" (9cm) square.

851848-1.desc:
Play the classic game of X's and O's with LEGO® minifigures!
Set includes 5 policeman minifigures and 5 robber minifigures for a good vs. evil game of strategy!
Includes 5" x 5" (12.7cm x 12.7cm) playing board, plus 5" x 5" (12.7cm x 12.7cm) baseplate for storing minifigures while not in play.
Sturdy case features Velcro closure for storage or flips open for play!

851853-1.desc: SpongeBob's boss Mr. Krabs will do anything to protect his secret Krabby Patty recipe, and now he'll protect your keys, too! Makes a great gift for SpongeBob fans of all ages! Includes LEGO logo plate.

851854-1.desc: Keep things cool in undersea style with these SpongeBob SquarePants magnets! Real LEGO minifigures of SpongeBob, Patrick and Mr. Krabs can be attached to your fridge, locker, or any other other metal surface. Includes Spongebob, Patrick and Mr. Krabs.

851875-1.desc: Toa beware -- now the weapon of the Barraki is in your hands! Conquer the seas like Takadox with this safe and durable BIONICLE sword. Sword measures 22" long! (56cm) Durable foam makes this sword soft enough for safe play but tough enough to stand up to battle!

851876-1.desc: Become the creepy Takadox and conquer the sea as a Barraki from the action-packed world of BIONICLE!

851877-1.desc: Take on your friends in the ultimate BIONICLE water fight with this Barraki Pump Action Water Gun! Replay your favorite BIONICLE battles or just have some soaking-wet fun in the sun!

851878-1.desc: Have an outdoor blast the BIONICLE way with these red and green Barraki squid! Just soak them in water and fling them through the air for a big splash and a wet and wacky time. Includes 2 Barraki Squid! Soft polyester and foam make these fun in the pool or out in the summer sun!

851893-1.desc: Evil robots don't stand a chance against the official EXO-FORCE rocket launcher! Just pump the launcher and watch the foam rockets soar through the air to blast enemy targets. Includes 3 foam rockets! Foam on handle makes it easy to hold! Launcher is 24" long! (61cm)

851894-1.desc: Charge into battle with this heroic LEGO Castle sword! With its lion's-head symbol and a shining 'gem' in the handle, the good king's golden sword is soft and durable for lots of knightly fun and adventure. Sword measures 20" long! (51cm) Durable foam makes this sword safe and fun!

851895-1.desc: You're in charge of the LEGO Castle with this high-quality King's Cape costume! Features "fur" mantle and trim, a fabric red cape with a "gold" chain (attached with a touch fastener) for plenty of adventure, questing and fun! Cape measures 25" long! (64cm) 100% polyester.

851896-1.desc: Take command of LEGO Castle with this kingly crown! Trimmed with 'fur' and richly decorated with shining 'gems,' the royal crown tells the whole kingdom that you're in charge!

851898-1.desc: There's lots of fun in store when you join the LEGO City Fire Department. This safe and sturdy fire axe will help you battle pretend blazes wherever you go, just like a real firefighter! Measures over 14" long! (36cm) Made with safe and durable foam!

851899-1.desc: Join the LEGO City Police with your very own working flashlight! Investigate the scene of the crime by day or night with this sturdy kid-sized flashlight with wrist strap. Requires 2 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included. Flashlight measures 6" long (15cm), perfect for little hands!

851901-1.desc: Take command with the working LEGO City Police megaphone. Just press the trigger and talk to hear your voice broadcast all around, just like the real thing! Requires one 12v battery, included! Megaphone is 5" long x 4.5" tall. (13cm x 11cm)

851902-1.desc: There's been a crime in LEGO City! Good thing you've got your LEGO City Police Investigator Kit. Special Agent case with handle opens to reveal special crime scene tape, police notebook and pencil, magnifying glass, and even arrest forms with fingerprinting ink and an 'Arrested!' stamp for when you've cracked the case and saved the day! Includes crime scene tape, police notebook, magnifying glass, arrest forms, fingerprinting ink and "Arrested!" stamp! Case features handle and touch fastener closures for easy carrying!

851903-1.desc: It's a knapsack shaped like a LEGO brick! This fun blue bag with adjustable shoulder straps is just right for carrying books, lunch, and anything else you want to tote around. Each 'stud' on the back is a separate zippered compartment! Bag measures 12.5" long x 8" wide x 5" deep. (32 cm x 20cm x 13cm)

851904-1.desc: With a raised brick design on the front and studs on the back, this is definitely the wallet for the true LEGO fan. Includes storage for bills, cards, and a zippered coin compartment! Wallet has Velcro closure for easy use!

851905-1.desc: This isn't just a big blue LEGO brick -- it's a great sports bag, too! Stay active in style with this handy zippered bag with carrying handles and an adjustable shoulder strap. Each LEGO 'stud' is a separate zippered compartment! Bag has carrying handles and a detachable, adjustable shoulder strap! Sports bag measures 17" long x 8" tall x 6.5" deep. (43cm x 20cm x 16.5cm)

851906-1.desc: Plan out your day, your week, and even your month with the LEGO Activity Planner! Fun and functional for the whole family! Includes magnetic schedule board, brick-shaped magnets for each month, and extra magnets to represent friends, family and special events and activities! Also includes four real magnetic LEGO bricks to put wherever you want! You can write and erase notes on the calendar or message section of the board using the dry erase pen -- it's magnetic too! Measures at 15.5" long x 10.5" wide. (39cm x 27cm)

851908-1.desc: Lost keys are a thing of the past with the LEGO key rack! Made with real LEGO bricks, these colorful key chains snap right onto the stylish wall plate. Great for the home, the office, or as a gift for a LEGO fan. 2 LEGO brick keychains included! Felt padding protects wall plate when hanging your keys! Measures 8.25" tall x 6" wide. (21cm x 15cm) Includes hanging instructions and parts needed.

851910-1.desc: This fun and stylish stationery set has everything you need! Includes a spiral-bound notepad, 2 pencils, 2 brick-shaped erasers and a pencil sharpener! Decorated with colorful stripes and LEGO brick designs!

851911-1.desc: This fun and functional stationery set has everything you need! Includes a spiral-bound notepad, 2 pencils, 2 brick-shaped erasers and a pencil sharpener! Decorated with classic stripes and LEGO brick designs!

851915-1.desc: Just mix up a cake or jelly recipe and pour it into this fun, brick-shaped mould to create tasty desserts shaped like real LEGO bricks! Makes six individual 2 1/2" snacks! Mould is dishwasher and microwave safe and can be used at temperatures of up to 210'º C or 410'º F.

851917-1.desc: This classic and convenient storage unit is just what you need to keep your LEGO brick collection off the floor! Includes a sturdy red wooden frame storage unit and 4 plastic storage trays featuring compartments in different sizes. Storage Tray Unit measures 14" wide x 14" tall x 12" deep! (35cm x 35cm x 30cm) Some assembly required, bricks not included.

851918-1.desc: Now lunchtime is even more fun! Specially insulated to keep food fresh and at the right temperature, this lunch bag looks just like a blue LEGO brick. Each of the four 'studs' on the front is a separate zippered storage compartment! Lunch bag measures 8" long x 8" wide x 5.5" deep (20cm x 20cm x 14cm)

851931-1.desc: With this safe and durable pirate cleaver on your side, no landlubber will dare challenge you on the high seas. Measure 15" long! (38cm) Safe and durable foam construction!

851933-1.desc: Sail the seven seas for plunder and adventure with this LEGO pirate sword. This safe and durable sword is just the thing for exploring uncharted islands and making landlubbers walk the plank. Sword has a "gem" in the handle! Measures over 18" long! (46cm) Durable foam makes this sword safe and fun!

851937-1.desc: They build 'em tough in the Empire, and this Imperial Astromech Droid is no exception. He'll protect your keys no matter the odds!

851938-1.desc: She took down Jabba the Hutt, so you know no one will dare try to steal your keys while she's on guard. Straight from the LEGO Star Wars collection, Princess Leia is ready to guard your keys and save the galaxy! Includes LEGO logo plate!

851939-1.desc: Celebrate the 30th Anniversary of Star Wars! With an Imperial Stormtrooper, AT-ST Pilot and Rebel Y-wing Pilot, these fun and functional magnets are also real LEGO minifigures. Great for your fridge or any other metal surface. Includes Imperial Stormtrooper, AT-ST Driver and Rebel Y-wing Pilot!

851949-1.desc: With a royal lion symbol and a golden crown on top, it's clear that this is the shield of a noble king. Carry it bravely into battle as you quest to defend the LEGO Castle! Shield includes a "gem" on the golden crown! 2 straps on back of shield makes it easy to hold on your arm! Safe and durable foam construction!

851950-1.desc: It's a knapsack shaped like a LEGO brick! This fun pink bag with adjustable shoulder straps is just right for carrying books, lunch, and anything else you want to tote around. Each 'stud' on the back is a separate zippered compartment! Bag measures 12.5" long x 8" wide x 5" deep. (32 cm x 20cm x 13cm)

851951-1.desc: This set of 4 classic plastic tumblers features colorful stripes and LEGO brick designs. Durable and dishwasher safe! Tumblers measure at 5" tall. (13cm) 2 tumblers have colorful stripes and LEGO brick designs in red, pink, lime green and yellow! 2 tumblers have colorful stripes LEGO brick designs in blue, light blue, green and lime green!

851954-1.desc: This LEGO Aqua Raiders Stationery Set includes everything you'll need to record your action-packed undersea adventures…or just take notes in class. Includes 2 pencils, 5 colored pencils, 1 notepad and a 6" (15 cm) ruler!

851955-1.desc: Giant squids and mutant crabs are no match for the pump-action Aqua Raiders Water Gun! Just fill it up, aim and fire for a blast of aquatic fun in the summer sun. Water Blaster measures over 11" (28 cm) long! Water Blaster has a power meter that turns green when its ready to shoot water!

851958-1.desc: With a lock on the cover and LEGO Belville pony decorations, this beautiful diary will keep your secrets in style.

851960-1.desc: Elephants and zebras and lions! Make your own colorful zoo scenes with these friendly animal stickers. Includes 6 animal stickers, a Zoo background scene and lots of small food and animal prints stickers. The stickers can be re-used again and again.

851970-1.desc: From pretty pony stickers to a pink LEGO brick eraser, this LEGO Belville stationery set has everything a princess could need! Includes 1 sticker sheet, 1 glitter pen, 2 pencils, 1 pencil sharpener and 1 brick-shaped eraser!

851973-1.desc: Make Belville ice cubes -- just add water and slide the tray into your freezer! Makes 4 heart-shaped cubes and 6 butterfly shaped cubes at a time. Ice cube tray is dishwasher safe and measures 6.5" (17 cm) long and 4.5" (11 cm) wide!

851974-1.desc: Beware the tentacles of Kalmah! Barraki stationery set includes everything you'll need to record your BIONICLE battles. Includes 1 mechanical pencil, 1 eraser, a notepad and a lenticular 6" (15 cm) ruler!

851975-1.desc: Challenge your friends to your own Toa Mahri-Barraki battle. Load the soft foam darts into the rotating launcher and fire away. Dart Launcher measures 12" long! Includes 18 foam darts!

851976-1.desc: At school, on vacation or anywhere, bring a BIONICLE Barraki with you wherever you go! Sturdy notebook features a lenticular cover -- just tilt it and see what happens!

851988-1.desc: Fun and colorful DUPLO Zoo animals help to measure a growing child's height. Features markings in both inches and centimeters. Mount the chart on the wall with the included self-adhesive stickers. Chart measures from 20'' to 60'' and from 50 cm to 150 cm. Includes 10 "empty" stickers, so you can remember your height over time!

851994-1.desc: Detailed EXO-FORCE tutorial set includes everything you need to learn to draw manga-style art! Includes 2 drawing pencils, 1 drawing pen, an eraser, notepad and pencil sharpener!

851999-1.desc: Brave, loyal Hagrid knows all the secret passages of Hogwarts Castle, and he'll protect your keys just like he would Dumbledore's! Key chain includes authentic LEGO Hagrid minifigure and LEGO and Harry Potter logo plates!

852000-1.desc: Guarding your keys is as easy as magic for Hermione! She'll use all her spells to keep them safe and sound. Key chain includes authentic LEGO Hermione minifigure and LEGO and Harry Potter logo plates!

852001-1.desc: Battle your opponent in this exciting game of skill and strategy! This exclusive LEGO Castle Chess Set includes a total of 32 chess pieces, featuring 24 minifigures. Just choose your side and you're ready to play! One-piece chess board measures 10" x 10" (25 cm x 25 cm)! Includes 32 chess pieces featuring 24 LEGO minifigures including knights, skeletons, wizard, king and princess! Includes sturdy carrying case with leather handle, snap closures and storage compartments for each piece!
