852003-1.desc: The skeleton warriors are on the march! Who will save the LEGO Castle kingdom? Safe, durable toy sword is child-sized for endless fun and adventure. Skeleton sword measures over 18" (46 cm) long! Safe and durable foam construction!

852004-1.desc: Battle for the fate of the LEGO Castle kingdom! Safe, durable toy shield is child-sized for plenty of fantastic fun and adventure. Skeleton shield measures 14.5" (37 cm) round! Shield has 2 straps on the back to hold it on your arm! Safe and durable foam construction!

852005-1.desc: Adventure in the LEGO Castle kingdom! Become a knightly hero with this fun and durable child-sized helmet. Silver and blue helmet is made of safe and durable foam! Helmet also has grey fabric with gold trim hanging on the sides and back!

852007-1.desc: Bearing the image of a king's royal crown, this child-sized LEGO Castle shield is perfect for knightly adventures and imagination. Durable and child-safe!

852008-1.desc: Evil skeleton warriors are attacking the castle! Defend the kingdom as a brave knight with this durable, child-sized costume. Costume has soft blue fabric, gold trim and the King's shield on it! Silver foam shoulders with golden grommets add extra detail to the armor! Silver belt detail has elastic sides for multiple sizes! Armor costume measures 22" (56 cm) long!

852009-1.desc: Straight from LEGO Castle come the Good King, Royal Knight and Skeleton Warrior, equipped and ready to battle on your fridge and other metal surfaces. Real LEGO minifigures with real magnets!

852011-1.desc: There's always something going on in LEGO City. Write down your own busy events with this fun and colorful LEGO City stationery set! It includes everything you need to get the job done. Includes 2 pencils, 1 notepad, 1 eraser and 1 pencil sharpener!

852012-1.desc: It's another busy day in LEGO City…but this time, it's on your fridge! Real LEGO minifigures with accessories feature magnets that let them stick to metal surfaces. Includes train engineer, construction worker and captain minifigures!

852015-1.desc: Work and play in LEGO City with this colorful child-sized construction worker vest!

852018-1.desc: Make a splash at the pool or beach with this fun and colorful towel. Made from 100% cotton Features bright, classic stripes and LEGO brick designs! Features a loop for storage or hanging up to dry! Towel measures 48" long x 22.5" wide. (122cm x 57 m)

852019-1.desc: The aliens are after your energy crystals! With your authentic LEGO Mars Mission air blaster, you can load the soft foam darts into the rotating launcher, pump and fire to drive them away. You've saved the day! Includes 10 foam darts! Measures over 9" (23 cm) long!

852020-1.desc: 3…2…1…blast off! Rocket into space with the official LEGO Mars Mission Space Hero Suit. With shining silver shoulderpads, a working zipper, and lots of sci-fi details, this authentic and sturdy costume is sure to inspire light-years of adventures and imagination! Fun orange, white and silver Mars Mission colors and details! Suit has half zip down front and elastic sides for multiple sizes! Measures approximately 17" (43cm) long and 14" (36cm) wide! Made of polyster and foam materials.

852021-1.desc: Straight from the undersea world of SpongeBob SquarePants comes Squidward! This cranky squid will guard your keys from any mischief-makers - especially pesky sponges! Includes Squidward minifigure and LEGO logo plate!

852028-1.desc: It's time to go exploring! This rugged beige hat features a pocket with the LEGO DUPLO logo and a friendly lion cub to inspire plenty of outdoor adventures.

852043-1.desc: Blaze a trail down the track with this LEGO Racers cap, featuring flames and details for plenty of racing action and excitement. Red mesh on back of hat!

852080-1.desc: Harvey Dent, a.k.a. the super-villain Two-Face, is of two minds about everything. With him on your key ring, you never know what will happen! Includes LEGO logo plate!

852081-1.desc: Would-be thieves beware! The dastardly Penguin is on the prowl, straight from the LEGO Batman collection. No one's taking your keys while he's got his hands on them! Includes LEGO logo plate!

852084-1.desc: These authentic melamine plates feature colorful stripes and LEGO brick patterns. Great for the fan or the family! Safe, durable and dishwasher-safe! Includes 2 plates measuring 10" round! (25cm) 1 plate has red, pink, lime green and yellow stripes and brick patterns! 1 plate has blue, light blue, green and lime green stripes and brick patterns!

852085-1.desc: The battle for the galaxy is waged across your fridge! Boba Fett, Princess Leia and a Royal Guard are real LEGO minifigures with magnets to attach to metal surfaces. Includes Boba Fett, Princess Leia and Royal Guard!

852086-1.desc: The heroes and villains of the Star Wars movies are ready to stand guard or battle on your fridge and other flat metal surfaces! Real LEGO minifigures with real magnets. Set includes Darth Maul, Anakin Skywalker, and Naboo Fighter Pilot!

852089-1.desc: Here's a riddle: when is a fridge cooler on the outside than the inside? When Batman battles Mr. Freeze and the Riddler there! Magnet set features real LEGO minifigures of Batman, Mister Freeze and the Riddler!

852090-1.desc: The Riddler knows the solution to every puzzle, so your keys won't mysteriously vanish while he's protecting them. Includes Riddler minifigure and LEGO logo plate!

852091-1.desc: Harry Potter will use all his magic to protect your keys from Voldemort and other dangers! Key chain includes authentic LEGO Harry Potter minifigure and LEGO and Harry Potter logo plates!

852095-1.desc: This fun and colorful key chain features an authentic 2x4 yellow LEGO® brick.Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852096-1.desc: This fun and colorful key chain features an authentic 2x4 green LEGO® brick. Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852097-1.desc: This fun and colorful key chain features an authentic 2x4 orange LEGO® brick. Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852098-1.desc: A black LEGO® brick for your keys!

852099-1.desc: This fun and colorful key chain features an authentic 2x4 lime green LEGO® brick. Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852100-1.desc: This fun and colorful key chain features an authentic 2x4 white LEGO® brick. Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852113-1.desc: Blast off to hyperspace with this miniature Millennium Falcon from Star Wars! Millennium Falcon is 2'½" (6 cm) long! Includes LEGO logo plate! Makes a great gift, too!

852114-1.desc: Here comes the mini-sized Rebel Y-wing starfighter, saving the galaxy - wherever you are! Y-wing Fighter is over 3" (8 cm) long! Includes LEGO logo plate! Makes a great gift, too!

852115-1.desc: Darth Vader's custom TIE fighter is an authentic mini-sized Star Wars vehicle! Vader's TIE Fighter is 2" (5 cm) wide! Makes a great gift, too!

852116-1.desc: Santa Claus is here with a bag full of…whatever LEGO gifts you have in mind! Festive gift bag is just the right size for medium-sized LEGO sets (or lots of small ones) and includes a Santa minifigure gift tag. Gift Bag measures 20" (51cm) wide, 5" (13cm) deep and 17" (43cm) tall!

852117-1.desc: Present your presents in style with the official LEGO City Gift Bag! Featuring a colorful image of a friendly LEGO firefighter, it's sure to bring a big smile to the face of whoever receives it…especially if it's stuffed with brand-new LEGO sets! Great for birthdays, holidays, and any special occasion. Includes LEGO brick shape gift tag! Gift Bag measures 20" (51cm) wide, 5" (13cm) deep and 17" (43cm) tall!

852119-1.desc: Celebrate the season with this holiday magnet set! Santa, a festive tree and more are ready to decorate your home, office, or any other metal surface. Makes a great gift!

852124-1.desc: Decorate the holiday season with this LEGO Holiday Stocking! This red velour stocking has a white soft plush top and comes with a sewn on patch featuring a santa minifigure.

852129-1.desc: Emperor Palpatine is ready to protect your keys with all the Sith powers at his villainous disposal! Makes a great gift, too!

852130-1.desc: The spooky Scarecrow knows what makes key thieves scared! Never fear losing your keys with this Batman villain minifigure and sturdy metal key chain. Includes Scarecrow and LEGO logo plate! Makes a great gift, too!

852131-1.desc: Straight from the world of Batman, the icy-cool Mr. Freeze is here to guard your keys. Includes authentic LEGO minifigure, logo plate and sturdy metal key chain! Makes a great gift!

852132-1.desc: Play the classic game of Xs and Os with LEGO Castle minifigures! Sturdy box features hook and loop closures and flips open to reveal a studded Tac Tac Toe board, plus storage compartments for each piece. Set includes 5 knight minifigures and 5 skeleton minifigures for a good vs. evil game of strategy!

852133-1.desc: A smiling LEGO minifigure Santa Claus wishes all your relatives and friends a happy holiday this season. Includes 10 each of 2 different greeting card styles and 20 envelopes.

8910-1.desc: With his two Cordak revolving blasters, Kongu is ready to teach the Barraki the true meaning of crossfire. His Mask of Summoning lets him call sea creatures to his aid in the heat of battle, making him one of the most powerful Toa Mahri! Kongu stands over 6" (15 cm) high! Armed with Cordak blasters that really fire!

8911-1.desc: The Toa Mahri of Fire is ready to burn his way through the Pit in the search for the Mask of Life! Armed with an aquatic power blade and aided by a Hahnah crab fitted with a Cordak blaster, Jaller can hit enemies from two directions at once. His Mask of Sonar lets him spot his foes before they approach! Jaller stands over 7" (18 cm) tall! Armed with Cordak blaster that really fires!

8912-1.desc: Armed with his aqua warblade, Cordak blaster, and Mask of Gravity, Toa Hewkii challenges the Barraki in the fight for the universe. His electrified chains give off a charge powerful enough to stun a Takea shark -- but will they stop a Barraki? Hewkii stands over 6" (15 cm) tall! Armed with Cordak blaster that really fires!

8913-1.desc: From out of the shadows of the Pit swims Toa Mahri Nuparu to fight the evil Barraki! His aqua blaster blade sends shockwaves through the Pit, while his shield protects him from attack. Using his Mask of Stealth, Nuparu can move almost unseen, then fire his Cordak blaster at a foe! Nuparu stands over 7" (18 cm) tall! Armed with Cordak blaster that really fires!

8914-1.desc: The Toa Mahri of Water is in her element in the depths of the ocean! Her six wing-like fins let her swim faster than anything underwater and her Mask of Kindred lets her mimic the powers of other sea creatures. Carrying a Cordak blaster and protosteel talons, Hahli is the true power in the sea. Hahli stands over 7" (18 cm) tall! Armed with Cordak blaster that really fires!

8915-1.desc: There's an icy chill in the water when Toa Mahri Matoro comes near! Armed with his twin cutter and Cordak revolving blaster, Matoro will battle his way to victory. His Mask of Reanimation lets him bring back the victims of the Barraki's armies to form a legion against them. Matoro stands over 7" (18 cm) tall! Armed with Cordak blaster that really fires!

8916-1.desc: The slyest and most treacherous of the Barraki, Takadox relies on his hypnotize gaze, slashing blades, and sea squid launcher to conquer his enemies. Can the Toa hope to defeat this hideous villain? Includes squid launcher with 2 squid. Each Barraki features a unique body, face and weapons - collect them all!

8917-1.desc: Cunning and brutal, Kalmah strikes fear into the hearts of the fiercest sea beasts. His tentacle can crush his foes, or he can use his sea squid launcher to drain their life force. The tentacles on the back of his head help him to sense surprise attacks before they happen. Commanding an army of giant squid, Kalmah may be impossible to stop! Includes squid launcher with 2 squid. Each Barraki features a unique body, face and weapons - collect them all!

8918-1.desc: The strongest of the Barraki, Carapar claws can crush or shred anything in his way. His armored shell makes him invulnerable to just about everything but electrical attack. Close in, and you are trapped in his claws -- stay away, and he will get you with his sea squid launcher. Either way, Carapar rules the sea! Includes squid launcher with 2 squid. Each Barraki features a unique body, face and weapons - collect them all!

8919-1.desc: The first thing you'll hear is the shifting of sand … then you'll feel his claws. With his spiked shell, vicious pincers, and sea squid launcher, Mantax hides on the sea floor waiting for his prey. By the time you've seen him, it's much too late! Includes squid launcher with 2 squid. Each Barraki features a unique body, face and weapons - collect them all!

8920-1.desc: Enemies who think Ehlek is an easy target are in for a shocking surprise! If his sea squid launcher and claws are not enough to protect him, he can use his spines to send out electrical bolts at his opponents. With an army of venom eels at his command, Ehlek is out to destroy the city of Mahri Nui! Includes squid launcher with 2 squid. Each Barraki features a unique body, face and weapons - collect them all!

8921-1.desc: The deadliest and most ruthless of the Barraki warlords, Pridak rules through fear. With his shark like teeth and sea squid launcher, he leads his legions of Takea sharks against Mahri Nui and the Toa who dare defend it. Includes squid launcher with 2 squid. Each Barraki features a unique body, face and weapons - collect them all!

8922-1.desc: Once, Gadunka was a tiny sea creature, until the power of the Mask of Life turned him into a razor-toothed monster! Now it is ready to challenge the Toa Mahri and the Barraki to claim its territory beneath the sea. Gadunka has a dual-colored glow-in-the-dark skull!! Its razor-toothed mouth opens 6" (15 cm) wide! Includes squid shooter and extra squid ammo! Gadunka stands 8" (20 cm) tall!

8923-1.desc: Hydraxon is the powerful armored figure assigned to guard the Pit and now he's after the Barraki! A master of every known weapon, he's armed with boomerangs, wrist knives and a Cordak blaster. Runners don't have a chance when Hydraxon's on their trail! Hydraxon stands over 9" (20 cm) tall! Rotating Cordak blaster really fires!

8924-1.desc: This robotic guardian of the Pit has been taken over by the evil Makuta as part of his ultimate plan to seize power in the universe. Aided by his energy hound, Spinax, Maxilos uses his twin-bladed black fire sword and shoulder-mounted Cordak blaster in battle. But whose side is he really on? Maxilos's shoulder-mounted Cordak blaster really fires! Maxilos stands over 8" (20 cm) tall! Spinax has red eyes, spikes on his back and stands 5" (13 cm) tall!

8925-1.desc: The Barraki are searching the sea for the Mask of Life in their monstrous living patrol craft. When they spot a Toa Mahri in a transport pod, the battle is on! Includes glow-in-the-dark jellyfish and 4 solidified air spheres! Includes 3 miniature Barraki and 1 miniature Toa Mahri! Includes squid shooter and 3 sea squid ammo!

8926-1.desc: The Toa Mahri return to the Pit inside a bizarre sea creature, arriving just in time to battle the Barraki and their frightening sea creature servants. It's all-out battle under the sea when these two forces clash. Cordak blaster really fires and comes with extra missiles! Includes 3 miniature Toa Mahri and 3 miniature Barraki figures! Includes 9 solidified air spheres and 3 sea squid! Includes 3 sea Rahi and lots more!

8927-1.desc: Returning from saving the Matoran of Mahri Nui in their Toa Terrain Crawler, the Toa Mahri are ambushed by the evil Barraki! Will the Toa Mahri survive or has their quest for the Mask of Life come to a horrible end? Toa Terrain Crawler has a Cordak blaster that really fires! Open the sides of the Toa Terrain Crawler to reveal the attack vehicle! Includes 6 miniature Toa Mahri and 4 miniature Barraki figures! Includes sea squids, solidified air spheres, glow-in-the-dark jellyfish and much more!

8929-1.desc: A leader and inventor, Defilak leads a dangerous expedition to explore the waters of the Pit! But can even his cunning and wit save the Matoran of Mahri Nui from the unleashed Barraki? Includes solidified air bubble launcher and sphere ammunition!

8930-1.desc: An Po-Matoran aqua hunter, Dekar finds the Mask of Life only to lose it to the Barraki. A strong ally of the Toa Mahri, he will do anything to get the mask back! Includes solidified air bubble launcher and sphere ammunition!

8931-1.desc: One of a team of hydruka, native undersea creatures that serve the Matoran of Mahri Nui, Thulox's job is to harvest the fields of air. When threatened, he fires spheres of solidified air from his launcher! Includes solidified air bubble launcher and sphere ammunition!

8932-1.desc: Like all hydruka, Morak is stubborn, bad-tempered, yet skilled at harvesting air bubbles from the fields of air. When threatened, he fires spheres of solidified air from his launcher! Includes solidified air bubble launcher and sphere ammunition!

8934-1.desc: The Barraki rely on their hordes of vampiric sea squid to weaken their enemies! These special packs contain extra squid ammo for Barraki launchers, so the battle never ends. Includes 7 squid.

8935-1.desc: Nocturn is the warlord of Ehlek's underwater army and an expert in every form of deep-sea combat! With his glow-in-the-dark spines, head, shoulders and legs Nocturn attracts attention even in the darkest corners of the abyss. Includes squid launcher and 2 squid.

8939-1.desc: A legendary hero of the past returns as Toa Lesovikk strikes in Mahri Nui! He's on a millennia-long quest for justice, and no one better get in his way! Armed with his air sword and his sea sled, he is ready for undersea action! Lesovikk has red glowing eyes that really light up! Lesovikk can grab onto the sea sled to ride into battle! Sea sled has a rotating Cordak blaster that really fires! Retractable legs allow the sea sled to stand when not in use! Lesovikk stands 7" (18 cm) tall and sea sled is 11" (28 cm) long!

8940-1.desc: The dreaded Karzahni, powerful ruler of his own realm, has traveled to the Pit in search of the Mask of Life. Can two brave Matoran, Sarda and Idris, hope to trap him and end his reign of fear? This special set includes Karzahni, Sarda, Idris and trap! Karzahni features a horned mask and evil red eyes! Karzahni is armed with a a squid shooter and blades on his body! Help the Matoran capture Karzahni using the trap that really closes! Karzahni stands 10.5" (27 cm) tall! Sarda and Idris are over 4" (10 cm) tall!

9222-1.desc:
People from around the world!
Bring LEGO® DUPLO® creations to life with this set of people from all around the world. Safe and sturdy, they’ll make a wonderful addition to any young builder’s collection.
Includes 16 LEGO DUPLO figures!

9241-1.desc: If your LEGO creations are always on the move, you need lots and lots of wheels! Set includes 2 different sizes of tires, plus axles and wheel hubs to keep your creations rolling on and on.

9632-1.desc: The Mechanisms Set presents students with 12 different models that are designed to be built by teams of two. Teamwork is essential with the Mechanisms Set, as two building guides for each model are included – one for student A and one for student B. Each student assembles part of the model, and then the two parts are joined to complete the building aspects of the project. The models demonstrate various physical science and technology concepts, including forces and motion, simple machines, measurement, energy, and more. The set contains 352 LEGO® Technic elements and building instructions for 12 models, all in a sturdy storage bin that includes a sorting tray. The set is appropriate for 4th grade and up.

GGSW005-1.desc: Introducing the LEGO Star Wars Luke Skywalker Pilot minifigure maquette -- a great collectible for the grown-up LEGO Star Wars fan, just in time for the holiday season! This limited-edition maquette comes with a Certificate of Authenticity and features a removable, magnetic head and logo plate, and stands 6" high. Luke Skywalker Maquette stands 6" high, 4'½" wide and 4'½" deep! Magnetic attachment allows Luke's head to turn in any direction! Includes Certificate of Authenticity! Great gift for adult LEGO Star Wars collectors! Please note: Due to the magnetic features and polyresin construction of this figure, it is intended as a display collectible only and should not be used as a toy.

K851951-1.desc: This set of 4 classic plastic tumblers and 4 melamine plates features colorful stripes and LEGO brick designs. You save 30% on the original price by purchasing the tumblers and plates together in this great value picnic set. Durable and dishwasher safe! Tumblers measure at 5" tall. (13cm) Plates measure 10'' round (25cm). 2 tumblers and 2 plates have colorful stripes and LEGO brick designs in red, pink, lime green and yellow! 2 tumblers and 2 plates have colorful stripes LEGO brick designs in blue, light blue, green and lime green!

MS1038-1.desc: Using the NXT Brick (sold separately), the Color Sensor enables your robot to distinguish not only between black and white, but also a range of bright and pastel colors. Does not include connector cable. This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

MS1040-1.desc: Using the NXT Brick (sold separately), the Accelerometer Sensor lets your LEGO® MINDSTORMS® creation know which way is up and when your robot tilts left or right, up or down, or side to side. This three axis accelerometer sensor also measures acceleration so you can measure g forces just like jet fighter pilots and astronauts. Does not include connector cable. This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

MS1042-1.desc: Upgrade your LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT creations with the Infrared Seeker sensor! Your robots will be able to detect infrared light sources and determine their direction and relative strength thanks to 5 infrared detectors arrayed at 60º intervals. Includes 1 Infrared Seeker. Does not include connector cable. This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

MS1044-1.desc: The Gyroscopic Sensor lets you build LEGO® MINDSTORMS® NXT robots that can detect rotation using a single axis gyro based on a quartz resonator. Accurate readings require the gyro sensor NXT-G block or use of another programming environment to read the raw value from the sensor. Includes 1 Gyroscopic Sensor. Does not include connector cable. This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

MS1046-1.desc: Enhance your LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT creations with an Infrared Link Sensor! With 3 NXT-G blocks, you'll be able to build robots that can communicate with other devices, including the MINDSTORMS RCX, LEGO IR remote-controlled trains, and LEGO Power Functions motors. Includes 1 Infrared Link Sensor. Does not include connector cable. This is the individual component, and does not include the NXT Intelligent Brick, software or any accessories. It requires the complete LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT set (#8527 or #8547) for use.

NDS061-1.desc: Play through the events of all six Star Wars movies in one video game, for the first time ever! With new characters, new levels and new features, players can build and battle like never before. Solve puzzles that encourage creative thinking through the use of teamwork and unique building situations only possible in a LEGO Star Wars galaxy! Experience new levels, such as Episode II's never-before-played high-speed pursuit of bounty hunter Zam Wesell! New playable characters like Watto, Zam Wessell, Boss Nass and more bring the total count to over 160! Create cross-Trilogy mash-up characters like "Han Windu" and "Lando Amidala." More new game features include enhanced Force powers, new power-ups, a new Challenge Mode, the ability to build, jump into and exit every vehicle, and much more! Rated E for Everyone.

P2155-1.desc: It's the only pen you connect and build yourself - in LEGO Star Wars style! Choose from a variety of unique pieces, including Darth Vader minifigure elements, and assemble your pen in any order you choose! Ballpoint pen writes in black ink. Pen features a molded grip for writing comfort! Special elements include minifigure pieces and Darth Vader's cape!

P2156-1.desc: It's the only pen you connect and build yourself - in LEGO Star Wars style! Choose from a variety of unique pieces, including Yoda minifigure elements, and assemble your pen in any order you choose! Ballpoint pen writes in black ink. Pen features a molded grip for writing comfort! Special elements include minifigure pieces!

P2157-1.desc: It's the only pen you connect and build yourself - in LEGO Star Wars style! Choose from a variety of unique pieces, including R2-D2 minifigure elements, and assemble your pen in any order you choose! Ballpoint pen writes in black ink. Pen features a molded grip for writing comfort! Special elements include minifigure pieces and metallic pieces!

P2158-1.desc: It's the only pen you connect and build yourself - in LEGO Star Wars style! Choose from a variety of unique elements, including Chewbacca minifigure elements, and assemble the pieces in any order you choose! Ballpoint pen writes in black ink. Pen features a molded grip for writing comfort! Special elements include minifigure pieces!

P60230-1.desc: Battle the Barraki with this fun and action-packed BIONICLE cartridge pen! Features a durable design, clip, and colourful graphics. Features a soft-writing stainless steel nib with iridium point. High-quality ink feeder. Suitable for standard ink cartridges and ink converters. Suitable for left handed and right handed.

With new characters, new levels and new features, players can build and battle like never before. Solve puzzles that encourage creative thinking through the use of teamwork and unique building situations only possible in a LEGO Star Wars galaxy! TS41-1.desc: The fearsome Dark Lord of the Sith stands supreme with this great LEGO Star Wars T-shirt! Black shirt features Darth Vader and his red lightsaber, with the Death Star in the background. 100% Cotton!

TS43-1.desc: The fight for the Death Star is on! Darth Vader's TIE fighter fires its lasers at a Rebel Alliance X-wing against a star-filled background on this fun and action-packed black T-shirt. Will the heroes save the galaxy, or will the Dark Side rule? 100% Cotton!

TS44-1.desc: Darth Vader and the mighty Death Star stand ready to battle the forces of the Rebel Alliance on this fun and fashionable blue T-shirt. Show your allegiance to the Dark Side…or just show that you love LEGO Star Wars! 100% cotton.

TS45-1.desc: He may be small, but Yoda packs some serious Force skills -- and smarts, too! Show off your own wisdom with this LEGO Star Wars T-shirt, featuring Yoda the Jedi Master and the Rebel Alliance symbol. 100% Cotton!

TS59-1.desc: The evil Barraki called Kalmah brandishes his powerful tentacles and fires his squid launcher on this white BIONICLE short-sleeve T-shirt with red trim. 100% pre-shrunk cotton.

TS62-1.desc: Luke Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Yoda and Darth Vader come to life in LEGO minifigure form on this awesome LEGO Star Wars dark blue T-shirt! 100% Cotton!

TS64-1.desc: 'Beware of the Dark Side!' says Yoda on this 100% cotton dark grey, long-sleeved T-shirt featuring the wise Jedi Master and the mask of the evil Darth Vader.

W004-1.desc: It's the only watch you connect and build yourself! Start with the black, blue, white and grey pieces and build the watchband in any pattern and size you want. Add the studded bezel and minifigure, and you're ready to tell time the LEGO Star Wars way! Includes an R2-D2 minifigure! Watch face features an image of R2-D2 on a blue background! Water-resistant to 50m / 165 ft! Watch face measures 1" (2.5cm) wide.

W005-1.desc: It's the only watch you connect and build yourself! Start with the black, red and grey pieces and build the watchband in any pattern and size you want. Add the studded bezel and minifigure, and you're ready to tell time the LEGO Star Wars way! Includes a Darth Vader minifigure, with lightsaber! Watch face features an image of Darth Vader on a Star Wars background! LEGO ClicTime watches are tested to ISO standard 2281 to a static depth of 50m. This means that our watches are splash proof. Watch face measures 1" (2.5cm) wide.

W006-1.desc: It's the only watch you connect and build yourself! Start with the black, blue, white and translucent green pieces and build the watchband in any pattern and size you want. Add the studded bezel and minifigure, and you're ready to tell time the LEGO Star Wars way! Includes a Luke Skywalker minifigure, with lightsaber! Watch face features an image of Luke Skywalker on a Star Wars background! LEGO ClicTime watches are tested to ISO standard 2281 to a static depth of 50m. This means that our watches are splash proof. Watch face measures 1" (2.5cm) wide.

W007-1.desc: It's the only watch you connect and build yourself! Start with the black, white and yellow pieces and build the watchband in any pattern and size you want. Add the studded bezel and minifigure, and you're ready to tell time the LEGO Star Wars way! Watch face features an image of Clone Trooper on a yellow background Water-resistant to 165 ft (50m) Watch face measures 1" (2.5cm) wide PLEASE NOTE: Includes a Storm Trooper minifigure, with gun. Does not include a Clone Trooper minifigure.

WII063-1.desc: Play through the events of all six Star Wars movies in one video game, for the first time ever! With new characters, new levels and new features, players can build and battle like never before. Solve puzzles that encourage creative thinking through the use of teamwork and unique building situations only possible in a LEGO Star Wars galaxy! Experience new levels, such as Episode II's never-before-played high-speed pursuit of bounty hunter Zam Wesell! New playable characters like Watto, Zam Wessell, Boss Nass and more bring the total count to over 160! Create cross-Trilogy mash-up characters like "Han Windu" and "Lando Amidala." More new game features include enhanced Force powers, new power-ups, a new Challenge Mode, the ability to build, jump into and exit every vehicle, and much more! Rated E for Everyone. Order by November 30th to receive a special game code to unlock exclusive content!* *Exclusive content code will be included on your printed packing slip enclosed with your shipment. Exclusive content code is available only through the LEGO Catalog and LEGOshop.com.
tags: Lego Star Wars The Complete Saga

XB3076-1.desc: Play through the events of all six Star Wars movies in one video game, for the first time ever! With new characters, new levels and new features, players can build and battle like never before. Solve puzzles that encourage creative thinking through the use of teamwork and unique building situations only possible in a LEGO Star Wars galaxy! Experience new levels, such as Episode II's never-before-played high-speed pursuit of bounty hunter Zam Wesell! New playable characters like Watto, Zam Wessell, Boss Nass and more bring the total count to over 160! Create cross-Trilogy mash-up characters like "Han Windu" and "Lando Amidala." More new game features include enhanced Force powers, new power-ups, a new Challenge Mode, the ability to build, jump into and exit every vehicle, and much more! Rated E for Everyone. Order by November 30th to receive a special game code to unlock exclusive content!* *Exclusive content code will be included on your printed packing slip enclosed with your shipment. Exclusive content code is available only through the LEGO Catalog and LEGOshop.com.
tags: Lego Star Wars The Complete Saga

10184-1.desc: Celebrate the 50th anniversary of the modern LEGO brick with this special-edition update of the classic Town Plan set! Completely redesigned with the best of modern bricks, details and design, the all-new Town Plan features a 1950s-style gas station with pumps, carwash and garage, a town hall with a newly-married couple, a movie theater with ticket booth, seats and posters, 2 automobiles, 8 minifigures, rare LEGO colors and elements, and more. Includes a letter from company owner Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen, who appeared as a kid on the original Town Plan box and returns on this one! Includes 3 gold bricks to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the LEGO brick!

10185-1.desc: Expand your LEGO® neighborhood or start a new one with the Green Grocer! Designed in a modular style, this colorful and lively building features a grocery store and classic apartments that can be built, rebuilt and rearranged to suit your own LEGO town. Detailed architecture includes realistic interior, courtyard access, a roof terrace and fire escape, lots of windows and doors, and much more! Build a street layout by combining Green Grocer with 10190 Market Street and 10182 Café Corner! Top 3 floors lift off to reveal inner rooms! Grocery store features a blue and white awning, cash register, bins for bread, vegetables and fruit, refrigerator and tiled floor! Apartments have lots of details like bay windows, fireplace with tools, grandfather clock and windows that open to the fire escape! Stairs lead up to the apartments and to the roof terrace! Roof terrace has chairs, umbrellas, grill and flowers! Check the mailboxes for letters! Fire escape ladders move up and down! Access the courtyard behind the building! Street features lampost, fire hydrant and light fixtures! Includes 4 townspeople minifigures, plus a cat and rat! Measures 14" (35cm) high and 10" (25cm) wide!

10186-1.desc: The towering cyborg commander of the Separatist forces lives! Wielding lightsabers in each of his four robotic arms, General Grievous prepares to battle the Jedi Knights in a fight for the fate of the galaxy. Standing 18 inches (46cm) tall on its rotating display base and plaque, this detailed and authentic Star Wars model features poseable hips and neck and a split-apart chestplate revealing Grievous' organs hidden beneath! Includes translucent "light saber" elements! Model features poseable neck, arms and hips! Split-apart chestplate opens to reveal Grievous' organs! Includes rotating display stand! Stands 18 inches (46cm) tall with stand!

10187-1.desc: LEGO fans around the world named the famed Volkswagen Beetle as the classic car that they most wanted as a LEGO model…and now it's finally here! Based on the iconic 1960 'Charlotte' model, the LEGO Volkswagen Beetle features realistic details and functions like opening doors, hood and trunk, a spare tire in the front and engine in the back, an accurate interior, and more. Includes display plate with detailed specifications of the original Volkswagen model! Measures 16" (41cm) long and 6'½" (16cm) high! Realistic details include a movable stick shift, opening glove compartment and seats that fold forward! Features an engine in the back trunk and spare tire under the hood! Beetle details also includes a Volkswagen logo decal, windshield wipers and rearview mirror! Tires measure 2'½" (6cm) wide!

10188-1.desc:
Battle inside the Death Star™!
Recreate the action and adventure of the Star Wars™ movies with the ultimate Death Star playset! This amazingly detailed battle station features an incredible array of minifigure-scale scenes, moving parts, characters and accessories from Episodes IV and VI on its multiple decks, including the Death Star control room, rotating turbolaser turrets, hangar bay with TIE Advanced starfighter, tractor beam controls, Emperor’s throne room, detention block, firing laser cannon, Imperial conference chamber, droid maintenance facility, and the powerful Death Star superlaser…plus much more! Swing across the chasm with Luke and Leia, face danger in the crushing trash compactor, and duel with Darth Vader for the fate of the galaxy!
Includes 24 minifigures and droids, plus all-new Dianoga™ trash compactor monster!
Includes 6 new and exclusive minifigures and droids only found in this set: Luke Skywalker™ (Stormtrooper™ outfit), Han Solo™ (Stormtrooper outfit), Assassin Droid™, Interrogation Droid, Death Star Droid and 2 Death Star Troopers™!
Also includes Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Obi-Wan Kenobi™, C-3PO™, R2-D2™, Princess Leia™, Chewbacca™, Luke Skywalker (Jedi Knight), Darth Vader™, Grand Moff Tarkin™, Emperor Palpatine™, 2 Stormtroopers, 2 Emperor's Royal Guards™, R2-Q5™, and mouse droid!.
Movie-authentic Death Star environments include the Superlaser control room and target monitor, Imperial conference chamber, TIE Advanced hangar bay with moving launch rack, Emperor's throne room, droid maintenance room, detention block, trash compactor, and much more!
Rescue Princess Leia from the detention block cell, then escape through the secret hatch to the trash compactor below!
Reenact the final duel between Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader in the Emperor's Throne Room!
Death Star measures 16” (41cm) tall and 16½” (42cm) wide!
TIE Advanced measures 3½" (9cm) wide!
tags: Death Star I Orbital Battle Station
Death Star II Mobile Battle Station

10189-1.desc: The famous Taj Mahal jewel of India is known all over the globe for its incredible beauty and elegance. Now you can recreate this modern wonder of the world for yourself! Designed for experienced builders, the LEGO Taj Mahal model features advanced building techniques, rare elements and colors, and realistic details of architecture. With over 5,900 pieces, the Taj Mahal makes an awesome addition to any LEGO collection! Amazingly detailed model features the base, minarets, domes, finials, arches and stairs in the front Assembles in 3 sections for easier transportation The most elements ever featured in one set! Measures over 20" (51cm) wide and over 16" (41cm) tall

10191-1.desc: LEGO Space is landing with this special-edition LEGO Factory set, designed by a LEGO fan! Defend the universe from evil with the interplanetary Star Justice collection, including the space-soaring Cosmic Peace Keeper and Hypersled with sliding landing gear, the 8-wheeled Mobile Cargo Transport with working suspension and equipment storage, and the Star Outpost 7 command base, plus 4 astronaut minifigures and 4 scanner robots! Includes 4 astronaut minifigures, plus a stickersheet to customize each minifigure! Includes ground vehicle, 2 space crafts, command base and 4 scanner robots! Raise and lower the ladder on the command base! Lower the ramp to load and unload the Mobile Cargo Transport!
tags: Lego Factory and Lego Design Byme

10192-1.desc: LEGO Space is landing with this special-edition LEGO Factory set, designed by a LEGO fan! The evil Space Skulls are out to loot and pillage the galaxy, and no space police had better stand in their way. Striking from a hidden asteroid base, they attack with their 12-armed Skullmecha command vehicle, Skullfighter ship with opening cockpit, Hover Skull troop transport, and the sneaky Skullbot with blaster and grasping claw! Includes 4 space minifigures, plus a stickersheet to customize each minifigure! Space Skulls have transparent red eyes and terrifying teeth! Lift open to top of the Skullmecha to place a minifigure inside! Skullfighter ship has sliding wings! Open the mouth of the Skullfighter to put the minifigure at the controls!
tags: Lego Factory and Lego Design Byme

10200-1.desc: These custom hot rods are tuned-up, turbo-charged, and ready to burn up the road! Designed by some of the most talented LEGO fans around, they've got classic racing details, innovative parts and building techniques, and modular engines that you can swap from car to car, plus a racing garage with a working auto lift and removable roof to let you customize them even more! Includes 3 cars and drivers, mechanic with tools, High Speed Customs garage, 6 different hot rod engines, and a LEGO Digital Designer CD! Create your own custom models and order them online at LEGO Factory ! PC System Requirements OS: Windows XP Processor: 800 MHz or faster Video: 32 MB card (OpenGL 1.1 or higher compatible) Memory: 256 MB or higher Mac System Requirements OS: Mac OS X 10.3.9 or 10.4.6.8 Processor: G4, 1 GHz or faster Video: NVidia GeForce 5200/ATI Radeon 7500 or better Memory: 512 MB
tags: Lego Factory and Lego Design Byme

21000-1.desc: Introducing the LEGO Architecture Landmark series of real-world construction models! This striking black-and-white replica of the famous Willis Tower in Chicago, U.S.A. measures 9" (228 mm) tall and 3.1" (80 mm) wide at its labeled base, and includes a booklet full of details about the building's design and history, plus facts about the real tower. A creative and eye-catching accent for any desk, shelf or mantelpiece!Replica of real-world architectural landmark Willis Tower!Booklet included with details on design and history!Measures 9" (228 mm) tall and 3.1" (80 mm) wide!

2851146-1.desc: Arr! Whether ye be a seafarer or a landlubber, you can hoist your colors and set sail for treasure and adventure with the official LEGO Pirates T-shirt! Available in Youth sizes Small, Medium and Large. 100% cotton.

3830-1.desc: All aboard for new adventures with SpongeBob SquarePants, Patrick, and the Bikini Bottom Express. The bus keeps leaving without SpongeBob and Patrick! Can they get their tickets from the machine before it speeds away again? Lift roof off the bus to seat Spongebob and Patrick inside! Propeller on the back of the bus really spins! Bus measures 6" (15cm) long! Includes SpongeBob, Patrick and all-new bus driver minifigure, plus a ticket booth and bus stop!

3831-1.desc: SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy are blasting off on an expedition to find alien jellyfish! They've got their nets, their moon buggy, their space suits and everything else they'll need on their trip. Where will they end up this time? Features working loading bridge and opening rocket full of fun details to build and play with! Open the rocket to see the stations and equipment inside! Rocket is over 12" (30cm) tall! Includes all-new space-suited SpongeBob, Patrick and first-ever Sandy Cheeks minifigure!

3832-1.desc: SpongeBob's not just under the sea -- he's under the weather, too! Quick, load him into the ambulance-boat and drive him to the hospital. Good thing the doctor fish is there with all his medical equipment to help SpongeBob feel better...until the next emergency! Includes SpongeBob, Patrick and fish doctor minifigures! Place Patrick in the driver's seat of the ambulance-boat! Use the ambulance-boat to rush SpongeBob to the emergency room! Use the emergency room equipment to examine SpongeBob!

4210-1.desc: When there's an emergency at sea, the Coast Guard is always ready to come to the rescue! The elevated ocean base of the LEGO City Coast Guard has all the vehicles and equipment you'll need to save the day. Spot trouble from the command platform tower, take off from the landing pad with the rescue helicopter, and use the crane to lower the speedboat into the water to speed to the scene! Includes 4 minifigures, plus lots of accessories! Includes platform command tower, rescue helicopter and speedboat! Turn the gear on the crane to raise and lower the speedboat! Tower has control center and first aid station!

4268591-1.desc: Join the knights of LEGO DUPLO Castle! With this mighty shield on your arm, no evil warriors can defeat you. Child-sized shield is safe and sturdy for years of imaginative adventures.

4294200-1.desc: Always racing around? This LEGO Racers keychain is just the thing to keep up with your high-speed life! Featuring an authentic LEGO Racers minifigure and logo plate on a durable metal chain, it'll keep your keys in style! Includes official LEGO minifigure on a sturdy metal ring and chain! Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

440001-1.desc:
The Lego Indiana Jones Legends pack contains one silicone system glove for your DS Lite console, a Lego Indian Jones system wrap and an over-sized stylus pen for easier gripping.
*system glove mimics Lego pegs for a tactile surface
* Lego Indy artwork on the system wrap puts you right in the game!
* Full size stylus with the game logo allows for a more comfortable grip during extended gameplay

4837-1.desc: Choo-choo! Build any one of three fun train engine models: a classic steam locomotive, a modern diesel engine, and a tram. Includes instructions for all 3, and the pieces store in the portable and reusable box when you're done! Mini Train measures over 3" (7cm) long!

4838-1.desc: Build any one of three speedy vehicles: a car transporter with car, an off-road 4x4, and a mini tow truck! Includes Instructions for all three. When you're done, store the pieces in the portable and reusable box! Car transporter with car measures over 3" (7cm) long!

4862-1.desc: As the horse-drawn treasure wagon rolls through the forest, a wicked knight leaps from hiding. It's an ambush! Help the good knight protect the treasure and the kingdom. LEGO DUPLO pieces are colorful, fun and durable for younger hands. Includes good and bad knights, wagon, treasure and horse!

4863-1.desc: The bad knight watches the kingdom from his sentry tower! Help the good knight defend the kingdom with his horse-pulled catapult. Fire the boulder to knock down the enemy knight and the top of the tower! Safe, sturdy LEGO DUPLO pieces provide endless fun. Includes good knight and bad knight, plus horse and accessories! Roll the catapult to the tower and fire the boulder!

4864-1.desc: The wicked knight is attacking the castle with his firing cannon. Quickly, help the good knights protect the castle and the golden treasure inside! Imaginative, easy to build castle features lots of adventure and colorful, durable LEGO DUPLO bricks for smaller hands. Includes 2 good knights and bad knight with armor, plus a horse and accessories! Fire the cannon at the castle wall! Raise and lower the gate!

4993-1.desc: This cool car has it all! Twist the switch to open and close the convertible roof, then pop the hood to check out the powerful V8 engine. Includes instructions for rebuilding into a big truck or a working mini loader! Doors and hood really open! Measures 11" (28cm) long, 5" (13cm) wide and has 2" (5cm) wheels

4994-1.desc: Build a realistic and scary spider with eight long legs, big fangs and a bulging abdomen that can move up and down. Make it even scarier by rebuilding it into a creepy bug or slithering snake. Spider legs move at 2 joints! Spider measures over 10' (25 cm) side to side and over 8' (20 cm) front to back! Includes instructions to rebuild into a creepy bug or slithering snake!

4995-1.desc: No cargo's too tough for this mighty Cargo Copter! Use the Power Functions to automatically raise the cargo platform and carry it anywhere you want. Includes instructions for rebuilding the copter into a speed boat with Power Functions anchor or a plane with a Power Functions spinning propeller! Copter has propeller and rotor that really spins! Push the button to use the Power Functions winch to raise the cargo platform! Cargo Copter measures 12" (30cm) long and over 4" (10cm) high!

4996-1.desc: Need to get away? Relax in your very own beach house! This colorful building is packed with fun and realistic details, from the big sunlit windows to the barbecue and umbrella. Includes instructions for rebuilding into a cozy café or towering apartment building! Second floor lifts off to see stairs and fireplace on the first floor! Second floor has a balcony and a skylight that opens! Outside there is a patio with table, umbrella and chairs, and even a barbeque grill with chicken! Realistic details include mailbox, doorbell, flowers, walkway, light fixtures, chimney, tree and lots of windows! Beach House stands over 6.5" (17cm) high and includes a 5" (13cm) x 10" (25cm) baseplate Award Winner: iParenting Media's Excellent Products of 2008 2008 Parent's Choice Recommended San Diego Family's Holiday List Option Consummator's 5 Star Rating Oppenheim Toy Portfolio's Gold Seal NAPPA Honors Award iParenting Media's 2008 Excellent Products CTTC's 3 Stars Creative Child Magazine's Preferred Choice Award

4997-1.desc: Prepare to set sail! Load your ferry up with vehicles using the working back ramp and transport your cargo safely across the sea. Then use the geared lever to open the front doors and unload at your distant destination! Includes instructions to rebuild into a transport hovercraft or a cargo plane! Includes a car with trailer attached to load onto the ferry! Turn the gear to lower the ramp to drive the car onto the ferry then raise the ramp to set sail! Unlatch the front doors, turn the gear to open the doors, and drive the car off of the ferry! Ferry is on wheels to move it in any direction! Ferry measures 16" (41cm) long and 5" (13cm) wide!

4998-1.desc: Here comes the plate-backed Stegosaurus! This Jurassic dinosaur may have eaten plants, but it was no pushover -- just check out the four long spikes on its lashing tail! The Stegosaurus is fully-articulated with eyes that really light up! Includes instructions for rebuilding into a hungry T-Rex or a soaring Pterodactyl! Features movable mouth, tail, head and body! Includes a light-up brick! Measures 17" (43cm) long and stands over 8" (20cm) high!

5522-1.desc: Celebrate the 50th anniversary of the LEGO brick with this classic collection in fun retro packaging! Includes a great selection of traditional LEGO pieces for endless creative building and imagination. Includes a golden brick to commemorate the golden anniversary! Box shows lots of building ideas and inspiration!

5543-1.desc: Percy has had a busy day rolling down the tracks! Now it's time to relax in the shade at Tidmouth Sheds. DUPLO pieces are colorful, sturdy and safe for young hands! Includes Percy, shed, and signal! Percy measures over 4" (10cm) long and 4" (10cm) high!

5544-1.desc: Thomas is hard at work carrying coal around the island of Sodor. Along the way he passes Callan Station, a windmill, and a signal station. Can you help Thomas get his job done? Safe, colorful and durable LEGO® DUPLO® pieces are perfect for little hands! Includes Thomas, Sir Topham Hatt, tracks, station, water tower, and so much more! Turn the handle on the windmill to make it spin! Spin the signal to green or red! Tilt the coal into the carts! Full track measures 28" x 23" (72cm x 58cm) With carts attached, Thomas measures over 11" (28cm) long Award Winner: National Parenting Center's Seal of Approval Family Fun's Holiday List 2008 Oppenheim Toy Portfolio's Blue Chip Award TimetoPlayMag.com's Holiday List

5572-1.desc: Inside this sturdy and reusable storage case is a great collection of LEGO DUPLO bricks for endless imagination and creative building. Special elements include a friendly figure, a vehicle base with rolling wheels, bricks with eyes for building animals, and more! DUPLO bricks are big and safe for younger hands.

5573-1.desc: With this gigantic collection of LEGO bricks, you can make almost anything you can imagine, like houses, cool vehicles, airplanes, animals and much more. It even comes inside a sturdy and reusable storage box!

5574-1.desc: Start a LEGO® brick collection or just add to one with this great assortment of 280 colorful basic building bricks! Includes bricks in red, green, yellow, blue and white

5575-1.desc: Start a young builder off right with a great selection of 45 basic LEGO® DUPLO® bricks in 4 fun colors. LEGO DUPLO brick colors include red, green, yellow and blue! LEGO DUPLO pieces are colorful, large and durable for younger hands!

5576-1.desc: Add more basic LEGO® bricks to your collection to build even bigger and better models! Set includes 375 colorful construction bricks. Includes bricks in red, green, yellow, blue, white, and black.

5577-1.desc: Lots and lots of colorful LEGO DUPLO pieces! DUPLO bricks are large, sturdy and safe for younger hands. Let your toddler build, create and imagine! Contains 65 DUPLO brick colors in red, green, yellow, orange, blue, and light blue!

5578-1.desc: Create anything you can imagine with a whopping 500 colorful LEGO bricks in 8 colors! Classic LEGO elements are perfect for enhancing a LEGO collection or starting a brand-new one. Includes bricks in red, green, yellow, blue, white, black, grey, and light green.

5582-1.desc: This great collection of classic LEGO bricks has all the pieces you'll need to make your very own town. With houses of all shapes and colors, fun vehicles and even people to bring your town to life, you can use the building instructions or let your imagination go wild! Comes in a reusable plastic storage tub!

5583-1.desc: Now younger builders can make a car, a truck, a train or anything else on wheels they can imagine! Includes lots of big, safe, colorful DUPLO pieces with extra wheels for lots of rolling fun.

5584-1.desc: Build a cool car, a heavy truck, a high-flying helicopter or anything else you can imagine with the ultimate LEGO vehicle construction set! Includes plenty of rolling wheel pieces for lots of speedy vehicles.

5593-1.desc: The big top circus has come to LEGO Ville! The ringmaster welcomes the audience to an amazing spectacle with plenty of exciting circus acts. There's a high-wire acrobat with a tightrope, swing and cannon, a funny spinning clown with a cake to toss, and animal acts for the lion, monkey, horse and elephant! LEGO DUPLO bricks are safe, sturdy and fun for younger builders. Includes 3 figures, horse, monkey, lion and elephant

5596-1.desc: It's a happy day! The baby dinosaur has just come out of its egg and the mother dino is ready to take care of it. This colorful set includes egg, mother and baby dinosaurs! Mother dinosaur has movable neck that bends down to take care of baby! Attach baby dinosaur to the mother's back! Egg opens and closes!

5597-1.desc: Uh-oh -- a T-Rex is on its way! But the brave caveman is waiting to trap it by tipping rocks on its head. Can you help the caveman catch the dinosaur? Includes T-Rex dinosaur, caveman figure, tree, vine and other jungle elements! T-Rex's mouth opens and closes! Tree has a tipping function to drop rocks! Attach the caveman to the dinosaur's back!

5598-1.desc: Welcome to Dino Valley, where dinosaurs and cavemen live together in peace. But watch out for the T-Rex -- it's coming to steal all the food! Includes 2 cavemen and cave-boy, plus a cave that comes complete with cavemen drawings! Dinosaurs include a parent and baby Triceratops, parent and baby Pteranodon and a T-Rex with snapping jaws! Includes fishing pole, canoe and a fish so the cavemen to go fishing! Jungle has a tree, vine and a drawbridge that flips over!

5601-1.desc: Save the day with the Fire Station!

5602-1.desc: Can you help the policeman catch the robber? Speed to the scene of the crime in the police car with working lights and siren! With help from your trusty police dog, you can collar the crook and drive him back to the Police Station's jail. LEGO DUPLO pieces are colorful, safe and sturdy for younger hands. Includes police station, police car, 2 figures and a dog The siren and light of the police car really works!

5603-1.desc: The Fire Chief is always ready!

5604-1.desc: There's always something new to see and buy at the busy LEGO Ville Supermarket! Shop for anything you want, and then take it to the cash register where the friendly clerk will ring up your purchase. Register really makes sounds! LEGO DUPLO pieces are colorful, safe and sturdy for younger hands. Includes plenty of food bricks and 2 figures

5605-1.desc: From fire engines to airplanes, every vehicle in LEGO® Ville needs fuel to go! Help the busy driver fill them up with the Tanker Truck. Push the button to hear the gas flowing through the hose! LEGO DUPLO® pieces are colorful, safe and sturdy for younger hands. Includes 1 figure

5606-1.desc: Here comes the colorful circus train, complete with a friendly clown conductor and a baby elephant doing its umbrella act. LEGO® DUPLO® bricks are sturdy, safe, and lots of fun for small hands to build, take apart, and rebuild over and over again! Includes clown figure, elephant, and train

5607-1.desc: When you need to fix your tracks, the Track Repair Train is ready to go! Use the big loading arm to fill up the cargo wagon with bricks, then tip them out to build and repair. DUPLO bricks are safe and sturdy for younger builders! Includes builder figure!

5608-1.desc:
All aboard! Here comes the train!
This fun and imagination-inspiring set includes everything a toddler needs to start building and playing: train tracks, a bridge, a platform station, two passengers, a friendly engineer, and a motorized train that really makes sounds when you pretend to fill it up at the pump! LEGO® DUPLO® pieces are colorful, safe, and sturdy for young hands.
Train motor and gas pump make realistic sounds!
Track measures 23" x 28" (58cm x 72cm)
Requires 3 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included.

5609-1.desc:
A whole world of train adventures starts here!
This deluxe cargo train set has it all! Load and unload the train’s cargo wagons at the warehouse with the big loading crane and fun conveyor belt. LEGO® DUPLO® bricks are sturdy, colorful, and safe for a toddler’s hands.
Train motor and gas pump make realistic sounds!
Includes tracks, trains, vehicles, workers, and much more
Really makes sounds when you fill up at the station!
Raise and lower the hook on the crane!
Use the working conveyor belt to load and unload the train!
Fill up at the gas station!
Requires 3 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included.

5610-1.desc: The LEGO City construction worker is busy mixing cement. Making a big new building starts right here! Includes cement mixer and minifigure!

5611-1.desc: The LEGO City workman is busy keeping the city streets clean and tidy. Includes minifigure, garbage can, wheelbarrow and container!

5612-1.desc: No speeding in LEGO® City! This trusty police officer is ready to catch any speeders with his faithful police dog, speed limit sign and equipment. Includes police minifigure, police dog, speed limit sign and equipment

5613-1.desc: There's a fire in LEGO City! Good thing the brave firefighter is here with his extinguisher and all the equipment he'll need to put out the blaze. Includes firefighter minifigure and equipment!

5614-1.desc: LEGO Castle just got more magical! The Good Wizard is here to cast spells with his crystal ball, magic staff and wise owl friend. Includes wizard minifigure with magic staff, crystal ball and owl!

5615-1.desc: Villains beware, because here comes the Knight! With his shining armor and weapons, he's ready to defend the Castle against any foe. Includes knight minifigure with armor, shield and weapons!

5616-1.desc: Mining crystals on the surface of Mars isn't easy, but this mini-mining robot is ready to help the astronauts get the job done! Includes astronaut minifigure!

5617-1.desc: Watch out! A crafty alien is spying on the astronauts in his jet. Will the humans spot him in time? Includes glow-in-the-dark alien!

5618-1.desc: The troll warrior is out to conquer the LEGO Castle kingdom, and he's got a launching cannon and pet rat to help him! Includes armored troll warrior minifigure, wagon with flick-fire cannon and a rat!

5619-1.desc: The Crystal Hawk may be small, but it's built for speed and firepower! Battle the aliens wherever they strike with this fast-flying air fighter. Includes astronaut minifigure!

5620-1.desc: This helpful LEGO City worker is ready to keep the city clean with his street-sweeping machine! Includes minifigure, garbage can, 'trash' and tools.

5621-1.desc: Watch out for sharks and swimmers in trouble while you safeguard the waters of LEGO City with the Coast Guard Kayak! Includes Coast Guard minifigure, kayak and buoy.

6117-1.desc:
Doors and windows for your LEGO® creations!
This collection includes lots of doors, windows and shutters in different shapes, sizes and colors for all the houses and buildings you want to build! A great way to supplement your LEGO brick collection.

6118-1.desc:
Wheels and tires for LEGO® models on the go!
For cars, trucks and more, this collection of wheels, rubber tires, and related pieces has everything you need to take your LEGO creations on the road!

6119-1.desc:
Roof bricks for your LEGO® buildings!
This must-have 150-piece collection includes all the different red roof elements you’ll need to complete your LEGO® houses and other buildings!

6176-1.desc:
Lots of LEGO® DUPLO® bricks for lots of building fun!
The fun never stops with these colorful LEGO® DUPLO® bricks! LEGO DUPLO bricks are sturdy and safe for a toddler’s hands and imagination.
80 basic bricks in different sizes.
Includes bricks in red, green, yellow, blue, orange, light green, white and black.

6177-1.desc:
Endless building fun!
This special set contains 650 colorful LEGO® bricks you can use to build almost anything. The only limit is your imagination!
Includes bricks in white, orange, red, blue, yellow, brown, black, dark green, and light green!

6178-1.desc: Build houses, a car, and even trees and flowers! Colorful LEGO® DUPLO® bricks are big, safe and sturdy for smaller hands to build and play with. Imagination starts here, so let the fun begin! Includes a LEGO DUPLO figure and inspirational ideas!

6186-1.desc: Build a sailboat, a container ship, a crane, or anything else you can imagine with this ultimate LEGO Harbor building set! All aboard for fun! Includes 1 minifigure!

6187-1.desc: Build a truck, a front loader, a steamroller and much more with this exciting construction set! Includes 1 minifigure

7037-1.desc: The knights have captured a troll warrior and locked him in the prison -- but the other troll warriors are on the attack to get him back! The knights must use all their strength and skills to battle the rolling siege tower with its bridge and swinging dragon-headed battering ram. Includes 2 knight and 3 troll warrior minifigures with armor and accessories! Swing the battering ram through the castle's wall to release the captured troll warrior! Pull the string on the rolling siege tower to extend the bridge to the prison! Rolling siege tower has 2 flick-fire and 2"(5cm) wide wheels! Troll warrior tower is 8" (20cm) tall and 5" (13cm) wide! Castle tower is over 8'½" (21cm) tall and 2'½" (6cm) wide!

7038-1.desc: The evil trolls are on the march with their powerful assault wagon! Can the heroic knights stop the giant troll and keep the massive cannon from being fired? You decide! Includes troll warrior, giant troll, 2 knight minifigures! Chicken drumstick dangles over the giant troll's head so he will pull the wagon! Push down button and let go to send the missiles flying! Spikes and flag on wagon move up and down! Giant troll is 3" (8cm) tall! Wagon measures 4'½" (11cm) long and 4" (10cm) wide! With giant troll attached, set measures 9" (23cm) long!

7040-1.desc: The dwarves kingdom is under attack by evil troll warriors! It's up to the clever dwarves to fight back with their mining battle-wagon, equipped with triple spinning blades and a powerful catapult. Includes dwarf and 2 troll warrior minifigures! Pull the wagon's chain to launch the catapult! Front of battle-wagon features 3 rolling-powered spinning blades! Wagon measures 4'½" (11cm) long and 3'½" (9cm) wide!

7041-1.desc: The Troll Battle Wheel rolls, shoots and crushes everything in its way! The knights of LEGO Castle have never faced anything like the gigantic troll battle wheel and its hidden rapid-fire cannon. Can the knights' catapult and barricade trap stop it, or will the trolls roll and smash their way to victory? Fire the Troll Battle Wheel's cannon and launch the knight's catapult! Use the handle on the wheel to roll it fowards and backwards! Troll Battle Wheel stands over 7" tall and 5'½" wide! Includes 3 troll warriors and 3 knights!

7048-1.desc: Beware the crimson sails of the Troll Warship! With a crew of battle-hardened troll warriors at the oars and a towering Giant Troll for extra muscle, this fearsome ship attacks from the sea with a net, prison cage and firing launcher. Only the knight with the courage to ride the armored dragon has a chance at stopping it and saving the prisoner! Includes 6 troll warriors, a knight and dwarf minifigure, plus a 3" (8cm) tall giant troll and lots of accessories! Includes armored dragon that is 13" (33cm) long with a 13" (33cm) wingspan! Ship has a removable prison with a door that really opens! Use the working gear to lower the net and save the dwarf! The ship's launcher rotates 360 degrees and really fires! Help the troll warriors row to the beat of the giant troll's drum! Detach the two smaller boats from the ship! Troll Warship measures 20" (51cm) long, 13"(33cm) high and 5" (13cm) wide!

7583-1.desc:
It's a happy day for Bianca the puppy - she's won first prize in the dog show! Her mother, Bella, just couldn't be prouder!
Includes Bella and Bianca, plus doghouse and accessories!

7585-1.desc:
Fun at the horse stable!
Help Laura take care of her horse, Star, and its foal, Robin at the horse stable! When you're done, relax in the hay loft with some pink lemonade. It's sure to be a fun day!
Includes Laura and horses Star and Robin!
Horse Stable has lots of accessories including flowers, ribbons, carrots, kitten and more!

7586-1.desc: It's a happy day at Sunshine Home!

7620-1.desc: Indiana Jones and his father have found the treasure map that leads to the Holy Grail. But a guard is hot on their trail and the motorcycle chase is on! The gate is closing - Indy will have to crash right through it if he wants to escape! Includes Indiana Jones with hat, whip and bag, Professor Henry Jones, and guard! Includes Indiana Jones' motorbike with sidecar that detaches! Gate moves up and down!

7621-1.desc: Indiana Jones and Marion are trapped in a tomb filled with poisonous snakes! It looks like there's no way out - or is there? Help Indy bring the statue crashing down so he and Marion can escape! Includes Indiana Jones with hat, whip and bag, and Marion minifigures! Send the statue crashing through the wall to escape the tomb and to reveal a hidden hanging skeleton! Includes snakes that drop from the ceiling! Tomb stands 5'½" (14cm) high!

7622-1.desc: Recreate one of the greatest chase scenes in movie history with this exciting set! The villains have stolen the treasure and Indy must get it back. Riding on horseback, he chases the truck, but can he defeat the guards and win back the treasure? Includes Indiana Jones with hat, whip and bag, guards and a horse! Treasure chest is being transported inside the covered truck! Truck measures 6" (15cm) long!

7623-1.desc: Indiana Jones has come to a temple deep in the jungle in search of an ancient idol. But can he avoid the collapsing walls, shooting arrow traps, slithering snakes, spiked walls and a massive boulder rolling right for him? It's all out action, Indy style! Includes Indiana Jones with hat, whip and shoulder bag, Belloq, Satipo and pilot minifigures! Help Indiana Jones take the gold idol before the statue falls, get past the flick-fire arrows, swing over the pit using his whip, run from the rolling boulder and past the swinging swords to safety! Set includes 6" (15cm) long plane with snake inside, just like the scene from the movie! Features and details include skull rocks, bat, spider, spiderweb, skeletons, gold coins and more! Temple measures a total of 21" (53cm) long!

7624-1.desc: It's a battle in the jungle for Indiana Jones and Mutt as they face off against the sword-wielding Irina Spalko, the leader of the Russians, who have been pursuing them! Watch out for Irina's sword -- it cuts right through the table! Includes fully-equipped campsite with tent, campfire, table and ants! Includes Indiana Jones with hat, whip and bag, Mutt Williams and Irina Spalko minifigures!

7625-1.desc: In a terrific vehicle chase, Indiana Jones and his team attempt a daring river escape in an amphibious vehicle built to travel on both water and land! But the soldiers have a boat of their own, and they're in hot pursuit. Look out for the net trap, the snapping crocodile and snakes! Includes Indiana Jones with hat, whip and bag, Marion Ravenwood and two Russian Guard minifigures! Watch out for the soldier hidden in the tree! Drop the net from the tree! Vehicle measures 6" (15cm) long!

7626-1.desc: Look out! As Indiana Jones is trapped in a makeshift hideout, the mighty Jungle Cutter comes crashing through the trees, chopping down everything in its path with its giant spinning blades. Quick, launch Indy's rocket and watch the Jungle Cutter explode! Includes Indiana Jones with hat, whip and bag, Colonel Dovchenko and 2 Russian Guard minifigures, plus ants and break-apart trees! Turn the gear on the hideout to raise and lower the spider web! Push the Jungle Cutter forward to spin the blades! Push the lever on the back of the Jungle Cutter to pop the top pieces off! Jungle Cutter measures 9" (23cm) long, 4" (10cm) wide and has 2'½" (6cm) wide blades on the front!

7627-1.desc: What is the secret of the Temple of the Crystal Skull? Indiana Jones and Mutt want to find out, but first they'll have to get past Irina Spalko, and then survive the temple's collapsing stairs, firing spears, hostile warriors, and many other tricks and traps. Includes Indiana Jones, Mutt Williams, Irina Spalko, Russian Guard, 2 Ughs Warriors, armored skeleton and 3 Akator Skeleton minifigures! Temple features moving staircases, hidden rooms, flying objects and lots of cool details! Temple stands 10" (25cm) high! Base measures 15" x 10"!

7628-1.desc: Indiana Jones and Mutt have been captured by Irina Spalko and her henchmen! Taken to a secret South American airport, they must use their wits to escape. Can they work together to recover the crystal skull and battle their way to freedom? Includes Indiana Jones with hat, whip and bag, Mutt Williams and Irina Spalko, Colonel Dovchenko, pilot and guard minifigures! Includes plane, runway tractor and trolley, stairs to access the plane, plus Russian truck and a case that holds the crystal skull! Plane features working landing gear, propellers that spin and side compartments that open!

7644-1.desc: Look out, aliens -- here comes the MX-81 Hypersonic Operations Aircraft! Covered with high-tech alien-fighting weaponry, the MX-81 is five incredible vehicles in one, including a mining scout rover with quick-deployment platform, twin attack cruisers with swing-out wings, a mobile flying lab, and more. Just watch out for surprise alien attack! Includes 3 astronaut minifigures and 1 glow-in-the-dark alien minifigure and a new commander alien!

7645-1.desc: For any mission, on any surface, the MT-61 Crystal Reaper always has the equipment to get the job done. With its twin spinning harvester blades, rotating treads, and a detachable spaceship, rover unit and research lab, this rugged all-terrain vehicle is ready to collect the energy crystals needed to power the astronauts' vehicles and technology. But the alien strike-ship has a different plan! Includes 3 astronaut minifigures, 2 glow-in-the-dark alien minifigures and commander alien minifigure! Comes with step-by-step instructions to make your MT-61 Crystal Reaper fully remote controlled by adding LEGO Power Functions. Requires LEGO Power Functions items 8881 Battery Box, 8883 M-Motor (x2), 8884 IR Receiver and 8885 IR Remote Control, all sold separately.

7646-1.desc: Careful, astronaut -- your scanners may deceive you! Piloted by an elite Alien Commander, the ETX Alien Infiltrator attacks the mining robot from the air in its sinister flight mode, then quickly converts into a combat walker to continue the fight on land. If human reinforcements arrive, another fast change and it escapes into the Martian sky! Includes alien, alien commander and 2 astronaut minifigures! Convert the attack ship into a combat walker! Attack ship measures 13"" long; when in combat walker mode its over 8"" tall! Open the mining robot to put an astronaut at the controls! Mining robot has a drill, tools and measures 4"" (10cm) tall!

7647-1.desc: It's an alien attack! Quick -- transform the MX-41 Switch Fighter from 6-wheeled rolling ground vehicle to high-speed rocket jet! Features multi-mode conversion and alien attack vehicle. Transport aliens in the MX-41 Switch Fighter or store energy crystals! Converts from a high-speed rocket jet to a rolling ground vehicle! Open cockpit to put the astronaut at the controls! MX-41 Switch Fighter is 13' (33 cm) wide and is 9' (23 cm) long! Alien attack vehicle is over 4' (10 cm) long! Includes astronaut minifigure and a glow-in-the-dark alien!

7648-1.desc: The MT-21 Mobile Mining Unit is out on a mission, drilling for energy crystals and transporting them back to base in its detachable high-tech mobile laboratory. Just watch out for the alien and its jet pack! Detach the drilling vehicle to search for energy crystals! Front opens to seat minifigure driver and sides open to store energy crystals! Mobile Mining Unit measures 7' (18 cm) long! Includes astronaut minifigure and glow-in-the-dark alien with jet pack!

7649-1.desc: This powerful drilling rig may look like a simple base for mining energy crystals, but it's so much more -- when hostile aliens attack, the MT-201 Ultra Drill Walker converts into a massive 4-legged mobile tank-mech and thunders across the surface of Mars! Includes 2 astronaut minifigures and alien commander! Detach the high-tech observation shuttle to keep an eye out for the Alien Commander and his strike ship! Launch the missile at the alien attack ship! Turn the gear to spin the drill for mining energy crystals!

7667-1.desc: Send in the Imperial Dropship with its stormtrooper squad! Equipped with laser cannons and a detachable troop platform, this speedy space transport is ready to battle the Rebellion on any planet in the Empire. Includes 3 stormtroopers and shadow stormtrooper pilot! Lift back up to drop the clone troop platform into battle! Imperial Dropship is 4" (10 cm) long!

7668-1.desc: When the Empire is on the march, the Rebels fight back! The Rebel Scout Speeder is ready for action with a detachable rotating heavy blaster cannon and a crew of 4 new Rebel troopers straight from the Star Wars movies. Build your forces! Includes 4 Rebel trooper minifigures! Rebel Scout Speeder is 6" (15cm) long! Blaster cannon detaches from vehicle and rotates in all directions!

7669-1.desc: Blasting out of the new Clone Wars CG-Animated TV Series, it's Anakin Skywalker's customized Jedi starfighter! Fight the forces of the Separatists and the dark side with flick-firing missiles, retractable landing gear and an ejection button for R2-D2. Includes R2-D2 and new Anakin Skywalker minifigures! Jedi Starfighter measures 10" (25cm) long!
tags: Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

7670-1.desc: The Separatist army is on the attack! Roll into battle with the giant-wheeled Hailfire droid with 8 flick-firing missiles. The heavily armed and armored spider droid is close behind, backed up by a squad of battle droids! Includes folding Hailfire droid, spider droid, super battle droid, battle droid commander and 2 battle droids! Halfire droid has giant movable wheels and flick-fire missiles!
tags: Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

7671-1.desc: Bombard the enemies of the Republic from long range with the AT-AP (All Terrain Attack Pod) walker! Extend the retractable stabilizer leg, open the roof and side doors to access the cockpit, and elevate, rotate or release the top-mounted heavy blaster cannon. Includes 2 clone shocktroopers! Lift open the top and sides to access the controls! Blaster cannon rotates in all directions! AT-AP is over 8" (20cm) tall and over 6" (15cm) wide!

7672-1.desc: The sinister Rogue Shadow flies out of the Star Wars: The Force Unleashed video game! Carrying Darth Vader's apprentice on secret missions across the galaxy, this sleek black starship with rotating wings and folding landing gear is fully armed with blaster cannons, hidden missiles, and a firing rocket to destroy your enemies. Includes minifigures of Imperial officer and pilot Juno Eclipse, battle-damaged Darth Vader and Vader's Apprentice! Press the lever fire to the hidden missile! Rogue Shadow measures 13" (33cm) long and 12" (30cm) wide!

7673-1.desc: The skilled and silent Magna Droids are General Grievous' elite droid forces in the Clone Wars … and their specialized starfighter is just as deadly as they are! Equipped with a lever-activated cockpit, opening engine compartments, and a hidden missile launcher with flick-action rockets, this sleek ship is a serious threat to any clone troopers or Jedi Knights who dare to cross its path. Includes 2 Magna Droid minifigures! Push lever forward to flip open the cockpit! Sides open to reveal pop-up launchers! Back flips open to use the hidden flick-fire missile! Measures over 11" (28cm) wide and over 10" (25cm) long!
tags: Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

7674-1.desc: Battle the Separatist armies in space with the powerful V-19 Torrent starfighter, blasting straight out of the Clone Wars! Wings and landing gear move together automatically to switch between landing and flying modes. Authentically detailed with features including an opening cockpit, flick-firing missiles, and a new clone trooper pilot figure! Includes Clone Pilot minifigure! Launch the flick-fire missiles and open the sliding cockpit! Wings fold down and landing gear fold up to go from landing mode to flying mode! V-19 Torrent has a 21'½" (55cm) wingspan! Measures 9" (23cm) long and 9'½" (24cm) high!
tags: Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

7675-1.desc: When droids attack, it's time to call in the mighty AT-TE! This powerful 6-legged walker features details straight from the Clone Wars, including positionable legs, movable cannons, firing missiles, and armored hatches and cockpit that open to reveal the cabin and troop bay inside. Even with its flying STAP vehicle, the battle droid doesn't stand a chance against Anakin Skywalker and the clone army of the Republic! Includes Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka, Captain Rex, Clone Trooper and Battle Droid minifigures, plus Rotta the Hutt! AT-TE Walker has 2 missiles that really fire! Cannon on top rotates in all directions! Hatches open to reveal the inside cabins and troop bay with 4 seats and extra equipment! Open front to access the cockpit and to slide out the pilot seat! Measures 15.5" (39cm) long and 8" (20cm) high
tags: Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

7676-1.desc: Take the battle to the Separatists with the Republic Attack Gunship! This heavily armed and armored Clone Wars troop carrier can fly and land in any battlefield or hostile terrain. Features include opening troop bay doors, removable command station and healing chamber, positionable cannons, spy droids, flick missiles, a speeder bike that deploys from the back, and multiple decals to create different gunships for your army. But will even Obi-Wan Kenobi and Plo Koon be enough to stop the sinister Asajj Ventress and her double Sith lightsabers? Includes Obi-Wan Kenobi, Plo Koon, Asajj Ventress, Commander Cody and Clone Trooper minifigures! Side troop bay doors open! Open the front side compartment to remove the command station!
