The 2 cockpits in front and the 2 on the wings open! Features 8 positionable flick-fire missiles on top and 2 rotating missiles in front! Back hatch opens to deploy the speeder bike! Open the compartment on top to access the spy droids! Measures 14" (36cm) long, 17" (43cm) wide and 7" (18cm) high
tags: Republic Gunship Low Altitude Assault Transport
Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

7678-1.desc: The Separatists strike back with the mighty Droid Gunship! This heavily-armed vehicle straight out of the Clone Wars features wing-mounted laser cannons, movable nose-mounted blaster turrets, retractable landing gear, an opening cockpit, and 'bombs' that automatically drop with the turn of a gear. Includes Droid Pilot and 2 Battle Droid minifigures! Open the cockpit the put the Droid Pilot at the controls! Turn the gear to drop the "bombs"! Rotate the blaster turrets! Measures 10" (25cm) long and 9" (23cm) wide!

7679-1.desc: The powerful TX-130S hover-tank is the Republic's latest weapon in the Clone Wars! With heavy armor, two movable laser cannon turrets, an elevating gunner seat, hidden wheels and flip-out flick-missile launchers, it's sure to turn the tide of any battle. Includes 2 clone trooper minifigures! Flip out the sides to reveal the flick-fire missile launchers! Use the elevating gunner seat to control the laser cannon turret on top! Hover-tank is on wheels for realistic play! Measures 9" (23cm) long and 8" (20cm) wide!

7680-1.desc: Temperamental but tough, the Twilight is Anakin Skywalker's personal starship during the Clone Wars! He's rebuilt and upgraded all of its systems from cockpit to cargo bay, including retractable landing gear and wings that rotate from landing to flight modes, a firing flick missile, movable laser cannon turrets, the side-mounted escape pod and a working tow-cable winch. Includes Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka and R2-D2 minifigures, plus Rotta the Huttlet! The Twilight has moveable wings and retractable landing gear! Open the back to use the working tow-cable winch! Front and sides open! Detach the side-mounted escape pod! Rotate the laser cannon turrets on top! Measures 12" (30cm) long and 18" (46cm) wide!
tags: Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

7681-1.desc: Unleash the power of the Separatist Spider Droid! This towering engine of mechanical destruction from the Clone Wars strides across hostile terrain on four independently positionable stilt legs, then uses its moveable laser cannons to blast Republic forces. Includes Commander Fox, Clone Trooper, Battle Droid, Super Battle Droid and Battle Droid Commander minifigures! Rotate the laser cannon on top! Laser cannon underneath bends to change direction! Measures 6" (15cm) tall and 10'½" (27cm) wide!
tags: Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

7723-1.desc: When there's trouble on the water, the police send their seaplane to save the day. Open the side door and put the police pilot in the cockpit -- now you're ready for adventure. Propellers really spin! Includes pilot minifigure! Plane measures 14" (36cm) long and has a 16" (40cm) wingspan!

7724-1.desc: Celebrate 24 days of festive building with the 2008 LEGO City Advent Calendar! This all-new holiday set includes lots of minifigures and accessories, all leading up to the biggest model of all on the last day. A wonderful gift for any LEGO builder or the whole family to enjoy! Each day open a new window in the specially designed Advent Calendar box! Includes 24 city-themed surprises for the season, including LEGO minifigures, accessories and more! Includes 10 minifigures!

7726-1.desc: Mayday -- there's trouble at sea! Drive the rugged truck to the beach and launch the speed boat to go to the rescue. Includes boat, truck, trailer, and 2 minifigures! Speed Boat really floats! Open front compartment on the speed boat to store diving equipment! Trailer detaches from the truck! Truck holds equipment, plus diving mask with snorkel, flippers and oxygen tank! Speed Boat measures 6'½" (17cm) long! Truck and trailer together measure 14" (36cm) long!

7731-1.desc: The LEGO City postman is always busy! Drive the Mail Van through town and pick up all the mail on your route along the way. Truck doors really open! Includes bright yellow mail van, letters, red mailbox and postman minifigure! Open the back door of the mail van to deliver the letters! Open the mailbox to pick up and drop off the mail!

7732-1.desc: Have an express mail delivery to send? Load up the LEGO City Air Mail plane and get it there fast! Load up the plane with cargo and take off into the sky. Includes bright yellow Air Mail plane, minifigure, cart and cargo! Roof on plane opens to place mail package inside! Propellers on plane really spin!

7733-1.desc: Quick, you need to make a cargo delivery in LEGO City! Use the working forklift to load up the truck with pallets of supplies. When you reach your destination, detach the trailer from the truck and open the containers to unload! Includes 2 minifigures! Truck and trailer measure over 11" (27cm) long!

7734-1.desc: From LEGO City to far away and back again -- this big transport plane is ready to carry cargo anywhere you can imagine! Use the baggage truck to haul the cargo out onto the runway, then raise the lift to load the pallets onto the plane. You're ready for takeoff! Includes boarding stair vehicle and 3 minifigures! Plane measures over 20" (50 cm) long!

7736-1.desc: The Coast Guard is ready to save the day! Hop on the quad bike and race along the beach to help swimmers in trouble. Includes Coast Guard minifigure!

7737-1.desc: Patrol the beach in the powerful 4WD truck. When someone's in trouble, launch the jet scooter and race through the waves to save them. Includes truck, boat, trailer, diving equipment and Coast Guard minifigure! Includes mask with snorkel, flippers and oxygen tank for diving! Remove the jet scooter from the trailer! Trailer detaches from the truck! Truck and attached trailer measure 8'½" (22cm) long!

7738-1.desc: Boaters are lost at sea! Send out the Coast Guard helicopter! When you spot them, lower the self-winding winch, hoist the emergency life raft, and carry it back to shore. Better hurry -- that shark looks hungry! Includes helicopter, life raft, four minifigures and shark! Sides on lift raft open and close! Helicopter's propeller and rotor really spin! Open the sides of the helicopter to access the stretcher and equipment! Lower the winch, hook on to the life raft, and press the button to raise it up! Helicopter is on wheels! Measures 13" (33cm) long!

7739-1.desc: The tower has spotted an emergency - someone is in trouble at sea! Send out the Coast Guard patrol boat and use the crane to lift him out of the water. Includes patrol boat and command tower with dock! Includes four minifigures, shark, surfboard, buoy and lots of accessories! Patrol Boat really floats! Crane turns 360 degrees and moves up and down! Use the crane to lower the raft into the water! Lift the roof on the boat to access the controls! Lower the anchor into the water! Tower has a control station, first aid and a place to store equipment! Boat measures 17" (43cm) long and 4'½" (11cm) wide! Tower stands 12" (30cm) high and attached dock is 10" (25cm) long!

7741-1.desc:
Save the day in the sky!
Patrol and protect LEGO® City from the air! Watch for trouble in this police helicopter with copter rotors that really spins.
Includes pilot minifigure
Helicopter is over 7" (18cm) long

7743-1.desc: The police are able to keep watch and protect the city from anywhere with their mobile command center! The Police Truck is fully equipped with sides that open up, control room, tools, quad bike, and much more. Command station has a gate that really lifts open! Cab and trailer are detachable! Includes 4 minifigures With cab attached, truck is over 14' (36cm) long

7744-1.desc: The whole Police Headquarters is on alert to catch escaped prisoners! When you catch the robbers, throw them back into jail. This fun set can be divided in two and arranged however you like it. Includes police headquarters, prison transport truck, car and motorcycle Also includes 5 policeman, 2 prisoners and a police dog, plus lots of accessories Features realistic details, including gates that open, spotlights on roof, command base tower, garage doors that slide open and more! Set includes 2 prison cells with toilets and beds, keys hanging outside the prison cells, and even handcuffs to put on the prisoners! But be careful not to let the prisoners escape through the trick walls! Police Headquarters has rooms for interrogation, a coffee break, computer work, and a refrigerator with water cooler!

7884-1.desc: That cold-hearted supervillain Mr. Freeze is getting away with a set of stolen diamonds! It's up to Batman and his high-tech pursuit buggy to track down his frozen foe and use his harpoon to reel in the crook's sub-zero speedster. Just watch out for that freeze-ray! Includes Batman and Mr. Freeze minifigures! Batman's Buggy has flame and wing detail on the back! Mr. Freeze's vehicle has a freeze-ray on front and a place to hold a diamond on the back!

7885-1.desc: It's an underwater race to get the missing crystal! The Penguin's missile-firing sub is making waves, but Robin is on the way in his crime-fighting scuba jet! Can The Boy Wonder defeat the fowl fiend and his Penguin partners-in-crime? It'll take all of Robin's speed and skill to win this battle! Includes Robin and The Penguin minifigures, plus 2 Pinguins! The Penguin's submarine features flick-fire missiles and a firing rocket! Lift the roof off the submarine to put The Penguin at the controls! Robin's red, yellow and green scuba jet measures 5" (13cm) long! The Penguin's submarine measures 8" (20cm) long!

7886-1.desc: Here comes Harley Quinn in her big-wheeled hammer-slammer truck! Can Batman's high-speed Batcycle dodge her pavement-pounding mechanical mallet and put an end to the mischievous jester's crime spree? Fire the missiles and find out! Includes Batman and Harley Quinn minifigures! Batcycle features black wings and flick-fire launchers! Turn the knob on the back of Harley Quinn's truck to slam the giant hammer back and forth! Harley Quinn's truck has flick-fire missiles! Batcycle measures over 4" (10cm) long! Harley Quinn's truck measures 7" (18cm) long, 4" (10cm) wide and has 2" (5cm) wide tires!

7888-1.desc: When The Joker hatches a wickedly funny scheme to sell Joker-gas ice cream to the citizens of Gotham City, it's up to Batman to put an end to the laughing lunatic's practical jokes -- and to put The Joker behind bars once and for all! Roar into action with the Tumbler, Batman's massive armored crime-fighting car straight from the movies. Fire the rockets, but look out -- The Joker's ice cream truck packs a missile-sized surprise of its own! Includes Batman, The Joker, and Joker's Henchman minifigures! Open the cockpit of The Tumbler to put Batman at the controls! The Tumbler has a firing launcher and flick-fire missiles! Push down the ice cream cone on top of the truck to fire the hidden missile out of the back doors! The Tumbler measures 9" (23cm) long and 6" (15cm) wide! Ice cream truck measures 5" (13cm) long and over 2" (5cm) wide!

7979-1.desc: The 2008 LEGO Advent Calendar is full of LEGO Castle fun for the holidays! Discover and assemble a new character or accessory each day, from knights and a jester to a supper table and treasure chest. Each day open a new window in the specially designed Advent Calendar box! Includes 24 castle-themed surprises in all, plus a play mat printed on the box lid! Includes 9 minifigures!

8031-1.desc: Battle the Separatist armies in space with the Mini V-19 Torrent starfighter, blasting straight out of Star Wars: the Clone Wars ! The wings and landing gear can fold up and down to prepare for flight or landing. Measures 3" (over 7 cm) high and has a wingspan of 6" (15 cm)!
tags: Star Wars The Clone Wars Film

810010-1.desc: This green baby bedding is styled after a LEGO DUPLO brick for sweet dreams and a lifetime full of creativity and imagination. 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 70cm x 100cm for the cover and 40cm x 45cm for the pillow case.

810011-1.desc: This fitted green sheet is a perfect match for the #810010 baby bedding set. 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 40cm x 96cm.

810012-1.desc: This child's green bedding set is styled after a LEGO DUPLO brick, so it's sure to inspire lots of imagination and creative building! 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 100cm x 140cm for the cover and 40cm x 45cm for the pillow case.

810013-1.desc: Styled to match the #810012 child's DUPLO bedding set, this fitted green sheet is 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 60cm x 120cm. Bedstead not included

810020-1.desc: This pink baby bedding is styled after a LEGO DUPLO brick for sweet dreams and a lifetime full of creativity and imagination. 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 70cm x 100cm for the cover and 40cm x 45cm for the pillow case.

810021-1.desc: This fitted pink sheet is a perfect match for the pink baby bedding set (item #810020). 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 40cm x 96cm.

810022-1.desc: This child's pink bedding set is styled after a LEGO DUPLO brick, so it's sure to inspire lots of imagination and creative building! 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 100cm x 140cm for the cover and 40cm x 45cm for the pillow case.

810023-1.desc: Styled to match the #810022 child's DUPLO bedding set, this fitted pink sheet is 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 60cm x 120cm. Bedstead not included

810030-1.desc: Decorated with LEGO bricks and numbers, this blue adult-sized bedding set is sure to provide imaginative dreams and creative inspiration. 100% cotton and machine washable at 40 degrees. Dimensions are 140cm x 200cm for the cover and 60cm x 63cm for the pillow case.

8111-1.desc: With oversized turbines for high-speed amphibious action, Ha-Ya-To's new battle machine is ready to fight the robots on land, in the air and beneath the water! The mighty River Dragon features dragon scale camouflage armor and a transforming mini-robot weapon. River Dragon is over 5" (13 cm) tall! Includes Ha-Ya-To pilot minifigure!

8112-1.desc: Nowhere is safe in the Sentai Mountain jungle when the Battle Arachnoid is on the hunt! These robot battle machines strike with armor-piercing fangs, a transforming mini-robot weapon and a cockpit that detaches as an air attack vehicle. Battle Arachnoid is over 6" (15cm) long and 7" (18cm) wide! Includes robot pilot minifigure!

8113-1.desc: Takeshi's new battle machine is the heavy-duty Assault Tiger! This mighty mechanical warrior is armed and armored for all-out battle with tiger-stripe camouflage, a spinning mega-buzzsaw blade and a transforming mini-robot weapon. Now the EXO-FORCE team is ready to take on any foe! Assault Tiger is over 7" (18cm) tall! Includes Takeshi pilot minifigure!

8114-1.desc: Hikaru rules the jungle with his new Chameleon Hunter battle machine! With its cutting-edge stealth technology and camouflaged armor, it can vanish from sensors and then attack in a flash with its flame-blaster cannon, capture claw and transforming mini-robot weapon. The evil robots don't stand a chance! Chameleon Hunter is over 7" (18cm) tall! Includes Hikaru pilot minifigure!

8115-1.desc: Watch out, EXO-FORCE team -- the robots have a ferocious new battle machine on their side! Leaping from the jungle shadows, the 4-legged Dark Panther strikes without warning. Features an elevating cannon, transforming mini-robot weapon and two detachable attack flyers with Iron Drone pilots. With its spikes, Dark Panther stands 8" (20cm) tall! Includes 3 robot minifigures!

8117-1.desc: Watch the skies for the rumble of the Storm Lasher! With its giant spinning turbine blades and slashing mandibles, the ultimate robot air vehicle blasts into battle at supersonic speeds. Deploy and transform its weapon into a mini-robot scout for land battles! Storm Lasher has spinning turbines that move up and down! Measures 7" (18cm) long and 12" (30cm) wide! Mini robot has movable wings and is 4" (10cm) long! Includes robot pilot minifigure!

8118-1.desc: EXO-FORCE leader Sensei Keiken has been captured by the robots! Ryo drives to the rescue in the massive Hybrid Rescue Tank. Powerful battle tank bristles with weapons and features working treads, spinning turret, rolling wheel and auto-rotating blaster cannon. Tank turret separates to become a flying attack vehicle! Flying attack vehicle has movable wings and measures 9" (23cm) long! Hybrid Rescue Tank has working treads and a 3" (8cm) wide wheel! Tank is over 10" (25cm) long and 6" (15cm) wide! Includes Ryo and Sensei Keiken minifigures and transforming mini-robot scout!

8148-1.desc: With its all-new glow-in-the-dark headlights, the stylish EZ-Roadster is ready for some cool night cruising. Just build it and race! EZ-Roadster has glow-in-the-dark headlights! Measures 3" (8 cm) long! Combine with #8151 Adrift Sport to make a tough racing truck!

8149-1.desc: Race through the dark city streets with the turbo-charged Midnight Streak! Cool race car features hot metallic engine and decals and all-new glow-in-the-dark headlights. Just build it and race! Midnight Streak has glow-in-the-dark headlights! Measures 3" (8 cm) long! Combine with #8150 ZX Turbo to make a sleek racing truck!

8150-1.desc: The ZX Turbo is racing through the night! Watch its side exhaust pipes glow-in-the-dark as this touring car speeds down the city streets to victory. Just build it and race! ZX Turbo has side exhaust pipes that glow-in-the-dark! Measures 3" (8 cm) long! Combine with #8149 Midnight Streak to make a sleek racing truck!

8151-1.desc: Blind the competition with glow-in-the-dark roof lights as this pumped-up pick-up truck cruises with its giant spoiler in the back. Just build it and race! Adrift Sport has glow-in-the-dark roof lights! Measures 3" (8 cm) long! Combine with #8148 EZ-Roadster to make a tough racing truck!

8152-1.desc: There's a car chase happening in the streets! Follow the action from the news chopper with its glow-in-the-dark searchlight. Can the revved-up police racer catch up to the green speedster with glow-in-the-dark headlights? And is this just a chase or the ultimate race? Includes 2 LEGO Racers and news helicopter! Helicopter has glow-in-the-dark searchlight, police racer has glow-in-the-dark hood, and speedster has glow-in-the-dark headlights!

8153-1.desc: The Ferrari F1 truck is finally here! Drive the F1 truck to the track, unload it, get the racing tires from the storage compartments, mount them on the racing car and get ready to make racing history. All-new Tiny Turbos scale Scuderia truck is a 1:55 replica of the real thing. Combine with #8155 Ferrari F1 Pit for even more authentic Ferrari racing excitement! Includes Scuderia truck, race car and finish line! Truck is 8" (20cm) long with trailer attached!

8154-1.desc: Get your LEGO Racers tuned up and ready to drive at the Brick Street Customs racing garage! It's got everything you need, from the working car lift to the fill-up station, plus a tuner shop full of extra parts for your racers. Includes 7 tiny turbo racers and a flatbed transport truck with car-carrying trailer! Gas station has a drink machine, gas pumps, tire and oil cans! Work shop includes working car lift to inspect the car, spare tires, engine and more! Tractor trailer measures 13" (33cm) long! Racers measure 3" (8cm) long!

8155-1.desc: Travel with the Ferrari team to their next race in the official Scuderia Ferrari truck, then help get their cars ready in the pit stop garage! Includes garage and fuel pit, tools, truck, two F1 race cars, and car supply truck. 1:55 scale racing pit playset is compatible with all LEGO Tiny Turbos sets. Combine with #8153 Ferrari F1 Truck for even more authentic Ferrari racing excitement! Truck is 8" (20cm) long with trailer attached!

8156-1.desc: With only 30 race cars in production, the FXX is one of the rarest and most exclusive Ferrari vehicles ever made. This incredible 1:17 scale LEGO model is packed full of authentic features, including working doors, engine cover, and front trunk, a highly detailed and realistic interior, a replica 800 HP engine, and more! Hood, doors and trunk really open! FXX measures 11" (28cm) long!

8157-1.desc: At 1:9 scale and almost 1,000 pieces, this is the biggest official Ferrari F1 racer ever built with LEGO bricks! Incredible real-world features include a removable front spoiler and tires that really steer. Packed with realistic Ferrari details! Working steering system turns front tires! Front spolier is removeable! Measures 20" (52cm) long and 7" (18cm) wide! Tires measure 2'½ (6cm) wide!

8158-1.desc: Join Speed Racer at the wheel of the famous Mach 5 supercar as he races against his rival, the tricky Snake Oiler. Who will win the Casa Cristo Classic cross-country road rally? Includes Speed Racer and Snake Oiler minifigures! Includes Speed Racer's white supercharged Mach 5 and Snake Oiler's orange racecar! Cars measure 6'½" (17cm) long!

8159-1.desc: Racer X and Taejo Togokahn have teamed up to win the Casa Cristo Classic race! Do their turbo-charged racecars have what it takes to beat Speed Racer to the finish line? Includes Taejo and Racer X minifigures! Includes Taejo's red and black racecar and Racer X's yellow and black racecar! Racecars measure over 6" (16cm) long!

8160-1.desc: Cruncher Block tries to fix every race…but this time, the mysterious Racer X is out to stop him! But the masked racer will have to be careful -- Cruncher's massive semi truck is packed with tricks and traps like a hidden firing missile. Includes Cruncher Block, Racer X, Cruncher's Driver and Taejo minifigures! Launch the truck's hidden missile! Flip the cab's roof open to put Cruncher's Driver at the wheel! Truck's control center has a fish tank and works of art on the walls! Semi truck measures 13" (33cm) long and 4" (10cm) high! Racer X's yellow and black racecar measures 6'½" (17cm) long!

8161-1.desc: Speed Racer's new Mach 6 racecar is revved up and ready for the Grand Prix….but so are his opponents, Gray Ghost and Cannonball Taylor! Who will win the final race? Includes Speed Racer's white Mach 6 racecar, Gray Ghost's black and yellow racecar, and Cannonball Taylor's black and grey racecar! Set also includes checkered finish line, commentator box, Racer Motors car workshop and a large television to broadcast the race to fans! Includes Speed Racer, Gray Ghost, Cannonball Taylor, Pops, Trixie, Commentator and Spritle minifigures, plus Chim-Chim and more! Racer Motors car workshop has tools and tires needed to fix up the racecars! Commentator box has seats for two commentators, TVs to watch the race on, and a megaphone to broadcast the game! Racecars measure over 6'½" (17cm) long and 3" (8cm) wide! Commentator box stands 6'½" (16cm) high and 12" (30cm) wide!

8290-1.desc: Lift and load! Easy to build and fun to play with, the LEGO TECHNIC Mini Forklift uses a working mast and forks to pick up the included cargo pallet, just like the real thing. Push forklift down to pick up pallet and slowly release to lift! Over 4' (10 cm) long and 3'½' (9 cm) tall! Includes instructions for rebuilding into a high-speed Dragster!

8291-1.desc: Rev up your ultimate dirt bike with a working drive chain that powers the V2 engine, then challenge any off-road terrain with front and rear suspension and a working kickstand. For total functional realism, it's LEGO TECHNIC all the way! Includes instructions to rebuild into a Chopper! Dirt Bike has front and rear suspension, a working kick stand, chain and gear that really move, working 2-piston engine and front-wheel steering! Measures over 11" (28cm) long and 6" (15cm) tall!

8292-1.desc: Use the motorized Power Functions of the cherry picker truck to move the bucket and boom up and down…then flip the switch to make it rotate 360 degrees around! Realistic LEGO TECHNIC bucket truck includes instructions for rebuilding into a Dump Truck. Flip the switch to raise and lower the boom or to rotate it 360 degrees! Turn the gear on top to steer the front tires! Doors open and close! Measures over 12'½" (31cm) long and boom reaches over 16'½" (41cm) tall! Includes motor and battery box! Requires 6 AA (1.5v) batteries, not included.

8293-1.desc:
Power up your LEGO® Power Functions!
Add even more power to your LEGO® creations! Power Functions motor set includes a M-Motor, battery box, light cable, pole switch and additional pieces to add new functions and features to your motorized models.

8294-1.desc: The LEGO TECHNIC Excavator is loaded with realistic details and working functions, including mechanical actuators that raise and lower the articulated arm, an extending and contracting bucket scoop, 360-degree rotating cab section, and rolling caterpillar tracks! Download building instructions to rebuild into a Tracked Dumper! Turn the gear to raise and lower the boom, then flip the switch to move the bucket scoop! Rotating cab turns in all directions! Features turning caterpillar treads! Excavator measures 7'½" (19cm) long and 12" (30cm) high! Add motorized power with 8293 Power Functions Motor Set!

8295-1.desc: Lift nearly anything with this heavy-duty Telescopic Handler! It's loaded with realistic functions that you build right in, including a mechanical actuator that raises and lowers the extending boom, front-end stabilizers, and working four-wheel steering. You can even add 8293 Power Functions Motor Set to motorize the telescoping boom! Turn the knob on back to raise and lower the boom, then flip the switch the extend it! Tilt the front forklift to pick up the cargo pallet! Boom extends over 21" (53cm)! Telescopic Handler measures 15" (38cm) long and 15" (38cm) high!

8296-1.desc: This realistic dune buggy is ready to race! Functional LEGO TECHNIC model features working front-wheel steering, suspension system and moving rear-mounted pistons. Includes instructions for rebuilding into a Tractor! Dune Buggy has rear suspension, working pistons and a gear on top that steers the front tires! Measures 8" (20cm) long and over 3" (7cm) tall!

8297-1.desc: This rugged off-road truck is full of working details and functions, just like the real thing! Use the built-in motorized LEGO® Power Functions to raise and lower its ground clearance, operate the front-mounted winch, or turn on the bright LED headlights. Includes LEGO Power Functions accessories: battery box, lights, switch and motor! Turn on the working headlights! Features gull-wing doors and opening trunk and hatch! Off Roader has motorized suspension to raise and lower the truck! Use the motorized front-mounted winch! Features V8 engine with moving pistons and working steering system! Download building instructions to rebuild into a Buggy! Measures 15" (39cm) long Requires 6 AA (1.5V) batteries, not included.

8490-1.desc: This desert buggy Power Racer with pull-back motor is ready to jump, and it even comes with its own kangaroo-crossing ramp to get airborne! Can you make the Desert Hopper jump further than your friends? Combine with #8491 Ram Rod to make a 4-wheel-drive pull-back racer and ramp! Includes jump ramp, gate and racer with a pull-back motor! Desert Hopper is 5" (13cm) long!

8491-1.desc: No warning sign keeps this hot rod Power Racer from jumping! Pull back, let go, and watch the Ram Rod speed up the ramp, through the blockade and into the air. Combine with #8490 Desert Hopper to make a 4-wheel-drive pull-back racer and ramp! Includes jump ramp, gate and racer with a pull-back motor! Measures 5" (13cm) long!

8492-1.desc: Rough road ahead? No problem for this off-road dirt Power Racer! Use the pull-back motor and steep jump ramp to launch the Mud Hopper high into the air. Combine with #8493 Red Ace to make a flame racer and monster jumping ramp! Includes jump ramp and racer with a pull-back motor! Mud Hopper over 5" (13cm) long!

8493-1.desc: Will you jump high, or crash and burn? Pull back the Red Ace and let go to watch this blazing fast Power Racer speed up the fiery ramp and into the air! Combine with #8492 Mud Hopper to make a flame racer and monster jumping ramp! Includes jump ramp and racer with a pull-back motor! Red Ace is 5" (13cm) long!

8494-1.desc: It's the ultimate Power Racers stunt show! Pound the power slammer to send the racing buggy up the ramp and through the 'blazing' Ring of Fire. Wind-up motor makes the ring really spin! Includes racer, power slammer, ramp and ring of fire! Use the slammer to race the car up the ramp! Pull the string to wind up the motor and make the ring really spin!

8495-1.desc: Get ready for incredible speed and action! Seven lightning-fast racers are speeding toward the finish line: an off-road buggy, a big-wheeled truck, a fiery red racecar, a stretch limo, a surfer pick-up, a tuned-up van and a big racing rig with a car-carrying trailer. Who will cross the city first and take home the prize? Includes 7 tiny turbo racers and street light! Tractor trailer measures 10" (25cm) long!

8496-1.desc: It's the ultimate desert showdown! Use the pull-back motor and power slammer launcher to send these two tough Power Racers blazing up the ramp and hurtling through the wild Western ring with swinging hammer pendulum. In this match of speed and timing, who will win…and who will get smashed down? Includes 2 racers, ramps, ring with swinging pendulum, and slammer! Use the pull-back motor and slammer to send the racer up the ramp! Jump the racers through the ring! Try not to crash into the swinging hammer pendulum!

850353-1.desc:
Collect these great LEGO key chains!
Keep your keys on the coolest key chains in town!

850378-1.desc: For the ultimate LEGO Fan pack your sandwiches and a drink in LEGO lunchbox, making your lunch more colourful. Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

851626-1.desc: Keep your keys on the coolest key chain in town or just collect them all and attach them to your back pack.

851659-1.desc: Let Boba Fett guard your keys!

852145-1.desc: The greatest adventurer of all time is back…and ready to protect your keys! Includes official LEGO Indiana Jones minifigure on a sturdy metal ring and chain! Indiana Jones comes with signature hat and shoulder bag! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Indiana Jones fan!

852146-1.desc: Before Indiana Jones, there was his father Professor Henry Jones! Guard your keys for posterity with this wise and seasoned adventurer. Includes official LEGO minifigure on a sturdy metal ring and chain! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Indiana Jones fan!

852147-1.desc: Get ready for a motorcycle chase with this guard minifigure straight from the LEGO Indiana Jones collection! Includes official LEGO minifigure on a sturdy metal ring and chain! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Indiana Jones fan!

852165-1.desc: Turn the key and this enchanted jewelry box plays music while the fairy bunny dances. Store your fairy treasures and more! Heart-shaped jewelry box features a Belville fairy on top with dragonflies! Open the box using the pink ribbon and heart-shaped gem attached! Inside features a dancing bunny that spins and plays music, plus a mirror for putting your jewelry on! Box measures 3" (8cm) high, 6" (15cm) wide and 5" (13cm) long!

852171-1.desc: It's a new battle for the heroes of BIONICLE, and you can join in the adventure! Use your Midak Skyblaster to launch safe, durable light-spheres at the evil Makuta and help the Toa Nuva save Karda Nui. Includes 4 lightweight foam balls that are safe for play! Sphere Shooter measures 19" (48 cm) long!

852172-1.desc: Pohatu Nuva blasts into action on this striking grey BIONICLE Phantoka T-shirt with black trim. 100% cotton. Child's Age Child's Height (cm) 5-6 years 120 cm 7-8 years 130 cm 9-10 years 140 cm

852194-1.desc: Hailing from the Dwarve Kingdom, this brave warrior will keep your keys safe from any trolls, wizards or skeleton warriors that may try to steal them. Includes authentic LEGO minifigure with sturdy metal chain and loop! Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852198-1.desc: Charge into battle! This safe, sturdy, child-sized play axe is perfect for imagination, fun, and fighting the forces of evil, just like the brave warriors of LEGO Castle. Made of foam for safe and durable play!

852204-1.desc: This motorcycle cop means serious business -- serious fun, that is! Protect the streets of LEGO City with this black distinctive T-shirt with grey trim. 100% cotton.

852206-1.desc: Carry your books, lunch and other gear in style with this sturdy and durable multi-compartment zippered backpack…just like the ones the LEGO City firefighters wear! Orange and red backpack features LEGO City fire decals and designs! Back has the LEGO City logo and an embroidered firefighter helmet! Backpack has a zippered front pocket, side net pockets, and an inside pocket with a hook and loop fasterner! Backpack measures 13" long x 8" wide x 5" deep (33 cm x 20cm x 13cm).

852214-1.desc: Construct a tasty meal with these LEGO brick-shaped salt and pepper shakers! A perfect conversation piece or gift for the LEGO builder in your life. Measures 1.5" (3.5cm) tall and 1" (2.5cm) wide.

852216-1.desc: The Easter Bunny has found the perfect hiding place for a colorful green egg -- on your fridge! This fun and festive Easter scene makes a great gift or decoration. Magnet set includes a bunny, a green egg and 2 flowers! Features strong magnets for gripping any magnetic surface. Makes a great Easter Gift.

852217-1.desc: It's a friendly, plush bunny toy…and so much more! Designed for younger builders' hands and a lifetime of creativity and imagination. Includes a bag of 21 LEGO DUPLO bricks in fun colors! Includes inspiration to build a bunny out of DUPLO bricks! Makes a great gift!

852221-1.desc: This blue retro-style T-shirt captures classic LEGO building sets and an older generation's classic LEGO construction fun! 100% cotton.

852231-1.desc: This fun and authentic LEGO Castle coin bank is just the thing to keep your loose change safe. Spin the handle and a fierce dragon pops out to retrieve your coins and guard them until you need them!

852238-1.desc: Straight from the undersea world of SpongeBob SquarePants, it's boating instructor Mrs. Puff, ready to guard the keys to your boat…and anything else! Includes authentic LEGO minifigure with a sturdy metal chain! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or SpongeBob fan!

852239-1.desc: Ready for an outer space adventure? This space-suited SpongeBob is all set to go wherever you do. Includes authentic LEGO minifigure sturdy metal chain and logo plate! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or SpongeBob fan!

852240-1.desc: With her spacesuit and helmet, SpongeBob's friend Sandy is here to guard your keys…wherever your adventures take you! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or SpongeBob fan!

852244-1.desc: A legion of Imperial Stormtroopers defends the Death Star on this fun and striking blue LEGO® Star Wars T-shirt with black trim. 100% cotton.

852245-1.desc: This LEGO Star Wars landspeeder mini-model is built to travel fast…on your bag or anywhere else you attach it with the sturdy metal key chain and LEGO logo plate!

852246-1.desc: Slave I is ready to carry out its next mission…on your bag! Sturdy metal key chain and LEGO logo plate let you take this sleek LEGO Star Wars mini-model starship anywhere you want to go.
tags: Boba Fett's Slave I Firespray-31-class Starship

852247-1.desc: Attach this LEGO Star Wars Jedi starfighter mini-model to your bag with its sturdy metal key chain, complete with LEGO logo plate. Don't battle the Sith without it!

852270-1.desc: Your coins will always stay safe with this colorful light green coin purse, featuring a beautiful fairy, pink and white flowers, and a dragonfly zipper charm.

852271-1.desc: Whether you're building your LEGO Castle army or defending the kingdom from evil skeleton warriors, these brave knights are here to save the day. Includes 5 heroic minifigures equipped with lots of different weapons, shields and armor!

852272-1.desc: Knights of LEGO Castle beware -- the skeleton warriors have brought reinforcements! Build up your skeleton army with this set of 5 skeleton minifigures. Includes 5 different evil skeletons equipped with plenty of weapons, armor and gear, plus a creepy spider!

852273-1.desc: This fun and colorful authentic 2x4 LEGO brick will go wherever you and your keys do!Includes sturdy metal loop and chain!Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852274-1.desc: This fun and colorful authentic 2x4 LEGO brick will go wherever you and your keys do! Includes sturdy metal loop and chain! Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852279-1.desc: Blast the evil Makuta with extra light-spheres for your Midak Skyblaster! Includes 6 safe and durable foam balls for use with 852171 Phantoka Sphere Shooter (not included)!

852283-1.desc: Happy memories are always in fashion with this fun and stylish LEGO Belville picture frame!

852286-1.desc: Have LEGO fashion fun, at home or on the run! This beautiful Fashion Diary Stationery Set includes pens, pencils, stickers, a pencil sharpener and lots more! Includes diary with stickers, page holders, and a string closure! Set also includes 3 pens with glitter ink, 2 pencils, 2 erasers and pencil sharpener! Complete set comes in a Belville box measuring 13" (33cm) long and 9" (23cm) wide!

852292-1.desc: This DUPLO farm activity set is full of hours of creative fun for young imaginations! Features a coloring section, a play section with cut-out DUPLO people and animals, and 8 colorful crayons.

852293-1.desc: There's never been a chess set like this one before! Now you can build the biggest and best LEGO chess board of all time, covered in incredible LEGO Castle details and complete with a dungeon, armory, and decorative dragon heads…and that's just the board itself! Pieces include king, queen, good and evil wizards, witch, knights, dwarves, trolls, skeleton warriors and horses, castle turrets, rolling siege towers, and more. It's the ultimate LEGO set for any chess player, collector, or LEGO Castle fan! Includes 31 minifigures, 2 giant trolls, 2 horses, 2 skeleton horses and 2 dragon heads! Minifigures are ready for battle with armor, swords, shields, and other cool accessories! It's a battle of good dwarves and knights vs. evil trolls and skeletons! Build the 4 realms in the corners of the chess board - the skeleton realm, troll realm, dwarf realm and castle realm! Measures 17" (43cm) squared! Complete with a giant storage case, measuring over 24" (61cm) high, 20" (50cm) wide and 7" (17cm) deep.

852294-1.desc: Join the mighty Dwarf warriors and defend LEGO Castle from evil trolls, wicked wizards, and fire-breathing dragons! Kid-sized costume helmet is just the thing for endless imagination and fun.

852302-1.desc: Join the LEGO Agents on a secret mission to save the world! This handy super-spy gadget pen clips on to stay with you no matter how much the action heats up.

852309-1.desc: This special LEGO brick comes attached to a sturdy metal keychain and really lights up at the push of a button!

852312-1.desc: Show the world you're ready to defend Gotham City from the forces of evil with the official LEGO Batman cap! Black cap features Batman and logo on the front, and eyes on the back that really glow in the dark!

852314-1.desc: Have no fear -- Batman has sworn to protect the streets of Gotham City…and your keys! Sturdy metal key chain includes authentic LEGO Batman minifigure and LEGO logo plate! Makes a great gift!

852315-1.desc: Straight from the world of LEGO Batman, the wild and wacky Harley Quinn is here to guard your keys! Includes official LEGO Batman minifigure on a sturdy metal ring and chain! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Batman fan!

852317-1.desc: Crooks and evildoers beware! LEGO Batman stands with Batarang at the ready on this black T-shirt. Available in sizes 5/6 Y, 7/8 Y, and 9/10 Y. 100% cotton.

852318-1.desc: Whether you're at school or on vacation, thanks to the Phantoka backpack, you never have to leave the action and adventure of BIONICLE behind! Backpack measures 17" (43cm) long x 11" (28cm) wide x 6" (15cm) deep! Features front and side compartments!

852319-1.desc: Even action heroes need refreshment! This tough aluminum drinking bottle features the BIONICLE logo and is ready to travel wherever you do. Measures 2'½" (6cm) wide and 6" (15cm) tall! Made of aluminum, not dishwasher safe.

852323-1.desc: This fun and durable wallet features designs and characters straight from the action-packed BIONICLE universe!

852330-1.desc: This fun and colorful lanyard with sturdy metal clip will tell the world you're a LEGO fan!

852331-1.desc: Everybody loves a classic! Celebrate the 30th anniversary of the LEGO minifigure with this unique collection of 5 famous figures from through the years. From the vintage 1978 astronaut to the mad scientist of 2002 and beyond, these friendly, smiling characters have always made building fun!

852333-1.desc: Spell your name and other words with this special keychain, featuring lots of letter elements, a sturdy metal clip, and a red LEGO brick!

852335-1.desc: Celebrate the 50th anniversary of the classic LEGO brick with this fun and colorful spiral-bound LEGO System notebook! Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan! Elastic strap keeps notebook closed! Measures 6" x 6" (15cm x 15cm)!

852336-1.desc: Celebrate the 50th anniversary of the LEGO brick! Write anywhere, any time with this fun and colorful LEGO-logo mechanical pencil and pen set! Includes mechanical pencil and pen! Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852339-1.desc: Big building project or just having fun? Spread out this LEGO play rug before you pile up your bricks, and cleaning up afterwards will be a breeze. Handles and latch let you close it up for easy transportation with all the bricks held safely inside. No more lost or missing pieces! Play Rug measures 39" x 39" (99cm x 99cm)!

852341-1.desc: Make your own delicious frozen minifigure treats with this unique popsicle mould! Makes 3 minifigure popsicles at a time!

852346-1.desc: 'Size matters not' rings especially true when you're a LEGO minifigure! Yoda the wise Jedi Master holds his glowing lightsaber on this iconic black LEGO Star Wars T-shirt. Available in youth sizes 5/6, 7/8 & 9/10 and adult sizes S, M, L, XL & XXL. 100% Cotton

852347-1.desc: Protect your keys with the Emperor's personal squad of shock troopers! This sturdy metal keychain features an authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Star Wars fan!

852348-1.desc: When the Empire strikes, the Rebels are here to save the galaxy…and your keys! Sturdy metal keychain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun. Makes a great gift!

852349-1.desc: The black-armored Shadow Troopers are specially trained for the Empire's most secret missions…like guarding your keys! Sturdy metal key chain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun. Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan!

852350-1.desc: Before he was Darth Vader, Anakin Skywalker protected the galaxy from the forces of evil…just like he'll protect your keys! Sturdy metal keychain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Clone Wars fan!

852351-1.desc: Brave Jedi Knight and Clone Wars general, Obi-Wan is here to save the galaxy…and defend your keys from the evil Sith! Sturdy metal keychain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun. Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Clone Wars fan!

852352-1.desc: Jedi Knight Plo Koon blasts out of the Clone Wars on a secret mission to protect your keys! Sturdy metal keychain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun. Makes a great gift!

852353-1.desc: Leaping straight off the screen of The Clone Wars , the brave Jedi apprentice Ahsoka is here to defend the Republic -- and your keys! Sturdy metal key chain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun! Makes a great gift!

852354-1.desc: A powerful warrior and agent of the Sith, Asajj Ventress has arrived from the Clone Wars to protect your keys from any who would dare try to take them. Sturdy metal key chain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Star Wars fan!

852355-1.desc: Straight from the Clone Wars, clone trooper officer Commander Cody is here to guard your keys from all enemies of the Republic! Sturdy metal key chain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun! Makes a great gift!

852356-1.desc: Loyal clone trooper squad leader Captain Rex has been specially trained to protect your keys, no matter the odds. Sturdy metal key chain includes authentic LEGO Star Wars minifigure and plenty of fun! Makes a great gift for any LEGO or Star Wars fan!

852394-1.desc: Defend the LEGO Castle with this safe and sturdy child-sized sword, perfect for imagination, adventures and fun!

852395-1.desc: Celebrate the 50th anniversary of the famous LEGO brick with this classic red LEGO System spiral-bound notebook!

852396-1.desc: This twin-pocket portfolio features the classic LEGO System logo to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the LEGO brick! Makes a great gift for any LEGO fan! Measures 9" x 12" (23cm x 30cm)!

852397-1.desc: This colorful red report cover celebrates the 50th anniversary of the classic LEGO brick!

852445-1.desc: Celebrate the 50th anniversary of the classic LEGO brick with this gleaming commemorative keychain!

852454-1.desc: With the famous LEGO logo printed on four sides and a blank white writing surface, this note block will look classy -- and classic -- on any desk!

852458-1.desc: These sturdy plastic paper clips in five fun colors do something that no other paper clips do -- they snap together and pop apart just like real LEGO bricks! Stack them, clip them, and display them for organization, storage and fun! Includes 5 brightly colored brick paper clips!

852459-1.desc: With pockets for 21 photographs including the front cover, this spiral-bound LEGO photo album features a real LEGO baseplate on its cover and locking clasp. It's perfect for storing and sharing favorite memories…and building new ones! Take pictures of your LEGO creations and display them in your LEGO Photo Album! Decorate the baseplate on the front cover with LEGO bricks! Display a picture of your favorite LEGO creation on the front cover! Album holds 20 4" x 6" (10cm x 15cm) pictures inside! LEGO logo plate snaps on baseplate to close the album!

852460-1.desc: These fun magnetic photo frames are made from real LEGO bricks, so you can take them apart, add the photo of your choice, rearrange parts and colors, snap them back together, and stick them onto any metal surface for play and display! Includes 2 frames, each made of 4 LEGO pieces! Add more LEGO bricks or minifigures to customize your photo frame! Frames measure 2" x 2¼" (5cm x 6cm)!

852461-1.desc: These colorful gift tag stickers feature a LEGO Santa, Mrs. Claus, Christmas tree, presents and more. A fun and festive decoration for any gift! 10 stickers included.

852462-1.desc: This bright yellow wrapping paper is decorated with lots of fun LEGO bricks! Includes 2 sheets of 70 x 100 cm (27.6 x 39.4 in) wrapping paper, plus 2 LEGO gift tags.

852467-1.desc: Decorate your fridge, desk, or any other metal surface with these 3 colorful magnets! Each one is a real LEGO brick compatible with other LEGO pieces on one side, so you can build gravity-defying constructions on them while they hold your notes and lists! Includes 3 colorful magnets! Each magnet measures 1.25" by 1.25" (3cm x 3cm)! Magnets are not stackable with each other

852468-1.desc: Build on your desk, your fridge and more with these 5 colorful magnets! Each one is LEGO brick compatible on one side. Use them to hold your notes, build on them with your LEGO brick collection…or both! Includes 5 colorful magnets! Each magnet measures 1.25" by 1.25" (3cm x 3cm)! Magnets are not stackable with each other.

852469-1.desc: Who said holding your notes had to be boring? These 10 colorful magnets are LEGO brick compatible on one side with your entire collection! Build on them and create fun and crazy LEGO sculptures that stick to your fridge, desk and other metal surfaces. Includes 10 colorful magnets! Each magnet measures 1.25" by 1.25" (3cm x 3cm)! Magnets are not stackable with each other.

852660-1.desc: Serve the coolest drinks around with ice that looks like LEGO bricks, or build your own LEGO ice 'sculpture'! Made of durable silicone Ice cube tray makes 10 ice 'bricks' at a time! Dishwasher safe.

853077-1.desc: Show the world you're a LEGO fan -- carry your lunch in this great LEGO lunchbox! Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

8630-1.desc: Dr. Inferno's henchmen have stolen gold bars from a secret temple hidden in the jungle! Only one thing can reach them in time: the LEGO Agents supersonic jet! The mission is to fly to the scene, track down their high-speed attack jeep and retrieve the gold bars at any cost. Good luck, Agent! Includes Agent Fuse, Gold Tooth and Henchman minifigures! Lift the truck's hood to reveal the hidden missiles! Open the jet's cockpit to put Agent Fuse at the controls! Jet has twin rocket launchers that really fire! Hit the target on the truck to knock the gold bars off! Truck has enhanced suspension! Supersonic jet measures over 8" (20cm) long and 8'½" (22cm) wide! Truck with trailer attached measures 9" (23cm) long!

8631-1.desc: Dr. Inferno's evil henchman Saw Fist has stolen an energy crystal and is escaping through the mountains on his armed and dangerous snow mobile! It's up to the LEGO Agent to catch the criminal using his top secret jet-powered heli-pack and grappling line. Get that crystal back, no matter the odds! Includes Agent Chase and Saw Fist minifigures! Jetpack has spinning rotor and hook to grab the crystal! Snow mobile has a moving high-speed tread! Snow mobile measures 5" (13cm) long!

8632-1.desc: A vital treasure map has fallen into the hands of Dr. Inferno's henchman! It's the LEGO Agent's mission to infiltrate the secret swamp base, recover the map, and escape on the high-tech rocket-cycle. Watch out for the booby-trapped bridge -- it can drop you into the jaws of the "remote-controlled" crocodiles! Includes Agent Charge and Break Jaw minifigures! Includes swamp base, rocket-cycle, jetski and 2 remote-controlled crocodiles! Bridge has 2 flick-fire missiles that rotate in all directions! Push the button to activate the secret drop bridge! Swamp base stands 6" (15cm) tall and 11" (28cm) wide!

8633-1.desc: Agent Trace has been captured by Dr. Inferno's henchman Break Jaw…and he's about to feed her to his laser-guided cyborg sharks! As a LEGO Agent, it's your mission to save Trace with the help of your gadget-loaded super-spy speedboat. Detach the mini-sub and take Break Jaw by surprise! Includes Agent Trace, Agent Chase and Break Jaw minifigures, plus 2 sharks! Launch the flick-fire missiles attached to the sharks! Use the net shooter to stop the sharks! Detach the mini sub from the speedboat! Fire the speedboat's harpoon and use it as a zipline to save Agent Trace! Open the sides of the speedboat! Watch out for Break Jaw and his jetski! Speedboat measures 10'½" (27cm) long and 5" (13cm) wide!

8634-1.desc: Dr. Inferno's laptop computer is loaded with secret information about his plans to conquer the world. It's the LEGO Agent's mission to locate his hidden base, snatch the laptop, and get out as fast as you can. Fortunately, you've got the latest high-tech turbocar on your side, packed with super-spy gadgets from an ejector seat to hidden lasers and missile launchers! Crash through the electronic-alarm gate, but watch out -- the spider-legged Spy Clops and his mecha-copter are in hot pursuit! Includes Agent Chase, Henchman and spider-legged Spy Clops minifigures! Turbocar has an ejector seat, pop-up launchers in front and hidden flick-fire missiles in back! Crash through the gate to set off the working alarm! Helicopter has a retractable winch to lower Spy Clops down and pull him back up! Launch the helicopter's twin flick-fire rockets! Car measures over 6" (15cm) long and over 3" (7cm) wide! Helicopter is 10" (25cm) long!

8635-1.desc: The evil Dr. Inferno is a prisoner in the gigantic rolling Mobile Command Center…but his henchmen have arrived with their hover-jet to break him free! Your mission: alert all the LEGO Agents and prevent his escape. Fortunately, this big truck is full of super-spy surprises, from a computer center with light-up mission projector, tool shop, loading crane, high-tech prison and weapons bay to a jet-boat, stealth plane, two cars, hidden missiles and blasters, and more! Includes 4 agent minifigures: Agent Chase, Agent Fuse, Agent Charge and Agent Trace! Also includes Dr. Inferno, Gold Tooth and Spy Clops minifigures! Truck closes for undercover mode and opens to reveal the command center! Truck holds 4 vehicles inside: a jet-boat, plane and 2 cars! Use the crane on the command center to lower the car! Push the light-up brick to project an image of Dr. Inferno and his evil sharks on the screen! Command center has a prison to lock up Dr. Inferno! Command center holds equipment and tools needed for missions! Front of truck's cabin opens to reveal hidden missiles! Cabin detaches from the truck and measures 8" long! Truck and trailer measures over 20" (50cm) long and 6" (15cm) high!

8636-1.desc: When danger threatens in the ocean depths, it's up to the LEGO Agents to save the day! The mission is to stop Dr. Inferno's henchmen Slime Face and Break Jaw from recovering the sunken treasure. Get there first in the tactical operations sub and use the detachable scuba jet and grappling hook to complete the mission -- but watch out for the glowing deep-sea octopus and the enemy boat's rocket and torpedo launchers! Includes Agent Chase, Agent Charge, Break Jaw and Slime Face minifigures! Watch out for the glow-in-the-dark octopus! Launch the boat's underwater rocket shooter and the flick-fire torpedo launchers! Detach the scuba jet for more underwater adventure! Hide the treasure chest in the sub's secret storage hold! Lift the front of the submarine to reveal hidden missiles! Open the sub's cockpit and put Agent Charge at the controls! Submarine measures 16" (41cm) long and 4'½" (11cm) wide! Henchmen's boat measures 9" (23cm) long and 4" (10cm) wide!

8637-1.desc: The LEGO Agents have finally located Dr. Inferno's hidden lair, built deep in the heart of a raging volcano. Now it's up to the LEGO Agents team to get there in the high-tech turbocopter with capture net, get past the high-security defenses using the lava pit monorail, and take out the giant laser cannon before Inferno unleashes its power on the entire world! This mission is top-priority and time is running out, but beware: you'll have to defeat Fire Arm and Claw-Dette before you face Dr. Inferno himself! Includes Agent Chase, Agent Trace and Agent Fuse minifigures! Also includes Dr. Inferno, Fire Arm and Claw-Dette minifigures! Drop the net from the turbocopter! Help save Agent Fuse from the lavapit! Volcano Base has a rotating laser cannon, satellite, control room and front doors that open! Volcano Base stands 8" (20cm) high and opens 15" (38cm) wide!

8685-1.desc: Strong and agile, Kopaka soars through the sky on his high-tech wings. Armed with his Midak Skyblaster tipped with an ice bayonet and Mask of X-Ray Vision, he is ready for serious combat in the air. Combine with 8945 Solek for more power in battle! Midak Skyblaster really fires! Toa Kopaka has 4" (10 cm) wings and stands 8" (20 cm) tall!

8686-1.desc: With his high-tech jet pack, Mask of Levitation, and wing blades, Toa Lewa roars into battle! Tall, strong and armed with a razor-sharp sword and Midak Skyblaster, he is a force to be reckoned with. Send him into the fight along with 8944 Tanma to rout the Brotherhood of Makuta! Midak Skyblaster really fires! Toa Lewa stands 7'½" (19 cm) tall!

8687-1.desc: Using his massive propellers to fly through the sky or bash his enemies, Toa Pohatu is as tough as they come. His Mask of Speed and shoulder-mounted Midak Skyblaster make him a devastating fighter. Combine with 8946 Photok for more action in the air! Midak Skyblaster really fires! Toa Pohatu stands 6'½" (16.5cm) tall!

8688-1.desc: With two powerful, foot-mounted jet rockets, Nynrah ghost blaster, and Mask of Water Breathing, Toa Gali rules the low-lying, muddy waters of the Karda Nui swamp. But will all her power be enough to stop the Makuta? Combine with 8944 Tanma for twice the power! Nynrah ghost blaster really fires! Stands 6'½" (16cm) tall!

8689-1.desc: Toa Tahu moves fast and strikes hard in the swamp of Karda Nui! He's got four powerful jet rockets for speed, plus a Nynrah ghost blaster, rotating blade, and Mask of Shielding for combat. He's ready to lead his team to victory over the Brotherhood of Makuta! Combine with 8945 Solek for more power in battle! Toa Tahu has 4 jet rockets, spinning blades and a firing Nynrah ghost blaster! Stands 7" (18cm) tall!

8690-1.desc: Wise and strong, Toa Onua challenges the mysteries of Karda Nui with his jet rockets, Nynrah ghost blaster, multi-resistant shield, Mask of Strength and high-tech wings. But can the power of earth prevail in a swamp filled with deadly foes? Combine with 8946 Photok to battle the Brotherhood of Makuta! Toa Onua is equipped with multi-resistant shield and Nynrah gohst blaster that really fires! Stands 7" (18cm) tall!

8691-1.desc: Armed with a Tridax Pod, Mask of Corruption, powerful claws and poisonous fangs, Antroz leads the Brotherhood of Makuta forces in Karda Nui into the fight. This powerful warriors tears through the air on bat-like wings. Combine with 8947 Radiak for a flight of fear! Tridax Pod holds 4 shadow leeches! Antroz has 6" (15cm) bat-like wings, armed with 3'½" (9cm) blades and stands 7'½" (19cm) tall!

8692-1.desc: Diving silently through the air on his huge black wings, Makuta Vamprah strikes fear into the hearts of even the other Brotherhood members. He's ready to crush the Toa Nuva with his Mask of Hunger, vicious hook claws, razor-sharp wing knives, and Tridax Pod with shadow leeches. Combine with 8948 Gavla to double the destruction! Tridax Pod holds 4 shadow leeches! Vamprah stands 7" (18cm) tall!

8693-1.desc: When there is evil to be done, insane genius Makuta Chirox unfolds his wings and takes to the sky. Armed with a Tridax Pod, blade hooks, and Mask of Silence, this twisted being creates bizarre creatures and brings darkness to Karda Nui. Combine with 8949 Kirop for twice the menace! Tridax Pod holds 4 shadow leeches! Chirox has 4'½" blades and stands 7'½" (19 cm) tall!

8694-1.desc: He strikes from the mist like a ghost, appearing and disappearing at will! With his venomous fangs, Mask of Repulsion, and Nynrah ghost blaster, Krika may be the strangest and most ruthless foe the Toa Nuva have ever faced! Combine with 8949 Kirop for more action! Nynrah ghost blaster really fires! Front venomous fangs are 8" (20cm) long! Stands 9" (23cm) tall!

8695-1.desc: Makuta Gorast is known throughout the universe for her raw power and violent rage. With four claw arms, Mask of Disruption and Nynrah ghost blaster, even other Makuta have reason to fear her might. Combine with 8947 Radiak for more action in the air! Gorast has 4 claw arms, stinger and Nynrah ghost blaster that really fires! Stands 6" (15cm) tall!

8696-1.desc: Makuta Bitil uses his Mask of Duplication to draw earlier versions of himself from the past, creating a fierce army of time-traveling warriors! Combined with his spikes, blades and Nynrah ghost blaster, this makes him an unstoppable foe! Combine with 8948 Gavla to soar into battle! Bitil is ready for battle with his spikes, blades and Nynrah ghost blaster that really fires! Stands 8" (20cm) tall!

8697-1.desc: The Mask of Life created a body for itself from stray molecules and has become Toa Ignika, the Toa of Life! Now, flying on a powerful skyboard and armed with a Midak Skyblaster and keen sword, he is determined to be a hero. Includes Kanohi Ignika! Toa Ignika has blades on his shoulders, 5" (13cm) long sword and a Midak Skyblaster that really fires! Attach and detach Toa Ignika from the skyboard! Toa Ignika stands 7" (18cm) tall and skyboard measures 11" (28cm) long!

8698-1.desc: Mounted on his ultra-fast skyfighter, the evil Vultraz fires devastating bolts of shadow from its front-mounted blaster. Can the Toa Nuva survive his sudden strikes, or will he bring their mission in Karda Nui to a crushing end? Front-mounted Skyblaster really fires! Vultraz stands 5"" (13cm) tall! Skyfighter is 14"" (36cm) long and 10"" (25cm) wide!

8699-1.desc: After surviving an attack by the Makuta, Takanuva now finds himself controlling both the power of Light and the power of Shadow! Granted even greater power by the energies of Karda Nui, this mighty hero is ready for the fight. Armed with a Midak Skyblaster and a three-pronged power lance, he is ready to challenge any enemy. Midak Skyblaster really fires! Three-pronged power lance is 11"" (28cm) long! Takanuva stands 12"" (30cm) tall!

876993-1.desc: Erase any errors and look cool while you do it with this set of LEGO brick erasers!

8881-1.desc:
Add more power to your LEGO® Power Functions!
Give even more power and movement to your LEGO® creations with an extra battery box to supply power to your LEGO Power Functions motors!
Each battery box can power 2 XL-Motors or 4 M-Motors at the same time.
Requires 6 AA (1,5V) batteries, not included.

8882-1.desc:
Powerful rotation for your LEGO® Power Functions!
Add an extra XL-Motor to your LEGO® creations! This super-strong motor will give plenty of power to your models, whether it’s spinning a wheel or turning a system of gears.
Use the "XL" Motor to animate larger builds.
Requires battery box (Item #8881), not included.

8883-1.desc:
Add a spin to your LEGO® Power Functions models!
Build an extra medium-strength, medium-sized M-Motor into your LEGO® creations and watch things start moving!
Use the M-Motor for speed.
Requires battery box (Item #8881), not included.

8884-1.desc:
Add remote-control functionality to your LEGO® models!
Build this LEGO® Power Functions IR receiver into your LEGO models and add amazing movement and functionality with a click of the remote control (available separately, see item #8885 or 8879)!
IR Reciver has 2 outputs that connect up to 2 different LEGO Power Functions.
The LEGO Power Functions IR RC system operates on 4 different channels enabling you to control 4 different models at the same time. Use 8885 IR Remote Control or 8879 IR Speed Remote control to control functions on the IR Receiver!
The reaching distance of the infra-red RC system is at least 30' (10m).
Requires battery box (Item #8881), not included.

8885-1.desc:
Ultimate control over your LEGO® Power Functions creations!
Build a LEGO® Power Functions IR receiver, battery box and motors into your LEGO creations, then use this handy remote control to start, stop, change direction and more!
The LEGO Power Functions IR Remote Control system operates on 4 different channels enabling the use of 4 models being controlled at the same time.
Control up to 8 different LEGO Power Functions with one remote by connecting 2 LEGO Power Functions to 4 different receivers each.
The reaching distance of the infra-red RC system is at least 30' (10m).
Requires IR Receiver (Item #8884), not included.
Requires 3 AAA (1.5V) batteries, not included.

8886-1.desc:
Extend the reach of your LEGO® Power Functions!
Power up your LEGO® Power Functions creations with this 8" extension wire. Make your models bigger, better, and more mechanized than ever before!
Allows you to connect your LEGO 9V electric systems to the new Power Functions!
Extension Wire is 8" (20cm) long

8941-1.desc: Packed with power, the Rockoh T3 can trap energy ships in an energy field or ram them out of the sky! Fold out the wings for flight, or fold them into for a power dive. Includes special-edition Pohatu Nuva figure! Pull the lever underneath to fire the blaster! Rockoh T3 measures 16" (41cm) long! Pohatu Nuva stands 7" (18cm) tall!

8942-1.desc: Makuta Antroz has hijacked the Jetrax T6 and now flies it against the Toa Nuva! Open the cockpit to put him inside, then use the three powerful blasters mounted on the front to launch an attack. Includes special-edition Antroz figure! Jetrax T6 has 3 Midak Skyblasters that really fire! Cockpit opens and turbines fold in! Antroz stands 7" (18cm) tall! Jetrax T6 measures 21" (53cm) long and 16" (41cm) wide!

8942-2.desc: Makuta Antroz has hijacked the Jetrax T6 and now flies it against the Toa Nuva! Open the cockpit to put him inside, then use the three powerful blasters mounted on the front to launch an attack. Includes special-edition Antroz figure! Jetrax T6 has 3 Midak Skyblasters that really fire! Cockpit opens and turbines fold in! Antroz stands 7" (18cm) tall! Jetrax T6 measures 21" (53cm) long and 16" (41cm) wide!

8943-1.desc: Lewa Nuva is ready for battle in this massively powerful battlecruiser! With dual Midak Skyblasters and tri-arms featuring lasers and force field generators, its mission is to smash the Brotherhood of Makuta while there's still time to save the universe! Includes special-edition Lewa Nuva figure! Raise and lower the landing gear! Sides open to reveal the dual Midak Skyblasters that really fire! Turn the gear on the side to open and close the tri-arms! Hold the handle underneath to fly the Axalara T9! Lewa Nuva stands 7½" (19cm) tall! Measures over 20" (50cm) long and 13" (33cm) high!

8944-1.desc: The only member of his village to survive a shadow leech attack, Tanma is out for revenge on the Brotherhood of Makuta. With his twin power blades and rocket booster, he has what it takes to fight and win. Combine with 8686 Toa Lewa to soar into battle! Tanma has yellow eyes, rocket booster and 3'½" (9cm) long twin power blades! Stands 5'½" (14cm) tall!

8945-1.desc: An expert on the ancient legends of the Toa, Solek has always wanted to be a hero like them. Now he has the chance to fight alongside his idols! Fights with dual power blades and rocket booster. Combine with 8685 Toa Kopaka for more action! Solek has yellow eyes, rocket booster and 3'½" (9cm) long twin power blades! Stands 5'½" (14cm) tall!

8946-1.desc: Taking crazy risks, Photok uses his twin power blades and rocket booster to prove he's as good as any Toa. Combine with 8687 Toa Pohatu too for twice the power in the skies of Karda Nui! Photok has yellow eyes, rocket booster and 2'½" (6cm) long twin power blades! Stands 5" (13cm) tall!

8947-1.desc: Once a great Matoran hero, Radiak now fights his former friends with wings, fangs and four wickedly sharp blades. Combine with 8691 Antroz to make a fearsome duo! Radiak has red eyes, wings, and two 4" (10cm) long blades! Stands 5'½" (14cm) tall!

8948-1.desc: The first Matoran of Light to be corrupted by the Makuta, Gavla is out to avenge years of being shunned by her own people. Combine with 8692 Vamprah to threaten the freedom of every Matoran! Gavla has red eyes, wings and 3'½" (9cm) long twin blades! Stands 5" (13cm) tall!

8949-1.desc: Once he was the leader of the Matoran in Karda Nui -- now he rules the evil Matoran who threaten their lives! Large claw blades and wings are his most formidable weapons. Combine with 8693 Chirox to spread darkness and fear! Kirop has red eyes, wings and large claw blades! Stands 5'½" (14cm) tall!

8952-1.desc: Deep in the heart of a vast hive, evil Makuta Mutran and his servant Vican guard the shadow leech vats. With claws, blades, spears and armored wings, they are prepared to fight off any attack. Set includes both figures, Tridak pod with shadow leeches, and more! Figures combine so they can go into battle together! Mutran has claws, fangs, wings, blade, Tridak pod with shadow leeches, and a 9" (23cm) long spear! Vican has red eyes, wings and claws! Mutran stands 9" (23cm) tall and Vican is 4'½" (11cm) tall!

8953-1.desc: Icarax is the ultimate winged Makuta warrior! With his twin sword, rotating shadow blades, Mask of Shadow, and Tridax pod, he is ready to crush any Toa opponent! Can any power in the universe hope to stop him? Includes Tridax pod with four shadow leeches! Turn the handle to spin the shadow blades! Icarax stands 10" (25cm) tall! Twin sword measures over 10" (25cm) long!

8954-1.desc: Mazeka travels to Karda Nui on his Helryx Swamp Strider to strike for the Order of Mata Nui! This brave Matoran dares any danger to stop the evil Brotherhood of Makuta. His Midak skyblaster turret rotates 360 degrees and comes with 9 light spheres. Adjust the legs of the swamp strider, load your skyblaster and prepare for battle!

922999-1.desc: For the ultimate LEGO Fan pack your sandwiches and a drink in LEGO lunchbox, making your lunch colourful. Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

926096-1.desc: For the ultimate LEGO Fan pack your sandwiches and a drink in LEGO lunchbox, making your lunch colourful. Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

9628-1.desc:
Combine the Power Add-On Set to the Mechanisms Base Set and watch as your students bring their models to life! With the addition of the motor, battery box, and connecting leads, your students can build four new models and solve two additional problem-solving tasks. Building instructions for the new models are included. Activities are included in the Mechanisms Activity Pack.
This set previously appeared as, and is the same as, Science & Technology Power Add-On Set.

9648-1.desc: This versatile set includes 671 TECHNIC building elements. The set was specifically designed to complement the LEGO MINDSTORMS Education Base Set, as well as the new Science & Technology Set. Use the Resource Set to build bigger and more complex robots, and complete more challenging engineering projects. The set comes complete with a plastic storage bin and sorting trays.

9656-1.desc:
This set features a brick assortment and eight double-sided, full-color building instructions. The set includes gears, levers, pulleys, and wheels and axles, as well as a plastic punch-out sheet with eyes, sails, scales and wings.Use this set with the accompanying curriculum pack to conduct full lessons, extension activities, and problem-solving tasks. The support materials provided in this curriculum pack include teacher guidance and student worksheets.

LIJNDS-1.desc: From the creators of the LEGO Star Wars video games, it's LEGO Indiana Jones: The Original Adventures! Swing, battle, and build your way through all three classic movies, from the hunt for the Golden Idol to the quest for the Holy Grail…now with a unique LEGO twist! Outrun boulders, outwit enemies, and encounter all of Indy's most famous friends and foes in this exciting, funny and action-packed game for the entire family. Play through classic Indiana Jones adventures, from Indy's entanglements with snakes to his daring boulder run! Use Indy's signature whip to attack enemies, swing over perilous pits and interact with a world of LEGO objects and puzzles! LEGO characters are fully immersed in their environment; swim, climb, shimmy across rock ledges and pick up and carry objects! Get help from a host of supporting characters including Marion Ravenwood and Short Round! Players can also mix and match the body parts of more than 60 playable characters to create new heroes like Sallah Scott or Mola Round! Rated E for Everyone.

10193-1.desc:
Expand your LEGO® Castle kingdom!
This classic medieval village with marketplace is a perfect match for any LEGO® Castle. Full of authentic features, fun accessories and all-new animals to expand and enhance your kingdom; it includes two complete buildings with detailed interiors like a blacksmith’s shop with waterwheel-driven hammer, a food stand, tree, table, cart, cows, chicken, rooster, duck, peasants, knights, rare elements and colors, and more!
Play inside! The 2 two-story buildings feature a hinge system that allows you to open and close them as you wish!
The yellow building contains the stables, blacksmiths shop and his home upstairs! Help the blacksmith forge the swords with the water powered trip hammer! Don’t forget to close the stable gates and feed the horse some carrots!
The classically European styled blue building features a cozy tavern on the first floor and welcoming bedroom on the top floor.
Lots of authentic touches: fireplaces in the bedrooms, pictures on the walls, dressing tables, working doors and windows and other interior details!
The soldiers and peasants alike shop and eat in the marketplace filled with baskets of fish, apples and flowers. Sit at the table for a meal of cheese and whole turkey but stay out of the way of the soldiers carrying the kings treasure!
Includes 8 minifigures: blacksmith, 2 soldiers, 2 male peasants, 2 female peasants and a boy minifigure!
Buildings measure over 7.5" (19cm) tall and over 9" (22cm) long when open wide!

10194-1.desc:
With piston-powered wheels, this train is an all-new LEGO® classic!
Here comes the Emerald Night! Build this incredible classic-styled train with loads of amazing details, from the steam locomotive with furnace to the opening tender and dining car with removable roof, opening doors and detailed interior. Measures 27.2" (68cm) long! Includes three minifigures, elements in rare colors and all-new large train wheels with piston motion! Add LEGO® Power Functions to motorize. This classically-styled train features a steam locomotive with furnace, opening tender, dining car with removable roof, opening doors and detailed interior! Train measures 27.2" (68cm) long Lots of authentic touches including elements in rare colors and all-new large train wheels with piston motion! Includes 3 minifigures! Motorize your Emerald Night by adding LEGO Power Functions #8882 Power Functions XL Motor, #8867 Flexible Train Track, #8878 Power Functions Rechargeable Battery Box, #8887 Transformer 10v DC adapter, #8884 Power Functions IR Receiver,#8870 Power Functions LED Lights, #8879 Power Functions IR Speed Remote Control!

10196-1.desc: It's a wonderful day for a ride on the merry-go-round! This elegant and beautifully detailed LEGO model isn't just for show -- it really spins and plays music while the horses and swing boats move up and down! Built with intricate, lifelike ornaments and features, the Grand Carousel is a spectacular addition to any LEGO display or carousel collection. Includes 9 minifigures and LEGO Power Functions motor and sound brick. Experience the romance of this merry-go-round decorated with brightly colored elements! Features 9 minifigures including ride operator! The platform rotates and the music plays! The swing boats and galloping jumper horses move up and down! Lots of realistic details including reflective decals on the center pole, ornate ornamentation, fleur de lys, bejeweled horses and profiles of jesters! The tent-like top is made of canvas! The Grand Carousel measures 15.1" (38.4cm) x 15.1" (38.4cm) x 13.8" (35.0cm)! Requires 6 AA (1.5V) batteries, not included.

10197-1.desc:
Build an authentic vintage fire station!
Ding ding ding! There’s a fire in town! The fire brigade drives to the scene from this detailed and realistic 1930’s fire station. Designed to fit with other modular buildings like 10211 Grand Emporium and 10185 Green Grocer, the station features rare LEGO® pieces and innovative construction techniques. It includes a ‘30s-style fire truck, 4 minifigures, a fire-dog, an opening station garage door, and a removable building roof for interior access. It also includes 2 fully-furnished floors with fire-fighting tools, racks for the firemen's helmets, fire-pole, ping-pong table, kitchen with fully-stocked fridge, couch, bookshelf and a roof with a water tower and bell. Measures 14" (35cm) high and 10" (25cm) wide.
Includes a 1930’s-style fire truck, 4 minifigures and a fire-dog!
Features lots of realistic details including fire-fighting tools, racks for firemen’s helmets and even a fire-pole!
The station house features an opening station garage door and 2 fully-furnished floors including a kitchen with fully-stocked fridge and a ping-pong table!
Remove the roof for interior access!
The roof is equipped with a water tower and bell!
Fire Brigade features rare LEGO elements including bricks and plates in dark tan, 1x1 dark red tiles, a red hot dog and the 3x6x5 Belleville® arch. It also features gold fireman’s helmets, a tan hand bag and a red sliding garage door!
Measures 14" (35 cm) high and 10" (25 cm) wide!
Add Fire Brigade to your LEGO Town and combine it with other modular buildings like 10211 Grand Emporium and 10185 Green Grocer!

10287-1.desc: Now you can be the proud owner of one of the Limited Edition Black NXT micro-controllers that have been produced to celebrate the 10 year anniversary of LEGO MINDSTORMS! The first LEGO MINDSTORMS products came out in the year 1998 and have since then continued to bring fun and active building and programming experiences to millions of robotic builders across the world! Once you have bought and received your new Black NXT you will get access to exclusive materials like a special-made program for the Black NXT, a personal certificate of ownership, wallpapers, and building instructions for special models! The Limited Edition Black NXT, your robot's 'brain', features a powerful 32-bit microprocessor and Flash memory, plus support for Bluetooth and USB 2.0! Limited quantity available! The NXT intelligent Brick includes: 32-bit ARM7 microprocessor. Support for Bluetooth wireless communication. 1 USB 2.0 port. 4 input ports. 3 output ports. Powered by 6 AA (1.5v) Batteries, not included, or lithium Rechargeable Battery (#9798), sold separately. Up to three NXT Bricks can be connected at the same time; however, you can only communicate with one NXT Brick at a time. This is the individual component, and does not include any sensors, motors, cords, software or other accessories; for the complete LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT set, please see item #8527.
